raw.description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.

Location: India (Remote)

Work Schedule: 9 hours per day, 6 days per week

Employment Type: 6-Month Contract (High performance converts to an Extension or Full-time)

Compensation: ₹10,000 – ₹15,000 / month fixed + additional performance-based incentive

Why Join Weekday?

At Weekday, we are building the future of startup hiring. High-growth tech companies and fast-paced startups rely on us to find exceptional talent, fast.

As a Candidate Outreach Associate Intern you will be the first voice our shortlisted candidates hear. Your main responsibility is to call candidates, inform them that their profile has been shortlisted for specific roles and companies, explain why this opportunity matters, and gauge their interest. This is a high-impact role: your calls directly affect how many strong candidates convert into interviews and offers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Here’s the updated JD with the 100–120 calls/day expectation clearly added:

    Job Title

    Candidate Outreach Associate (Intern / Executive)

    About the Role

    You will be the first voice our shortlisted candidates hear. Your main responsibility is to call candidates, inform them that their profile has been shortlisted for specific roles and companies, explain why this opportunity matters, and gauge their interest. If they’re interested, you’ll guide them to the next step (interview scheduling / profile submission). This is a high-impact role: your calls directly affect how many strong candidates convert into interviews and offers.resources.workable+2

    Key Responsibilities

  • Make 100–120 outbound calls per day to shortlisted candidates from the database / ATS.

  • Clearly explain the role, company, location, shift, and key highlights in a way that makes the opportunity feel important and worth pursuing.

  • Assess candidate interest, answer basic queries, and address common objections (timing, location, notice period, etc.)

  • Maintain accurate call logs and candidate status updates in the tracker/ATS (e.g., “contacted”, “interested”, “not interested”, “call back”).

  • Follow up via call/WhatsApp/email as needed to keep candidates engaged until interview or offer stage.

  • Work closely with the recruitment/HR team to understand role priorities and update them on candidate response patterns.

Requirements

  • Excellent communication skills in English and local language (clear speech, polite tone, confident phone etiquette).

  • Smart, quick learner who can grasp job details fast and explain them simply.

  • Comfortable making multiple outbound calls daily and handling rejection professionally.

  • Basic computer skills (Google Sheets/Excel, email, WhatsApp).

  • Prior experience in BPO, telecalling, sales, or recruitment outreach is a plus but not mandatory for interns.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in IT/non-IT staffing or recruitment coordination.

  • Familiarity with ATS tools or candidate tracking sheets.

What We Offer

  • Direct Path to Full-Time: Outstanding performance can lead to contract extension or conversion to a full-time role.

  • Steep Learning Curve: Learn startup hiring, candidate evaluation, and operational analytics directly from experienced leaders.

  • Culture of Growth: Work in a high-energy environment where ownership is recognized and rewarded.

Description

TripleTen is a service that empowers individuals, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions.

Our bootcamps focus on training students in software engineering, data science, business intelligence analytics, and QA engineering in a feasible and accessible way, ultimately leading them to thrive in a new career.

Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.

TripleTen is a remote first organization mirroring our students who complete our bootcamps in a remote environment.

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Marketing Manager to own and drive a portfolio of marketing projects, from scoping through launch and results tracking. This role collaborates closely with our Marketing, Content, and Product teams to identify opportunities, run initiatives end-to-end, and turn insights into measurable results.

The best candidates for this position combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, are comfortable managing several projects at once, and know how to turn a messy problem into a clear plan.

What you will do

  • Own and drive multiple marketing projects end-to-end, from scoping to launch to results tracking.
  • Analyze market and audience feedback, turning insights into actionable marketing initiatives.
  • Develop and execute content and community strategies in collaboration with internal teams and external agencies.
  • Establish and grow brand presence across social media, online communities, and other digital channels.
  • Build guidelines and playbooks to support consistent brand messaging across channels.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to resolve complex, cross-functional issues.
  • Track project performance and report on key metrics to leadership.
  • Identify and act on opportunities to improve brand visibility and audience engagement.
  • Set up and manage engagement processes for key audience segments (students, graduates, alumni, etc.).
  • Scout, test, and scale new channels and platforms to reach and grow our audience.

Requirements

You're a strong, hands-on marketing generalist who loves building things yourself, not just managing others, with:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience running marketing projects end-to-end.
  • Strong background working with consumer-facing brands.
  • Excellent English communication skills for global audience engagement.
  • Analytical mindset with ability to measure and optimize project and campaign metrics.
  • Experience across several marketing disciplines: content, social media, and community.
  • Strategic thinking combined with tactical execution capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience with AI in at least one area — building products, funnels, designs, copywriting workflows, or agents.
  • Proven ability to manage sensitive or public-facing situations effectively.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in education technology or similar consumer services.
  • Content creation and digital marketing skills.
  • Crisis communication experience.

What we can offer you

  • Base compensation of $3000/month plus annual bonus.
  • Fully remote collaboration.
  • High autonomy to explore, test, and improve marketing processes.
  • Work alongside an experienced, global marketing team.
  • Room to grow your scope as projects prove out.

raw.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Community & Intelligence (Cloud Services). Cloud Services Software team is responsible for managing complex, high-stakes deployments of integrated Motorola Solutions’ SaaS products to seamlessly meet critical customer needs.


Job Description

We are seeking a highly accomplished and results-driven Project Manager to lead complex, cross-functional product deployment projects. The ideal candidate is an expert in project management with proven communication and leadership skills, capable of driving multiple simultaneous business projects towards aggressive delivery goals. This role is instrumental in identifying potential project breakdowns, implementing corrective changes, and proactively finding creative solutions to constraints to ensure successful, on-time project completion. This role requires exceptional skill in navigating a highly matrixed internal organization and coordinating with complex customer organizations to ensure successful, on-time delivery.

Key Responsibilities and Impact

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Own the Project Plan - Write, manage, implement, and continuously measure the project plan utilizing automated project management tools and processes.

  • Drive On-Time Delivery - Build, maintain, and communicate comprehensive project launch plans, meticulously tracking deliverables, milestones, resource allocation, and dependencies across all cross-functional teams.

  • Mitigate Risk & Escalate - Proactively anticipate issues, explore contingency plans, and provide effective escalation management throughout all phases of key projects.

  • Lead Implementation - Be fully accountable for the successful implementation and professional hand-off of the solution to the long-term Support and Success teams.

Stakeholder & Customer Management

  • Primary Liaison - Serve as the central point of contact for customers, channel partners, subcontractors, and internal staff for project-related matters.

  • Status & Reporting - Establish and maintain contact with customers and internal stakeholders, providing regular, transparent, and concise status updates.

  • Meeting Facilitation - Organize and facilitate effective meetings with both internal and external customers to drive decision-making and ensure the achievement of project goals, milestones, and deadlines.

  • Negotiation & Influence - Leverage excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills to navigate organizational complexity, influence stakeholders, and ensure project success.

Strategic Planning & Process Improvement

  • Business Acumen - Understand and articulate the business and financial implications of all project decisions and outcomes.

  • Process Enhancement - Collaborate with provisioning and product teams to develop and enhance tools, processes, and methodologies that improve collaboration, reduce redundancy, and ensure overall project success.

  • Risk Analysis - Perform detailed analyses of program data, provide ongoing assessment of project risks, and recommend data-driven solutions to customers and management. Prepare comprehensive action plans to resolve issues that could severely impact project achievements.

Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of Project Management experience working with SaaS solutions.

  • Bachelor's Degree; Master's Degree is a plus.

  • Demonstrated experience successfully navigating and leading agile projects within a highly matrixed organizational structure.

  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate the 'big picture' strategy while building trust with leaders cross-departmentally.

  • Proficient in developing project documentation and experienced with cloud-based document management systems.

  • Experience with Public Safety communications systems, understanding of local public safety customers (police, fire, EMS) is a significant plus.

  • PMP, PMP-ACP, or equivalent agile certifications are highly desirable.

  • Monday.com, Salesforce, or Zendesk experience is a plus.

Target Base Salary Range: $90,000 - $120,000 USD
Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.


Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree

  • At least 5+ years of experience working with SaaS solutions.

  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely is required. Employer work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.


Travel Requirements

Under 10%


Relocation Provided

None


Position Type

Experienced


Referral Payment Plan

Yes

Our U.S. Benefits include:

  • Incentive Bonus Plans

  • Medical, Dental, Vision benefits

  • 401K with Company Match

  • 10 Paid Holidays

  • Generous Paid Time Off Packages

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Paid Parental & Family Leave

  • and more!

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. To request an accommodation, please complete this Reasonable Accommodations Form so we can assist you.

Stormwater Engineer - NSW Residential Subdivision (Remote)

Work From Home | Full-Time | AU Hours | PH-Based

OutsourcedIn is partnering with an Australian consultancy to hire an experienced Stormwater Engineer with strong expertise in NSW residential building and land subdivision projects.

This role is focused on delivering compliant stormwater drainage designs for duplexes, townhouses, custom homes, and Torrens Title / greenfield subdivisions in accordance with NSW council requirements and Australian Standards.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with NSW OSD (On-Site Detention) systems and council submission processes.

About the Role

You will be responsible for preparing compliant stormwater management designs, supporting DA/CC submissions, and ensuring drainage solutions align with NSW DCP and ARR standards.

This is a technical role requiring strong compliance knowledge and detailed documentation capability.

Key Responsibilities

Stormwater Design & Engineering
Design stormwater systems for single dwellings, duplexes, and multi-dwelling developments
Design drainage systems for Torrens Title and greenfield subdivisions (ESSENTIAL)
Prepare Stormwater Management Plans (SWMP)
Perform hydraulic modelling and runoff calculations (ARR 2019 compliant)
Design OSD systems in line with NSW council DCP requirements
Prepare DA / CC documentation and engineering drawings

Compliance & Standards
Ensure compliance with NCC, AS/NZS 3500, ARR 2019, and NSW Council DCP requirements

Apply WSUD principles where required

Interpret and implement Sydney Water requirements (advantage)

Coordination & Project Support
Coordinate with planners, surveyors, architects, and certifiers
Provide construction-stage support and respond to RFIs
Ensure drainage layouts align with easements, overland flow paths, and inter-allotment drainage requirements

Technical Skills

Strong knowledge of NSW drainage and subdivision requirements
Pit & pipe network design for residential subdivisions
OSD tank sizing and orifice design calculations

Proficiency in AutoCAD and Civil 3D

Experience with DRAINS, MUSIC, or similar hydraulic software
Strong understanding of overland flow paths and drainage compliance

Mandatory Requirements

Bachelors Degree in Civil Engineering

5+ years stormwater / civil drainage design experience
Minimum 1–2 years NSW residential subdivision experience (ESSENTIAL)
Experience liaising directly with NSW councils
Strong written documentation skills for council submissions

Highly Regarded

Knowledge of Sydney Water requirements

CPEng qualification (desirable but not essential)
Experience supporting multiple residential projects simultaneously

Ideal Candidate Profile

Detail-oriented with strong compliance focus
Familiar with NSW certifier and council submission processes
Able to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced residential environment
Proactive communicator working with Australian teams remotely

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★
QuickBooks Financial Controller
Location: Remote — Canada, Central America, South America, or Europe
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
Industry: Interior Design / Professional Services
Compensation:$2,000 – $4,000 USD/month
English Proficiency:C1/C2 English Required
Schedule: Full-Time | Required overlap with U.S. business hours
Reports To: CFO


About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based luxury interior design firm specializing in bespoke, high-end environments that combine exceptional design, craftsmanship, functionality, and personalized client service.
The company is strengthening its internal finance operations and is looking for an experienced accounting professional who can bring the same level of precision and attention to detail to its financial function.
About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished QuickBooks Financial Controller with deep, hands-on QuickBooks expertise to take ownership of the company's accounting operations.
Reporting directly to the CFO, you will have full responsibility for the General Ledger, lead the transition from an outside accounting firm to a fully in-house accounting function, manage monthly close and reconciliations, prepare financial reporting, and oversee the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable team.
QuickBooks expertise is essential for this position. This role requires more than day-to-day usage. You must be comfortable configuring and optimizing QuickBooks and have experience with QuickBooks implementations.
This is a hands-on position for someone who is highly accurate, independent, comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment, and willing to support operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting when needed.
Why This Opportunity?
  • Take full ownership of the company's accounting operations and General Ledger.
  • Become the internal QuickBooks expert for the organization.
  • Work directly with the CFO and play a key role in strengthening the finance function.
  • Lead the transition from outsourced accounting to a fully in-house operation.
  • Manage and improve accounting processes, controls, and reporting.
  • Work remotely with significant autonomy and responsibility.
What You'll Do
QuickBooks & General Ledger
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks to support the company's accounting structure and reporting requirements.
  • Lead or support QuickBooks configuration and implementation initiatives.
  • Lead the transition of the General Ledger from an outside accounting firm to an in-house function.
  • Maintain, reconcile, and close the books monthly.
  • Establish and maintain the Chart of Accounts and appropriate classification standards.
Financial Reporting & Cash Management
  • Prepare accurate financial statements across the company's business divisions.
  • Prepare and review Profit & Loss (P&L) statements.
  • Oversee bank reconciliations.
  • Monitor the company's cash position.
  • Maintain accurate and reliable financial information for CFO review.
Team Leadership & Client Support
  • Supervise Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable specialists.
  • Review and approve invoices, hours reports, and client statements before distribution.
  • Review and approve payroll, vendor payments, and expense submissions.
  • Interface with clients regarding accounting-related requests when required.
  • Ensure accounting work completed by the team meets established standards.
  • Support operational and non-accounting matters that may arise within a small-team environment.
Tax & Accounting Controls
  • Coordinate payroll tax, sales tax, and 1099-related matters.
  • Execute accounting policies established by the CFO accurately and consistently.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a high standard of accuracy.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Prior experience as a Financial Controller, Senior Accountant, or similar senior accounting professional with full ownership of the General Ledger.
  • Advanced, hands-on QuickBooks expertise.
  • Professional experience with QuickBooks Online and/or QuickBooks Desktop.
  • Experience configuring QuickBooks and/or leading a QuickBooks implementation.
  • Strong experience managing the General Ledger, reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Experience preparing financial statements and P&L reports.
  • Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts structures and accounting classifications.
  • Experience overseeing or working closely with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistently low error rates.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to execute accounting policies and procedures with precision.
  • Comfortable supporting operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting.
  • C1/C2 English proficiency, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to work with required overlap during U.S. business hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience transitioning an accounting function from an external accounting firm to an in-house team.
  • Experience with BigTime or similar project accounting software.
  • Previous experience in professional services, interior design, architecture, construction, or project-based businesses.
  • Experience supervising accounting or bookkeeping professionals.
How Success Is Measured
Success in this position will be measured by your ability to:
  • Maintain an accurate and reliable General Ledger.
  • Independently execute reconciliations and month-end close.
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks according to business requirements.
  • Successfully support the transition to an in-house accounting function.
  • Deliver accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a consistently low error rate.
  • Effectively oversee AP and AR activities.
  • Work independently while executing CFO policies accurately.
  • Communicate professionally with U.S.-based colleagues and clients.
Video Presentation Required
As part of your application, please submit a short video in English introducing yourself and briefly summarizing your accounting background, followed by a 30-second to 1-minute overview of your QuickBooks experience, including how many years you have used it professionally, whether you have worked with QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop, your main responsibilities in the system, and any experience configuring QuickBooks or leading an implementation.
Why Join Us?
  • $2,000 – $4,000 USD/month, based on experience and location.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Direct exposure to the CFO and company leadership.
  • Significant ownership of the accounting function.
  • Opportunity to lead an important financial operations transition.
  • Long-term, full-time contractor opportunity.
  • Short initial trial period to ensure mutual fit.
Important Notes
Advanced QuickBooks expertise is a core requirement for this position. Basic familiarity, occasional use, or self-taught exposure without substantial professional experience will not be sufficient.
Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain their years of QuickBooks experience, versions used, responsibilities within the system, experience running monthly close, and any QuickBooks configuration or implementation experience.
C1/C2 English is mandatory. The role operates entirely in English with a U.S.-based team and, at times, directly with clients.
This is a permanent, full-time contractor opportunity with a short initial trial period.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

Job Description

We are seeking a hands-on Product Manager to drive improvements in the Canvas LMS experience and PowerSchool platform for educators and students. This role will focus on implementation, integrations, and user experience design—ensuring that Canvas works seamlessly with 3rd party tools, delivers content effectively, and provides an intuitive, engaging experience that supports learning at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end implementation of Canvas features, enhancements, and workflows across K–12 environments.
  • Help to guide and collaborate on the implementation of PowerSchool features, enhancements, and workflows across K–12 environments.
  • Partner with engineering, design, and curriculum teams to optimize the user experience for teachers, students, and administrators.
  • Evaluate, integrate, and manage 3rd party tools and content providers within Canvas, ensuring smooth interoperability and compliance with standards (LTI, QTI, SCORM, xAPI).
  • Gather and synthesize user feedback to identify pain points and prioritize solutions that improve usability, navigation, and engagement.
  • Own the product backlog, writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and working closely with engineering on delivery.
  • Collaborate with support teams to monitor performance, track issues, and ensure timely resolution of bugs or integration challenges.
  • Develop metrics and dashboards to measure adoption, user satisfaction, and learning impact; use insights to guide product decisions.
  • Create training materials, release notes, and demos to support rollout and drive adoption of new Canvas features and integrations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field; technical or instructional technology background preferred.
  • 4–8 years of experience in product management or LMS administration (Canvas and PowerSchool experience strongly preferred).
  • Strong understanding of LMS integrations, standards (LTI, QTI, SCORM, xAPI), and digital content delivery.
  • Experience working directly with educators, administrators, and instructional designers to improve workflows and learning experiences.
  • Excellent collaboration skills and ability to translate user needs into technical requirements.
  • Strong problem-solving and organizational skills with attention to detail.
  • Passion for improving digital learning environments and creating intuitive, student-centered experiences.

Senior Manager, Data Acquisition

About the Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at the link below,

About the Role

The Senior Manager, Data Acquisition, will lead data acquisition activities for the Global Fraud and Identity Market, with a focus on mobile identity and phone intelligence. This role will manage strategic data provider relationships that support business strategy, product innovation, and market growth, while partnering closely with product, analytics, legal, compliance, finance, and technology teams to bring high-value data assets into the business. The role will ensure data is responsibly sourced, aligned to business needs, and positioned for long-term value through effective onboarding, governance, and supplier management.

You'll be responsible for:

  • Lead the identification, evaluation, and acquisition of external data sources that support business strategy and product priorities for phone intelligence and mobile identity solutions.

  • Identify new market opportunities and data partnerships that strengthen product differentiation and long-term growth

  • Build and manage relationships with data suppliers, serving as the primary point of coordination throughout the acquisition lifecycle

  • Partner cross-functionally with product, analytics, legal, compliance, finance, and technology teams to assess opportunities and advance initiatives

  • Drive supplier due diligence, data evaluations, and onboarding activities to ensure new data assets meet business, operational, and compliance requirements

  • Negotiate commercial terms and support contract development in partnership with legal and business stakeholders

  • Oversee the successful transition of new data assets from evaluation through implementation and operational handoff

  • Monitor supplier performance, manage ongoing governance activities, and help address issues, renewals, and contract-related decisions

  • Develop clear business cases, recommendations, and status updates to support prioritization and executive decision-making

  • Ensure all acquisition activities align with internal policies, risk standards, and regulatory requirements

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business or Risk Management, preferred

  • Minimum 9 years related work experience

  • Demonstrated expertise in mobile identity and phone intelligence at a global scale, including practical knowledge of data sources, market dynamics, and use cases across regions.

  • Established relationships and experience working with mobile network operators, telco carriers, and related partner ecosystems to support data sourcing, and commercialization of phone intelligence solutions.

  • Understanding of regulatory requirements across multiple countries and industries governing the use of phone numbers and phone intelligence data.

  • Experienced in contract negotiations, including negotiating commercial and contractual terms with external partners and suppliers.

  • Experience managing multiple external data and vendor relationships of varying size and scale, including accountability for the P&L associated with those relationships.

  • Highly organized, self-motivated, and capable of working in a dynamic environment with minimal supervision.

  • Strong research, financial analysis, business analyst/support skills

  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to clearly engage stakeholders at all levels, including senior and executive leadership.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, issues, and deadlines concurrently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

U.S. National Base Pay Range: $104,900 - $174,700. Geographic differentials may apply in some locations to better reflect local market rates.This job is eligible for an annual incentive bonus.

Responsibilities include leading, collaborating with, and managing a talented team of stakeholders consisting of internal, external, and partner designers, professional staff and external Architectural and Engineering resources. Requirements of this position include demonstrating a high degree of creativity, foresight, and judgment in planning, organizing, and guiding architectural programs and activities.

Project types include Free Standing Emergency Department and Urgent Care facilities, Medical Office Buildings, and a combination thereof. The majority of projects will consist of De novo builds with some Tenant Improvement work. The ability to implement standards in a constantly evolving environment will be key to success. Strong and passionate leader committed to overall team success, evolution, and creative innovation to ensure a world class experience for our patients.

COMPETENCIES

  • Knowledge of healthcare design standards, permitting processes, and construction coordination preferred.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

REQUIRED

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred in Architecture, Construction Management, Interior Design, or related field.

  • Experience reviewing architectural and construction documents and supporting project implementation.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, and MS Project.

About The Position

The KIPP Foundation is seeking a highly organized and mission-driven Network Events and Experience (NEE) Manager. This full-time, exempt position reports to the Director of Network Events and Experience and works in close collaboration with the Schools Team. The NEE manager is responsible for achieving at least a 90% satisfaction rate on logistics from attendees and ensuring all events are delivered on time and within budget, and strengthening a shared sense of ownership, across the network, for all student outcomes. The ideal candidate is passionate about K–12 public education and thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. They bring strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills, and are comfortable managing complex projects and engaging with high-level stakeholders. Experience with event planning and cross-functional coordination is essential. The NEE manager is part of the Network Events and Experience (NEE) team, which provides comprehensive planning and execution support for events—whether in-person, virtual, or hybrid—across multiple teams. Our mission is to ensure consistent, high-quality event delivery from start to finish. As a detail-oriented and collaborative team, NEE partners closely with internal stakeholders to offer strategic guidance and manage logistics, communications, financial processes, and program evaluation for key events.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Program Design Partnership

  • Lead the planning and execution of high-impact virtual and in-person KIPP events and programs with a commitment to excellence.

  • Collaborate with programming directors to co-create the vision, annual strategy, and goals for cohort-specific learning experiences.

  • Develop detailed project plans aligned with programming leads’ objectives.

  • Set agendas and facilitate virtual planning meetings to identify gaps, align on program strategy, and ensure cohesion across workstreams.

  • Facilitate and support cohort team planning meetings to drive clarity and execution.

  • Provide thought partnership to session designers and hold stakeholders accountable to timelines and deliverables.

Event Operations, Logistics & Communications

  • Manage virtual programming components such as webinars, conference calls, and engagement on KIPP Share.

  • Manage all aspects of event logistics including set-up, registration, session execution, on-site support, off-site activities, and event break-down.

  • Lead communications for each event, including programming agendas, logistical details, instructor and participant communications, and supporting documents (e.g., pre-reads, handouts, binders).

  • Coordinate with internal teams, and as needed, external vendors (hotels, catering, transportation, etc.) to support program and event requirements.

  • Review, edit, and produce high-quality event materials.

  • Print, pack, and ship instructionally-related materials as needed.

Budget, Evaluation & Knowledge Management

  • Lead financial planning and monitoring processes including budget setting, expense tracking, invoice coding, and contract processing for programming-related activities.

  • Create and distribute post-event evaluations, including participant, instructor, and internal team surveys.

  • Conduct qualitative and quantitative data analysis to generate insights that inform program improvement.

  • Participate in after-action reviews and support team learning.

  • Maintain systems for internal knowledge and resource management.

  • Support team operations including supplies, materials inventory, and special projects as needed.

Skills and Mindsets

  • Mission and Student Focus: Demonstrates passion and commitment to KIPP’s mission and possesses the desire and ability to uphold KIPP’s core values (Focus on Excellent Results, Collective Impact, and Courageous Action)

  • Self Management: Demonstrated record of co-creating ambitious goals with their managers – and driving toward desired outcomes; Effectively monitors progress toward goals for multiple workstreams; Leverages understanding of an organization’s operating model, structure, and core operational process to effectively drive work to achieve goals; effectively works through direct reports and peers to follow through on commitments, ensuring others do the same.

  • Collaboration: Leads successful stakeholder management, accounting for varied perspectives when gathering feedback. Builds coalition by prioritizing end-user experiences. Builds trusting relationships and effective communications. Able to identify and remove barriers to working across teams. Demonstrated professional finesse that will allow you to successfully handle the unique and ever evolving needs of our facilitators (many of whom are high profile) and attendees. 

  • Work Management: Effectively drives work they own through clear action planning. Manages time effectively around competing priorities. Skilled in creating and executing project plans through partnership with stakeholders and effective delegation to achieve intended results on time. Skilled in knowledge management Detail oriented, execution focused and an ability to see the big picture while managing every detail 

  • Problem Solving: Generates solutions outside of their direct work and shrinks problems to solve independently. Shows initiative in generating and recommending ideas and solutions within their own workstreams. Anticipates risks and develops proactive solutions that support their team.

  • Continuous Learning: Engages in the work of personal development at working, knowing that personal development is ongoing and vital to their personal and professional success; hold themselves accountable to evolving, growing, learning and unlearning in ways that improve results for students, adults, and the larger community. 

Experience and Qualifications

  • Education – Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required 

  • 3-5 years of experience managing in-person and/or virtual events preferred. 

  • Experience in customer service role preferred.

  • Previous project management experience preferred. 

  • Proficiency with Survey Monkey, Qualtrics, Cvent, Zoom and Microsoft Office Suite

Work Conditions

  • Full-time, Exempt position   
  • Travel requirements: up to 30%
  • May require occasional heavy lifting (up to 50lbs) or physical setup of materials and equipment for events or programming.
  • Position includes some evening or weekend work, as determined by the nature of the role (e.g., evening events, weekend conferences, or special projects).
  • Flexibility in scheduling is expected to meet programmatic or event-related needs outside standard business hours.

Location

It is preferred, but not mandatory for this role to be based out of a KIPP Foundation office. This role also has the option of working from a remote office full-time. KIPP Foundation offices are in NYC and Chicago.

Compensation and Benefits

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, and relevant experience. The salary range for this position is $83,200 - $99,000. In addition, KIPP Foundation provides a variety of benefits to employees, including: 

  • 25 holidays for + 18 days additional flexible PTO days (flexible PTO increases to 23 days for years 3 and 4 and to 28 days for years 5+).

  • 100% paid parental leave

  • 100% coverage of the premium for employee and 75% for employee + family’s medical/dental/vision plans.

As the Senior Product Designer/Industrial Designer, you will lead the design and development of next-generation patient care products - from concept through production - translating caregiver feedback, customer reviews, and competitive insights into profitable, manufacturable solutions with exceptional ergonomics, usability, and functional detail.

﻿This is a full-time, remote independent contractor position.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to enhancing the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a passionate, diverse team from around the globe, the company prides itself on creating products that are not only well-designed but genuinely useful. Customer obsession is a guiding principle that shapes the company's strategy, culture, and decisions.

The company's mission is centered on improving well-being through meticulous attention to detail and continuous listening to customer feedback, ensuring that its solutions meet real caregiving needs. Its vision is to empower patients and caregivers with innovative products that improve quality of life. The company also values caring customer service, professional growth, work-life balance, and a supportive environment where team members can thrive and contribute to meaningful product impact.

This is a Full-Time | Fully Remote position reporting to the Project Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from concept development to production-ready solutions, ensuring all designs go through rigorous DFM (Design for Manufacturing) and DFA (Design for Assembly) analysis.
  • Translate internal product briefs, caregiver feedback, VOC data, and customer reviews into innovative, user-centered product concepts.
  • Apply deep materials knowledge to select the most suitable materials that balance aesthetic with structural durability and cost-efficiency.
  • Create advanced CAD models and detailed technical design and engineering documentation, utilizing FEA (Finite Element Analysis) and structural simulations to validate mechanical integrity and performance before prototyping.
  • Design and validate mockups, prototypes, and functional test samples.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, sourcing partners, and marketing to balance creativity with cost targets, supplier capabilities, and timelines.
  • Optimize design-to-prototype cycle times and improve design efficiency.
  • Maintain high standards of manufacturability, functional performance, and customer satisfaction (targeting 4.5+ product ratings).
  • Communicate effectively with international manufacturing partners, including Asian/China suppliers.

Expected Outcomes:

  • Deliver 4–6 fully engineered, manufacturable product designs within the first 3 months.
  • Develop final production-ready samples of 12–18 new SKUs by the end of 2026.
  • Achieve 30% contribution margin in design cost modeling.
  • Optimize and meet quarterly design-to-prototype cycle time targets within the first 6 months.
  • Implement a structured, user-driven design process for top legacy products within 12 months.
  • Establish and maintain a repeatable, scalable design documentation system.

Qualifications:

    • 3+ years of experience in Industrial Design or Product Design.
    • 2+ years designing mass-produced consumer, HME, or DME (patient care) products.
    • Experience taking products from concept to mass production.
    • Experience in mechanical design, prototyping, simulation, and testing.
    • Experience working within manufacturing and supplier constraints.
    • Experience communicating and collaborating with Asian/Chinese manufacturers.
    • Experience designing products for marketplaces influenced by public customer reviews.
    • Experience with mechanical CAD software, such as SolidWorks, Inventor, Onshape.
    • Experience with cost modeling and margin-focused design decisions.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable design improvements.
    • Deep understanding of ergonomics, usability, and user-centered design principles.
    • Close attention to detail and commitment to excellence.
    • Proactive problem-solver with a strong ownership mindset.
    • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
    • High adaptability and ability to thrive in a fast-scaling environment.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to Detail – Nothing slips through the cracks.
  • Commitment & Work Ethic – Willingness to go the distance to get results.
  • Consistency & Persistence – Demonstrates tenacity in achieving goals.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset – Sees and communicates the bigger picture.
  • Proactive Problem Solving – Brings new ideas without being prompted.
  • Integrity & Trustworthiness – Operates with honesty and transparency.
  • Customer Obsession – Actively integrates customer feedback into product improvements.
  • Creativity & Innovation – Develops original, differentiated solutions.
  • High Standards – Expects excellence from self and team.
  • Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration – Works seamlessly across departments.
  • Analytical Thinking – Transforms data into informed design decisions.
  • Flexibility & Adaptability – Thrives in dynamic and evolving conditions.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Opportunity to design next-generation patient care products with meaningful market impact.
  • Direct influence on revenue growth and product innovation strategy.
  • High ownership and autonomy in decision-making.
  • A performance-driven, values-based culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored Company Trips.
  • Quarterly Rock Bonus.
  • Performance Bonus.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is a unique opportunity for a senior-level designer who combines creativity with engineering discipline, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer empathy with commercial awareness.

raw.description:
What You'll Do

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Offensive Security Engineer to join our Threat Management & Security Operations organization. In this hands-on role, you will think and operate like an adversary — continuously finding, exploiting, and helping remediate real-world weaknesses across First Advantage’s products, cloud infrastructure, networks, and people. You will design and execute penetration tests, red and purple team engagements, and adversary emulation exercises that validate our detection and response capabilities and measurably reduce enterprise risk at-scale.

This role partners closely with Security Operations, Threat Intelligence & Hunt, Vulnerability Management, Application Security, DevOps, and Product teams to turn offensive findings into prioritized, business-aligned remediation. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building custom tooling, chaining exploits across complex environments, and communicating impact clearly to both technical teams and executive leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Penetration Testing: Plan, scope, and execute internal and external penetration tests across web and mobile applications, APIs, cloud (AWS/Azure), networks, and infrastructure using real-world attacker techniques.

  • Red & Purple Teaming: Design and run adversary emulation and red team engagements that combine multiple attack paths to accomplish objective-based goals, and partner with the SOC, Threat Intel & Hunt, and Detection Engineering on purple team exercises to validate and improve detection coverage.

  • Exploit Development & Chaining: Identify, validate, and safely exploit vulnerabilities — including chaining lower-severity issues into high-impact attack paths — and demonstrate tangible business impact in production-representative environments.

  • Adversary Emulation: Model real-world threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework to test and strengthen organizational resilience, detection, and response.

  • Findings & Remediation: Review and validate findings for accuracy, prioritize real-world exploitability and business risk, create remediation tickets, and partner with engineering teams to drive fixes and coordinate retests within policy SLAs.

  • Tooling & Automation: Build and maintain custom scripts, tooling, and automation to scale offensive testing, and help operationalize continuous/autonomous testing platforms across the environment.

  • Reporting & Communication: Produce clear, decision-ready reports and executive summaries that translate technical findings into risk and business impact for technical stakeholders, GRC/Audit, and executive leadership.

  • Incident Response Support: Support incident response and threat hunting efforts by providing offensive expertise, attack-path context, and adversary insight.

  • Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the maturity of the offensive security program — developing repeatable methodologies, playbooks, and metrics that demonstrate progress over time.

What You Will Need to be Successful:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in offensive security, penetration testing, red teaming, or a closely related security engineering role.

  • Demonstrated expertise across multiple domains: web/mobile application, API, network, infrastructure, and cloud (AWS and/or Azure) penetration testing.

  • Strong understanding of exploitation and post-exploitation techniques, attack-path chaining, and objective-based adversary emulation.

  • Proficiency with industry-standard offensive tooling such as Burp Suite Professional, Nmap, Metasploit, and Kali Linux, along with vulnerability scanners.

  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (e.g., Python, Go, PowerShell, Ruby, or Bash) to build custom tools and automation.

  • Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and hands-on experience mapping engagements to adversary TTPs.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings to both technical audiences and executive leadership.

What You May Need to be Successful:

  • Advanced offensive certifications (e.g., OSEP, OSCE³, CRTO, GXPN) and a track record of original security research, CVEs, or responsible disclosures.

  • Experience with cloud-native attack techniques and container/Kubernetes (EKS/AKS) and serverless security testing.

  • Experience operating or evaluating continuous/autonomous pen testing and breach-and-attack-simulation platforms.

  • Familiarity with detection engineering, SIEM/EDR platforms, and building purple team feedback loops into SOC content.

  • Knowledge of compliance and security frameworks relevant to our environment.

  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and helping mature an offensive security program.

Why Join Us at First Advantage?

At First Advantage, team members are united around a noble purpose: helping organizations to safeguard their workplaces and manage risk. The company’s culture is shaped by its core values — Authenticity, Curiosity, Integrity, Teamwork, Customer-Inspired — empowering team members to bring their best ideas forward, collaborate across departments, and make a real impact.

About the role

The VP, IT & Cybersecurity owns Tidal Financial Group’s enterprise IT and cybersecurity strategy, operating model, and execution. This leader is accountable for the company’s technology reliability, security posture, operational resilience, and IT service experience—establishing departmental direction and advising executive leadership on technology risk, investment priorities, and business-enablement opportunities.

What you'll do

People leadership & operating cadence

  • Lead, coach, and develop the IT and Cyber teams; set clear goals, expectations, and performance standards.
  • Design and evolve the IT and Cybersecurity organization as Tidal scales, including workforce planning, leadership development, succession planning, and appropriate use of strategic partners.
  • Establish clear decision rights and accountability across managers, internal teams, MSPs, and MSSPs, reducing dependency on SVP involvement in routine operations.
  • Establish a weekly operating rhythm (intake, prioritization, escalations, metrics review, and leadership updates).
  • Build a culture of customer service, documentation, ownership, and continuous improvement.

IT service delivery & reliability

  • Own IT service management processes: ticket triage, SLAs, escalation paths, and end-user communications.
  • Ensure stable operation of core business platforms (Microsoft 365, identity, endpoint management, collaboration, file services, key SaaS applications).
  • Drive standardization of onboarding/offboarding, device lifecycle, patching, and asset management.

Cybersecurity strategy, governance, and execution

  • Define and own Tidal’s multi-year cybersecurity strategy, target maturity, control framework, and investment roadmap aligned with company growth and risk objectives.
  • Establish enterprise security policies and standards across endpoint protection, identity and access, monitoring, vulnerability management, data protection, and incident response.
  • Enforce least privilege, RBAC, and zero-trust practices across systems and vendor access.
  • Lead technology and cybersecurity decision-making during material incidents, including executive communication, containment priorities, recovery tradeoffs, and post-incident accountability.
  • Maintain and test incident response runbooks; coordinate tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews.

Risk management, compliance, and audit readiness

  • Maintain evidence and control operation for SOC 2 / vendor due diligence / regulatory expectations (as applicable).
  • Partner with business owners to close control gaps, remediate findings, and track risk exceptions; recommend or approve risk acceptance within defined authority and escalate material risks with clear options and recommendations.
  • Ensure third-party risk processes are followed for new vendors and renewals.

Vendor, MSP/MSSP, and budget management

  • Own the departmental budget, workforce plan, vendor portfolio, and sourcing strategy, balancing security, reliability, service quality, and cost.
  • Manage relationships with key vendors, MSPs, and security service providers; drive accountability on outcomes, deliverables, and SLAs.
  • Lead forecasting, renewal planning, licensing optimization, and procurement in partnership with Operations and Finance.

Department strategy and executive leadership

  • Define and own Tidal’s multi-year IT and Cybersecurity strategy, target operating model, annual priorities, and investment roadmap aligned with company objectives.
  • Make high-impact prioritization and investment decisions across security, reliability, cost, operational risk, and business speed.
  • Advise executive leadership on technology risk, operational resilience, material incidents, investment priorities, and risk-acceptance decisions.
  • Establish enterprise standards and decision frameworks for identity, endpoints, infrastructure, collaboration platforms, security controls, third-party access, and technology lifecycle management.
  • Represent IT and Cybersecurity in executive, audit, board, client, and strategic partner discussions as appropriate.
  • Translate strategic priorities into quarterly operating plans and provide decision-grade reporting on performance, incidents, risks, investments, and roadmap progress.

Metrics of success (examples)

  • Executive alignment on a multi-year IT and cybersecurity strategy, target operating model, and investment roadmap.
  • Measurable reduction in enterprise technology and cybersecurity risk, with timely closure or formal acceptance of material findings.
  • Ticket SLA attainment and CSAT; reduction in repeat/recurring incidents.
  • Endpoint compliance and patch timeliness; MFA/conditional access coverage.
  • Time-to-contain and recover from security incidents; completion of incident response exercises.
  • Resilience and recovery readiness for critical business services.
  • Audit/control evidence completeness, on-time delivery, and quality of audit outcomes.
  • Budget performance, licensing optimization, and measurable vendor value.
  • Stronger leadership bench, succession readiness, and reduced dependency on SVP involvement in day-to-day operations.
  • Documentation coverage for critical systems and processes.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years in IT operations, cybersecurity, infrastructure, identity, or related technology leadership roles with progressively broader scope.
  • 5+ years leading teams and leaders, preferably across both internal teams and strategic service providers.
  • Demonstrated ownership of departmental strategy, budgets, organizational design, executive risk decisions, and material technology or cybersecurity incidents.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft 365/Entra ID, endpoint management (e.g., JumpCloud/Rippling/MDM), identity standards (SSO/SAML/OIDC/SCIM), and SaaS administration.
  • Working knowledge of modern security controls: endpoint protection, vulnerability management, logging/monitoring, IAM governance, and incident response.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly to non-technical stakeholders and executives.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar assurance programs.
  • Familiarity with financial services operational risk and vendor due diligence.
  • Experience managing MSP/MSSP relationships.

raw.description:
Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. A companhia impulsiona a transformação digital de grandes empresas habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis, possibilitando assim que seus clientes ofereçam produtos e experiências digitais a todo o seu ecossistema.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:


Qual a missão do Cargo?

Conduzir a evolução do AI Gateway ao lado de engenharia, UX, comercial e marketing — entendendo as dores de quem está tentando adotar IA com governança, transformando isso em oportunidades priorizadas e garantindo entregas de qualidade e alinhadas aos objetivos. É uma grande oportunidade de construir produto em mercado em formação, com ciclo curto e leitura de evidência constante.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Entender dores, necessidades e anseios de clientes e prospects, e mapear e priorizar oportunidades de evolução do produto conectadas aos objetivos organizacionais.
  • Atuar nos processos de discovery em parceria com UX e engenharia — organizando informação, conduzindo e sintetizando conversas, e transformando evidência em decisão.
  • Escrever especificações de negócio, requisitos e riscos de implementação em forma de histórias, organizadas em um backlog priorizado.
  • Validar as entregas do time de desenvolvimento, ajudando a garantir qualidade e aderência à especificações.
  • Acompanhar métricas de produto — uso, adoção e sucesso das funcionalidades e iniciativas.
  • Cuidar do operacional que mantém o produto rodando bem: solicitações que chegam de outras áreas, comunicados de release e documentação de produto.
  • Gerenciar expectativa e priorização de demandas com as outras áreas: comercial, suporte, marketing, etc.
  • Construir e comunicar o roadmap de produto, incluindo comunicados de atualizações de entrega.
  • Comunicar visão e estratégia do produto para o time de desenvolvimento e para os stakeholders.
  • Apoiar definição de estratégia, objetivos e Key Results, e no go-to-market — incluindo o enablement de Vendas, CS e Suporte nas novidades do produto.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de product discovery.
  • Conhecimento de métodos ágeis e habilidade para criação user stories.
  • Capacidade de levantar requisitos de negócio e organizar backlog.
  • Conforto para navegar tema técnico: APIs, autenticação e autorização, integração. Não é requerido nenhum conhecimento de programação, mas é necessário se sentir confortável para conseguir discutir arquitetura com engenharia.
  • Inglês para leitura e escrita.

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Experiências anteriores ou carreira sólida em engenharia, dados, UX, suporte, CS ou consultoria e quer construir carreira em produto.

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.

  • Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.
    Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)

Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!

  • Pensando em promover times cada vez mais diversos e ambientes de trabalho plurais, nossa missão é mapear os diferentes públicos que alcançamos com ele! Por isso, faremos algumas perguntinhas relacionadas à diversidade*, tudo bem? =)

raw.title: Social Media Content Creator
raw.excerpt: Are you a social-first storyteller who knows how to turn complex concepts into scroll-stopping content?
raw.description:
Are you a social-first storyteller who knows how to turn complex concepts into scroll-stopping content? We are looking for a part-time Social Media Content Creator to own and elevate our brand presence across social media channels, including LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, and Meta (Instagram & Facebook).

In this role, you’ll amplify the voice of our brand across digital channels by owning our end-to-end cross-channel social media presence. You will be responsible for setting strategy, creating content, posting regularly, engaging with our online communities and industry topics in feed, monitoring social engagement, and reporting on performance metrics.

You will maintain a highly active cadence on our primary channels, experiment with new platforms, repurpose core messaging into multi-format assets (video, copy, visuals), and help us bring buzz surrounding major industry events to people onsite and following along online.

The ideal candidate will understand that B2B marketing should still be speaking human-to-human (and doesn’t need to be boring!).

If you are a creative and strategic thinker with a strong track record of creating B2B social content that cuts through the clutter to reach the right target audiences, this is the perfect opportunity for you!

Key Responsibilities

1. Channel management & strategy

  • Own the grid: Manage, schedule, and publish consistent content across LinkedIn, YouTube, Reddit, and Meta.

  • Multi-channel strategy: Define and execute the optimal strategic posting cadence for new or growing channels including YouTube, Reddit, and Meta.

  • Community engagement: Monitor comments, foster industry discussions, and build relationships with our audience.

2. Multi-Format content creation

  • Social-first content: Translate our core messaging into diverse formats, including crisp written posts, eye-catching infographics, static visuals, bite-sized videos (Reels/Shorts), and longer-form video content.

  • Content repurposing: Take long-form content (blogs, whitepapers, webinars) and slice it into highly consumable, platform-native micro-content.

  • Live event coverage: Partner with our on-the-ground teams during major industry events (e.g., Cannes Lions) to provide dynamic real-time content.

  • Design & editing: Light graphic design and video editing to ensure all assets are polished, on-brand, and optimized for their respective platforms.

3. Employee engagement & visibility

  • Employee engagement: Drive internal engagement with company posts (eg likes, comments, reshares)

  • Personal branding: In B2B, a huge portion of social reach now happens through individual employee profiles rather than just the company page. Support ongoing team initiatives to encourage Cinters to build personal brands and provide their unique industry POVs on LinkedIn.

  • A proven track record of managing social media specifically for B2B companies.

  • An understanding of algorithmic best practices for LinkedIn, YouTube, and Meta, as well as the unique cultural nuances/unwritten rules of Reddit.

  • Experience with creator tools (e.g., Canva, Figma, Adobe Premiere, CapCut) to quickly spin up visuals and edit engaging short-form video.

  • Familiarity with social media analytics platforms and reporting tools.

  • Excellent time management skills with the ability to self-start, manage a content calendar, and hit daily deadlines.

  • A customer-centric approach to content creation.

  • Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with an eye for detail, tone, and accuracy.

  • A proactive and collaborative mindset – you're curious, creative, and enthusiastic to share ideas and ask questions.

  • Preferred: Potential willingness to be on camera, do voice overs, or appear in social content.

  • Preferred: Knowledge of the ResTech and/or AdTech industries

This is a part-time position of approximately 20 hours per week. The anticipated hourly pay range for this role will be between $33.65 to $43.27 per hour.

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)

Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

Cint is the technology foundation for continuous research and measurement. With a global footprint and programmatic access to hundreds of millions of consumers across 130+ countries, Cint connects researchers, advertisers, and brands to reliable data from the world’s largest network of high-quality sources. Researchers can collect human and advanced data at speed. Advertisers and their partners can measure campaign effectiveness at scale. Brands can move from insight to action with clarity. By operating the connective layer between asking questions and measuring advertising outcomes, Cint enables organizations to move faster and make confident business decisions.

At Cint, we’re feeding the world’s curiosity.

This is a full-time remote position for a marketing professional with extensive experience in international launches, digital strategy, and content-driven growth who can drive measurable results and scale IMCPs global presence.

About the company

The Institute of Metacognitive Programming delivers training and certification in Metacognitive Programming, a coaching and leadership methodology designed to shift internal thought-emotional patterns and enable sustainable personal and professional transformation. IMCPs vision is to scale this methodology globally, helping professionals, coaches, and leaders achieve meaningful change through approaches grounded in psychology, neuroscience, and philosophy.
As IMCP expands its online programs—including courses, certifications, group coaching, and subscriptions—strategic marketing and high-performing campaigns are critical for audience engagement, conversion, and long-term growth in international markets.

  • Achieve SQL (Sales Qualified Leads) targets through targeted marketing initiatives.
  • Manage relationships with contractors, agencies, and external partners.
  • Provide weekly and monthly reporting with clear insights on performance and results.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a similar marketing role.
  • Proven success promoting educational projects—experience with author-led programs is a strong advantage—in European and U.S. markets.
  • Demonstrated experience launching marketing campaigns or programs in new markets.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills: ability to create detailed plans, manage schedules, budgets, and prioritize effectively.
  • Analytical mindset: ability to structure and process qualitative and quantitative data and draw actionable conclusions.
  • Team leadership and collaboration skills: ability to inspire and coordinate cross-functional teams.

raw.description:
ABOUT US

At the heart of AG1 lies a commitment to our mission to empower people to take ownership of their health. Since 2010, we've dedicated ourselves to bringing Foundational Nutrition to people around the world.

Our ethos is deeply rooted in science, with an unwavering dedication to continuous improvement. We leverage and contribute to the latest research to deliver a powerful, straightforward solution for optimal health to our customers. We harness the finest ingredients so that every scoop of AG1 gives you the nutrients you need with the simplicity you want in a daily routine.

Likewise, our organization puts the same energy into creating an environment that is a reflection of the cultural values that define who we are and how we work together. These seven values— One Spectacular Life, Customer Obsessed, Radical Ownership, High Performance, Courage, Amazing Humans and Continuous Pursuit of Excellence —are a representation of the high standards we set, and hold ourselves accountable to, when it comes to building our global team.


THE ROLE

The Senior Manager, Motion Designer owns motion design as a discipline across the European region — shaping the strategy, standards, and systems that guide how motion shows up across every campaign, while remaining deeply hands-on in creating the work itself. This person is the go-to expert for all things motion: setting standards, mentoring other creatives, and ensuring every video we ship is built with a YouTube-first mindset while performing across Meta and other channels.

This role connects day-to-day motion decisions to broader marketing objectives and influences creative direction beyond their own assigned projects. They're the final expert voice on all things motion — from concept through final cut — mentoring other creatives, setting the bar for quality, and ensuring every video we ship is built with a YouTube-first mindset while performing across Meta and other channels. This role requires native or fluent German language skills, along with excellent written and verbal English communication.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Motion Design Testing, Creating & Iterating

  • Create, animate, and edit motion graphics and video content for upper- and mid-funnel campaigns — from first cut through final polish — based on creative strategy briefs (all videos adapted for YouTube and Meta)
  • Juggle multiple high-volume projects simultaneously against tight, fast-moving turnaround times without sacrificing quality
  • Support ideation for YouTube-first concepts based on inspiration and overall creative strategy
  • Identify testing opportunities within the motion-design space and improve creative testing velocity and ad iteration speed

Data-Driven Insights

  • Actively use YouTube metrics and HighRise reporting to inform hands-on creative decisions and revisions
  • Evaluate and implement new tools and workflows to improve efficiency, including hands-on development of AI-assisted animation processes
  • Surface insights from performance data to directly inform and refine creative output

Creative Leadership

  • Serve as the final expert voice on motion-design decisions, providing feedback on others' work
  • Manage relationships with agencies and freelancers, providing direct oversight and feedback ensuring results are delivered with speed and with the utmost quality
  • Manage and mentor junior team members
  • Build reusable systems and templates that speed up production and reduce costs
  • Act as the brand and quality guardian for all things motion design — reviewing, editing, and elevating every asset that ships

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5-7+ years of hands-on motion design and video editing experience, with a strong reel demonstrating end-to-end craft — from concept through final cut
  • Proven ability to juggle multiple high-volume projects simultaneously against tight, fast-moving deadlines without sacrificing quality
  • Expert-level proficiency in motion design and editing tools (e.g., After Effects, Premiere, or comparable software)
  • Deep experience creating YouTube-first video content, with working knowledge of adapting assets for Meta
  • Comfort using performance data (YouTube metrics, HighRise or comparable reporting tools) to inform and iterate on creative decisions in real time
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI-assisted animation tools and workflows, and genuine interest in evolving how motion work gets made
  • Native or fluent German speaker (required) with excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong understanding of the German-speaking market, including cultural trends, consumer behavior, and localization best practices
  • Experience managing or mentoring junior designers, freelancers, or agency partners — while still staying hands-on in the work yourself
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple creative projects simultaneously with fast turnaround times
  • Experience localizing creative assets by adapting copy, pacing, messaging, and cultural nuance while maintaining brand consistency
  • Experience in DTC, subscription, or health and wellness brands is a plus

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • Competitive compensation and performance-based incentive plans.
  • A 100% remote working environment (excluding Laboratory positions), which has been implemented from day one.
  • A strong company culture that is enforced through the hiring process to ensure values alignment and a highly collaborative team.
  • A mission-driven approach to everything that we do, with an overall goal to significantly improve our customers’ health and wellness.
  • A high-growth, dynamic environment with opportunities for your direct impact to be felt.
  • Paid holidays, company-wide reset and reflect days, and unlimited PTO (based on your country of residence).
  • In-person team meetups for optimal collaboration, team building and accelerating productivity.
  • A work environment and culture that is based on high performance, productivity and continuous improvement.
  • The opportunity to work with passionate, high-growth, business-minded colleagues who bring their all to our mission each and every day.
  • Access to AG1 products and branded swag.
  • Monthly telecom stipend to offset some of the costs of home internet/wifi for eligible team members.
  • All other benefits and insurances as required by law, based on your specific country of residence.

AG1 is dedicated to providing equitable and competitive compensation & benefits packages. For this particular role, the base salary range is €77,000.00 - €95,000.00 and will ultimately be decided at the offer stage, based on an individual candidate’s level of skills and experience aligned with the needs of this role. Base salary is one component of total compensation for this position. We provide a competitive mix of base salary, performance bonus, and stock option allocation for eligible roles.

AG1 is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to inspiring fulfilling lives, starting with a focus on health and we believe this starts in the workplace. We do this by providing employees with a safe and welcoming work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strive to create a diverse & inclusive environment where all team members can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and make a difference in the world together. VRIFY is positioned at the forefront of the mining industry's transformation, leveraging cutting-edge AI to revolutionize mineral exploration. With a focus on AI drill targeting, VRIFY is expanding its capabilities by synthesizing vast amounts of geological information. This integration enhances the precision and efficiency of exploration strategies, offering our clients innovative solutions that depart from traditional methods.

Our mission extends beyond technological advancement. We are committed to transforming how mining companies engage with investors, aiming to foster a more transparent and accountable mining investment ecosystem. VRIFY's technology enables immersive 3D and 360° presentations that provide investors with a vivid and detailed visual context, making complex geological data accessible and engaging.

As we continue to refine our AI-driven solutions, VRIFY remains dedicated to driving innovation and excellence in the mining sector, ensuring our clients and investors are well-equipped to succeed in a rapidly evolving market.

About the Role

We're looking for a technically sharp co-op student who loves turning ambiguous problems into working software, fast. You'll split your time between quick-turnaround workarounds that unblock business operations and longer-horizon product prototypes that explore what we could build next.

What You'll Work On

Quick technical workarounds: Build fast, AI-assisted solutions to immediate business problems. Scrappy and shipped.

Product prototypes: Larger exploratory builds, taking ideas from concept to something tangible.

Variety: No two weeks will look the same across tools, tasks, and problem types.

Who You'll Work With

You'll collaborate directly with our Product Advisor and our COO.

Who We're Looking For
