Pantheon’s WebOps Platform powers more than 300,000 websites for organizations including Google, Princeton, Salesloft, and Doctors Without Borders. Our platform helps developers and marketers build, manage, and scale WordPress and Drupal websites faster.

The Role

Our BDRs create the first meaningful connection between Pantheon and future customers. You’ll research priority accounts, find the right people, understand their business challenges,
and create qualified pipeline for our Account Executive team.

This is not a generic, high-volume outreach role. It’s a research-led, account-based role for someone who can turn insight into relevant conversations. You’ll use phone, email, social selling, referrals, and events to reach decision-makers and build relationships across strategic accounts.

What You Need to Succeed

  • Own a portfolio of target accounts and prioritize where to focus.
  • Research companies, technologies, organizational changes, business priorities, and buying signals.
  • Map stakeholders and multi-thread conversations across strategic accounts.
  • Write and deliver concise, personalized outreach across multiple channels.
  • Cold call prospects and lead initial qualification and discovery conversations.
  • Understand priorities, pain points, urgency, stakeholders, and fit.
  • Partner with Account Executives on account plans, qualification, handoffs, and next steps.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on campaigns, messaging, content, and account insights.
  • Keep Salesforce and account intelligence accurate and actionable.
  • Test, learn, and improve your approach based on conversion and pipeline data.

How AI Fits into the Work

AI is part of our modern BDR workflow. You’ll use approved tools to:

  • Summarize account research and surface relevant signals.
  • Prioritize accounts and contacts.
  • Create first-pass account briefs, messaging angles, and call preparation.
  • Analyze engagement, conversion, and pipeline progression.
  • Improve team playbooks and repeatable workflows.

AI supports your judgment—it does not replace it. You’ll verify facts, edit every message, protect confidential information, follow Pantheon policies, and never send unreviewed AI-generated outreach.

How We Measure Success

Activity matters, but quality matters more. We look at:

  • Qualified pipeline sourced and accepted by Sales.
  • Conversion from outreach to meaningful conversations and opportunities.
  • Account engagement and multi-threading.
  • Opportunity quality and progression after handoff.
  • Research quality, messaging relevance, CRM hygiene, and follow-through.
  • Consistent achievement of agreed goals.

What You Bring to the Table

  • 12+ months of experience in sales development, business development, outbound prospecting, or a related sales role.
  • A track record of holding your role, managing goals, and improving performance.
  • Strong account research, writing, phone, and social-selling skills.
  • Curiosity about technology and how digital teams work.
  • An analytical, coachable, resourceful approach.
  • Strong organization across multiple accounts and stakeholders.
  • Comfort using AI and sales technology thoughtfully and responsibly.
  • A collaborative mindset and genuine interest in building a long-term GTM career.

You’ll Stand Out If You Have

  • SaaS, WebOps, digital experience, MarTech, cloud, or enterprise sales experience.
  • Experience with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Gong, Nooks, or similar tools.
  • Experience with ABM, strategic prospecting, multi-threading, or enterprise sales.
  • Experience using AI to improve research, writing, analysis, or workflow design.

Growth at Pantheon

We build durable skills, not just activity metrics. You’ll receive coaching, training, sales technology, and feedback on your research, messaging, conversations, and pipeline outcomes. Strong performance can create opportunities in Senior BDR, Account Executive, Account-Based Marketing, Revenue Operations, and other GTM roles. Progression is based on demonstrated capability, sustained performance, and business needs.

What We Offer

We have all the usual perks and benefits but what we can really offer you is a fantastic work environment powered by an amazing team.

  • Industry-competitive compensation and equity.
  • Flexible time off, sick days, and 13 paid holidays.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  • Paid parental leave and family-planning benefits.
  • In-office workspace where available.
  • Wellness and reading allowance, plus LinkedIn Learning.
  • Team and company-wide events

Location and Compensation

The base salary for this position is:
  • US- SF/NY: $62,300 – $77,900 base (OTE $89,000 – $111,286)
  • US- all other states: $56,000 – $70,000 base (OTE $80,000 – $100,000)
  • CAN- CAD$51,400 – CAD$64,300 base (OTE CAD$73,429 – CAD$91,857)

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including role scope, relevant experience, and geographic location.

raw.description:
We're looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to own and scale paid media across Amazon, Walmart, Meta, TikTok, Google, and additional marketplace and retail media channels for a fast-growing clean-label snack brand. You will manage campaigns end to end, optimize for profitability rather than vanity metrics, and work directly with leadership to drive efficient, scalable growth across every channel.

This is not a brand awareness role. We are looking for someone who understands performance marketing at a deep level — contribution margin, TACOS, marketplace algorithms, and how to profitably scale a consumable CPG brand across multiple channels simultaneously. If you are highly analytical, execution-focused, and take genuine ownership of campaign performance and business outcomes, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Own the full paid media function for a growing CPG brand with real retail traction across major marketplaces and retail chains
  • High-ownership performance marketing role with direct impact on revenue and profitability

What You'll Work On

Marketplace and Paid Media Management

  • Manage and optimize Amazon PPC campaigns across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and DSP
  • Manage Walmart Connect campaigns and improve performance
  • Launch, manage, and optimize Meta advertising campaigns across Facebook and Instagram
  • Launch, test, and optimize TikTok Shop and TikTok Ads campaigns
  • Manage Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, YouTube, and Performance Max
  • Manage Reddit advertising campaigns and identify relevant community targeting opportunities
  • Support Instacart Ads and other retail media initiatives
  • Help drive growth and visibility on Faire and other marketplace channels

Performance Optimization

  • Improve TACOS, ROAS, contribution margin, and overall campaign profitability
  • Conduct keyword research, bid optimization, audience targeting, and campaign restructuring
  • Continuously test creative, audiences, landing pages, and promotional strategies
  • Identify scaling opportunities while maintaining efficiency targets
  • Monitor inventory levels and adjust advertising spend accordingly
  • Analyze customer acquisition costs, repeat purchase behavior, and LTV

Reporting and Analytics

  • Build and maintain weekly performance dashboards across all channels
  • Report on channel performance, trends, and growth opportunities with clear, actionable recommendations
  • Analyze competitive activity and marketplace trends
  • Interpret data quickly and make fast decisions based on performance signals

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with leadership, operations, and creative teams
  • Coordinate product launches and promotional campaigns across channels
  • Help improve product listings and conversion rates
  • Support marketplace expansion opportunities as the brand grows

What You Bring

  • 3 or more years managing performance marketing for e-commerce or CPG brands
  • Deep, hands-on Amazon PPC experience across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and DSP
  • Experience managing Walmart Connect campaigns
  • Experience managing Meta Ads across Facebook and Instagram
  • Experience managing Google Ads and YouTube campaigns
  • Experience scaling TikTok Shop or TikTok Ads
  • Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel and Google Sheets proficiency
  • Ability to interpret performance data and make fast, confident decisions
  • Experience managing advertising budgets profitably with a clear understanding of contribution margin and efficiency targets
  • Strong ownership mentality with the ability to execute quickly in a lean, entrepreneurial environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Reddit Ads and community-driven marketing
  • Experience with Instacart Ads or retail media networks
  • Background in food, beverage, or snack brand marketing
  • Experience working with Shopify brands
  • Familiarity with tools such as Helium 10, Data Dive, Pacvue, Perpetua, Quartile, Triple Whale, or similar platforms
  • Understanding of retail velocity and omnichannel strategy
  • Experience with creative testing and landing page optimization

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your performance marketing experience across Amazon and paid social, and walking through a specific campaign or channel you scaled profitably and how you approached the optimization

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a data-driven performance marketer who understands profitability and contribution margin, can manage campaigns across multiple channels simultaneously, and want to own paid media for a growing CPG brand with real commercial momentum, this role gives you the ownership and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures.   • Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
  • Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.

  • Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.

Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. raw.description:
Founded in 1954, North American Properties (NAP) is a privately held, multi-regional real estate operating company with a long history of acquiring, developing, and managing retail, multifamily, mixed-use, and office properties across the United States. NAP Development LLC is a venture office of NAP focused on providing Commercial Real Estate Owner’s Representative services. The team operates in a fully remote environment.
The Office and Project Administrator serves as the operational backbone of NAP Development LLC. This is first and foremost a broad administrative role, with approximately 75% of the position focused on keeping the day-to-day operations of the office organized, responsive, and running smoothly. Responsibilities include managing correspondence and records, coordinating with vendors and consultants, preparing and routing contracts and other documents, providing notary services, and supporting scheduling and documentation needs across a distributed team.
The remaining 25% of the role provides project administration support, working closely with Project Managers and Partners to help maintain budget tracking, coordinate invoicing, and keep pay application and related project workflows moving accurately and on schedule.
This role is well suited for someone who enjoys taking ownership of the systems and details that keep a small, fast-moving organization operating effectively. The ideal candidate is highly organized, resourceful, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and naturally becomes the person others rely on when they need to find something, coordinate something, send something, or get something signed.

Contributions you will make to our team

General Office Administration
Correspondence and Communications
· Retrieve, sort, digitize, and route all mail received through the office PO Box, ensuring time-sensitive items are directed to the appropriate team member promptly.
· Coordinate internal and external meetings across calendars, time zones, and project locations.
· Arrange business travel and prepare or process expense reports as needed.
· Assist with bank reconciliation and account documentation under management oversight.
Notary Services· Provide notary services for company documents, contracts, closing packages, lien-related documents, and other business needs.
· Provide mobile/remote online notarization when signers are offsite, with associated costs covered by the Company.
· Maintain required notary records and journals and ensure the notary commission remains current and in good standing.
Records and Document Management
· Own and maintain the Company’s digital filing structure, including naming conventions, folder hierarchy, version control, and access permissions.
· Maintain organized and complete project files, including contracts, change orders, certificates of insurance, permits, correspondence, and closeout documentation.
· Track document expiration dates, including COIs, licenses, W-9s, and permits, and proactively coordinate renewals.
· Implement and maintain appropriate records retention practices across entities and projects.
Vendor and Consultant Coordination
· Collect and verify vendor and consultant onboarding documentation, including W-9s, certificates of insurance, licenses, and other required compliance materials.
· Coordinate new vendor setup with the accounting team.
· Maintain an accurate and current vendor and consultant directory.
· Serve as an administrative point of contact for vendors and consultants as needed.
General Office Operations
· Manage software subscriptions, licenses, and user access for the team.
· Coordinate office, technology, and field supply needs.
· Support administrative and logistical aspects of onboarding new team members.
· Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, systems, templates, and workflows.
Project Administration Support
Contracts and Subcontracts
· Prepare draft contracts, subcontracts, and related documents using approved Company templates.
· Coordinate agreements through review, signature, and execution and track status through completion.
· Maintain the executed contract repository and monitor renewal, expiration, and other key dates.
· Assist with preparing and organizing exhibits, riders, change orders, and supporting documentation.
Budget and Cost Tracking
· Work with Project Managers to maintain current project budget trackers and cost reports.
· Assist with organizing supporting financial documentation and identifying outstanding or incomplete information.
· Help ensure project-related financial records remain current and consistent with approved budgets.
Payments and Reconciliation
· Process approved payments to vendors and other third parties in accordance with Company procedures.
· Coordinate with Project Managers, onsite staff, subcontractors, vendors, accounting personnel, and other external parties to resolve accounts payable and accounts receivable questions.
· All other responsibilities as assigned.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

· 1–3 years of experience in an administrative, project coordination, office management, or similar role; commercial real estate, construction, development, or property management experience is preferred.
· Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and changing priorities simultaneously.
· Demonstrated ability to take initiative, assume ownership of responsibilities, and work independently with limited day-to-day supervision.
· Strong written and verbal communication skills with a professional, responsive, and relationship-oriented approach.
· Comfortable working in a fully remote environment while maintaining a consistent and dependable work schedule.
· Strong judgment and discretion when handling confidential company, financial, contractual, and personnel information.
· Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel, as well as Adobe Acrobat.
· Ability and willingness to learn and effectively use project management, document management, accounting, and other Company systems.
· Current notary commission preferred; willingness and ability to obtain and maintain a notary commission, including remote online notarization capabilities, may be required.
· Resourceful and solutions-oriented, with an interest in continuously improving administrative processes and workflows.

What You’ll Get In Return

At North American, we live our values of Relationships, Ownership, Agility, Strength and Stability, Courage and Creativity, Empowerment and Integrity. North American and its portfolio companies invest first in people, recognizing that our people are our greatest assets. Full-Time associates will receive a competitive compensation package based on the candidate’s experience, they will receive a best-in-class benefit package, and opportunities for continuing professional development.

raw.title: Media Buyer & Creative Strategist
raw.excerpt: We're looking for a Media Buyer & Creative Strategist who knows that great advertising is about more than pushing buttons in Ads Manager.
raw.description:
We're looking for a Media Buyer & Creative Strategist who knows that great advertising is about more than pushing buttons in Ads Manager. You understand the relationship between creative, data, audiences, and performance—and you know how to turn those insights into campaigns that drive sales.

The Role
As our Media Buyer & Creative Strategist, you'll own the strategy, execution, and optimization of paid advertising while also helping shape the creative direction behind our ads.
You'll analyze what's working, identify why it's working, develop new creative concepts to test, and work closely with our creative team, content creators, and other marketing partners to turn those ideas into high-performing ads.
We're looking for someone who is data-driven, creative, curious, and obsessed with finding what makes customers click—and buy.

What You'll Do
Media Buying & Campaign Management
  • Manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
  • Own campaign setup, targeting, budgets, bidding, pacing, and optimization.
  • Monitor key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM, CVR, and spend.
  • Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns and quickly address underperforming campaigns.
  • Conduct audience, placement, offer, product, and campaign structure testing.
  • Manage daily and weekly budget pacing to ensure spend aligns with revenue and profitability goals.
  • Stay current on platform updates, advertising trends, and emerging paid media opportunities.
Creative Strategy
  • Develop the creative strategy behind paid advertising campaigns.
  • Identify high-performing hooks, messaging, product benefits, offers, formats, and angles.
  • Analyze winning and losing creatives to understand why they performed.
  • Turn performance data into clear, actionable creative briefs.
  • Partner with graphic designers, video editors, content creators, and UGC creators to develop new ad concepts.
  • Build a consistent pipeline of fresh creative concepts and testing opportunities.
  • Help determine what types of content, messaging, and storytelling will resonate with different audiences.
  • Stay on top of trends in UGC, short-form video, social media, and performance creative.
Testing & Optimization
  • Develop and manage a structured creative testing strategy.
  • Test hooks, headlines, thumbnails, messaging, CTAs, offers, formats, products, and audiences.
  • Establish performance benchmarks and identify winning creative quickly.
  • Scale winning concepts across campaigns and platforms.
  • Continuously refresh creative to combat ad fatigue.
  • Use performance insights to influence future creative strategy.
Analytics & Reporting
  • Monitor campaign performance and identify trends, opportunities, and problems.
  • Analyze performance by campaign, audience, product, creative, and funnel stage.
  • Create regular performance reports and clearly communicate key takeaways.
  • Turn data into actionable recommendations—not just reports.
  • Work with the broader marketing team to identify opportunities to improve the customer journey from ad click through purchase.
  • Help develop a deeper understanding of what drives customer acquisition and conversion.
You'd Be a Great Fit If...

You don't just look at an ad and ask "Did it work?"

You ask:
"Why did it work?"
"Who did it work for?"
"What should we test next?"
"How do we turn this into 10 more winning ads?"

You're equally comfortable looking at a spreadsheet of performance data and brainstorming a killer hook for a new TikTok ad.

You don't wait for someone to tell you what to test. You're constantly looking for the next opportunity to improve performance.

raw.title: Director of Engineering, AI
raw.excerpt: DescriptionSprout Social is looking to hire a Director, Engineering - Artificial Intelligence to join our engineering team.
raw.description:
Description

Sprout Social is looking to hire a Director, Engineering - Artificial Intelligence to join our engineering team. This leader will report to the Senior Vice President, Engineering. The key focus of this role is to help build and execute our platform-wide AI strategy. As a member of Sprout’s Engineering leadership team, this leader will also facilitate strong collaboration across the engineering, product management and product design organizations.

Why join Sprout’s Engineering team?

Sprout empowers businesses worldwide to harness the immense power and opportunity of social media in today’s digital-first world. Processing over one billion social messages daily, our platform serves up essential insights and actionable information to over 30,000 brands, informing strategic decisions that drive business growth and innovation, and fostering deeper, authentic connections to their end customers. Our full suite of social media management solutions includes comprehensive publishing and engagement functionality, customer care solutions, influencer marketing, connected workflows, and business intelligence. We're actively working to intuitively weave AI throughout our products, enabling organizations to work smarter, unleash their creativity, and maximize the business impact of social media–that’s where you come in!

With collaborative, cross-functional teams spanning front-end, back-end, applied science, and ML Ops, our team is a place to sharpen your craft and solve hard problems alongside some of the smartest people in the industry. As a Director of Engineering, you’ll operate at “tech-giant” scale, leading engineers and technical leaders while partnering closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and other teams to shape strategy and deliver against a shared roadmap. You’ll provide leadership across architecture, system design, engineering execution, and talent development, while helping define how our products, platforms, and services interconnect and scale. You’ll also join an empathetic Engineering Leadership team committed to helping each other grow, raising the bar for engineering excellence, and supporting our teams in delivering world-class products.

What you’ll do

  • As a Director, you will be a key member of the AI leadership team and be responsible for building high-functioning teams of applied AI/ML scientists and engineers and steering them to iteratively deliver quality results.
  • You’ll lead the engineering team building foundational AI/ML products that will be used across our entire product suite and customer base.
  • You will partner closely with the VP, Engineering and your leaders to chart the strategic growth of the current team, defining and building new teams and helping to steer architecture and product direction.
  • Relying on your experience in building and maintaining highly scalable, reliable, distributed AI products and leading applied science teams, you'll lead teams to iteratively deliver quality software.
  • You will guide the team through complicated product and technical roadmaps, and partner with product management and design to align on the strategy for your teams and support its execution.
  • You’ll grow your team of engineers and applied scientists by example with effective feedback, coaching, and career development.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a collaborative, pragmatic, highly motivating Engineering leader to help our AI team succeed and invest in the right capabilities to improve our customer experience and impact through AI and machine learning. If you confidently lead teams to solve hard problems, push them to learn from and teach each other, and work across functions and teams to get your teams to deliver, we'd love to talk with you!

The minimum qualifications for this role include:

  • 7+ years of experience building and supporting products in a production environment
  • 7+ years in software development, including several years leading teams and managing through leaders, with a track record of building sustainable, high-performing team structure.
  • Experience leading engineering teams building AI/ML or agentic products, including partnering with or leading applied scientists and AI/ML engineers.
  • Recent, direct experience (typically the last 2-3 years) leading or closely driving the development of modern AI products, agentic or LLM-based systems, evaluation and quality, built on foundation models. We care more about the depth and recency of your AI-product experience than the number of years.

Preferred qualifications for this role include:

  • Direct experience leading a mixed team of applied scientists and AI/ML engineers, and an understanding of how to lead research-inflected work, evaluation, model judgment, and quality, alongside product engineering.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and scaling high-performance teams through hiring and coaching of engineering leaders, applied scientists, and AI/ML engineers
  • Experience at a SaaS or product company that made a meaningful AI pivot or shift in product direction.
  • Experience aligning a team's focus and vision towards the most impactful work across a complex product suite to meet the needs of a diverse, global customer base
  • Track record of influencing and aligning stakeholders across different points of view or functions, to drive successful outcomes
  • Experience developing enterprise-level distributed applications using Python, Java, distributed queuing systems, etc.
  • Experience developing systems to deploy, manage, evaluate, and serve machine learning models and agentic products at scale
  • Experience with generative AI, including open source and third party solutions (e.g., OpenAI)

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Experiencing Sprout’s in-depth onboarding, covering everything from our company mission and values, hearing directly from executives and founders, to deep training on our products and the value that Sprout delivers to our customers
  • Learning the current state of AI and machine learning at Sprout and future product and technical roadmaps
  • Meeting your team in 1:1s to understand what’s working, what’s not, and gathering learnings to implement into your role
  • Establishing relationships with other engineering, product and design leaders and identify areas of opportunity

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Participating in architectural discussions and decisions, bringing an informed industry perspective to ask the right questions and guide your team toward successful outcomes
  • Assuming management of the AI team's engineering leaders. Meeting with them regularly and providing them with direct, constructive feedback on their work, as well as formulating career growth plans
  • Participating in quarterly planning and roadmap processes and helping your team shape the technical roadmap for long-term success
  • Getting acclimated to the hiring process and partner with your leaders to establish a staffing plan and process for the teams
  • Helping your team and leaders improve processes and team rituals
  • Building relationships with our infrastructure, product, go to market, legal, and support teams and identify ways your teams can be more proactive and effective.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Guiding and proactively evaluating your team’s execution on a major feature launch.
  • Understanding the business goals and helping the team proactively focus on the right problems while balancing technical debt, bugs, and product features with measurable results
  • Leading the performance review and career band calibration process for your team and coach your leaders through performance conversations with their direct reports
  • Partnering with the VP, Engineering, product and design teams to evangelize our AI and ML technical and product vision with internal and external stakeholders
  • Becoming an expert in our approach to AI and to confidently speak to ever-changing trends, new product features and platform enhancements to internal and external stakeholders

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Continue to develop your team, both personally and professionally, and having development plans in place for your team to hold them accountable
  • Serving as Sprout's bridge to the broader AI/ML industry by staying current on emerging trends and technologies and proactively bringing that outside perspective into the team's strategy and roadmap
  • Being recognized as a subject matter expert and leader in artificial intelligence and machine learning at Sprout
  • Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change our AI capabilities in Sprout in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.
  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
  • Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.
  • Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Whenever possible, Sprout wants to provide our team with the flexibility to work in the location that makes the most sense for them. Sprout maintains a remote workforce in many places in the United States. However, we are not set up in all states, so please look at the drop-down box in our application to see whether your state is listed. Few roles require an office setting. If your position requires a physical presence in a Sprout office, it will be evident in the job listing and your offer letter.

Our salary ranges reflect the expected earning potential for this role. Individual pay is based on geographic zone, relevant experience, and skills.

Our current hiring range for this role: $263,900 – $319,000 annually. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact.

We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth potential available as you progress in your role.

We have two geographic pay zones in the United States:

Zone 1 (New York, California, Washington): $290,300 – $435,500

Zone 2 (All other US states): $263,900 – $395,900

These ranges were determined by a market-based compensation approach; we used data from trusted third-party compensation sources to set equitable, consistent, and competitive ranges. We also evaluate compensation bi-annually, identify any changes in the market and make adjustments to our ranges and existing employee compensation as needed.

Because Sprout Social is a federal contractor, we affirmatively recruit individuals with a disability and protected veterans. raw.description:
About us

Founded in 1996, Argos Multilingual is a global provider of technology-enabled language, AI and data solutions. We combine human expertise, technology and AI to help organisations communicate, operate and grow across markets.

We work with some of the world’s most recognised companies, from global technology leaders and e-commerce innovators to major organisations in life sciences and manufacturing.

We are an international organisation with 400+ people across 42 countries. We continue to expand our capabilities in AI and data alongside our established language and localisation expertise, building on a strong foundation while embracing the opportunities created by new technology.

About the role

As an HR Generalist, you'll play a key role in delivering a high-quality HR experience across our global organisation. Our People team is a respected and valued strategic partner to the business. Our role is to enable performance across the organisation and create an environment where our people can thrive.

This is an individual contributor role with significant autonomy. You'll deliver day-to-day HR support across the full employee lifecycle, provide trusted advice to managers and employees, support recruitment and bring your experience and judgement to more complex people

matters.

Our workforce currently spans 42 countries, so you'll be comfortable navigating different employment environments, cultures and ways of working. You'll help us deliver effective HR across a complex global organisation, while bringing your experience and judgement to how we evolve the function.

You'll be joining at a time when Argos is continuing to grow and evolve. As we expand our data business and embrace new opportunities through AI, we're also evolving our People function to ensure our HR approach keeps pace with the needs of the business.

We're looking for an experienced HR professional who can operate with autonomy and make an immediate contribution. You'll bring demonstrable experience at this level, sound judgement and the confidence to handle complex people matters independently. We value people who are curious, challenge the status quo and want to improve how HR is delivered. You'll have the opportunity to use your experience to make a visible impact and help shape how the People function evolves.

You'll report directly to the Senior Vice President (Head of HR), becoming the sixth member of our People team.

What you'll do

HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle

  • Support the full lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding.
  • Act as trusted first point of contact for managers and employees.
  • Keep HR processes, records and HRIS data accurate and compliant.
  • Support payroll, benefits and external providers.
  • Manage HR documentation, contracts and employee communications.

Recruitment

  • Run end-to-end recruitment for agreed roles, from briefing and advertising to offer.
  • Partner with hiring managers on requirements, selection and decisions.
  • Manage sourcing, pipelines and candidate experience.
  • Work with external partners where specialist expertise is needed.
  • Improve recruitment processes with technology and AI.

Employee Relations

  • Provide practical advice on performance, absence, conduct and other matters.
  • Independently handle complex Employee Relations cases including disciplinary, grievance, absence, performance and workplace investigations.
  • Ensure decisions are fair, consistent, policy-aligned and compliant.
  • Know when to seek local or specialist advice and escalate appropriately.

Performance, Policies & Continuous Improvement

  • Support performance management, development and employee experience initiatives with the HR Business Partner and L&D team.
  • Help develop and implement HR policies that reflect applicable employment requirements.
  • Work effectively across our locations, drawing on local expertise.
  • Simplify and automate HR processes and contribute to our evolving use of HR technology and AI.
  • Contribute to projects that improve employee experience, efficiency and scalability.

Who you are

Solutions-driven, self-directed and comfortable with autonomy, collaborative, pragmatic in balancing business needs with good HR practice, and curious about how AI and technology can change the way HR is delivered.

Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years' HR experience with hands-on work across the full employee lifecycle.
  • Strong end-to-end recruitment experience.
  • Strong practical knowledge of employment law and HR compliance across different employment environments, seeking local advice where required.
  • Demonstrable experience independently managing complex employee relations matters (disciplinary, grievance, performance, absence, investigations).
  • Proven ability to advise and coach managers on a broad range of people matters.
  • Experience developing and improving HR policies, processes and systems with practical, scalable solutions.
  • Experience working effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.
  • Genuine interest in HR technology, automation and AI.

Why join us?

You'll join at an important point in our growth and transformation. We have almost 30 years of experience and an established global client base, but we're not interested in simply maintaining what we've built.

AI, data and technology are reshaping our industry, and we're responding by investing in new capabilities and new ways of working.

You'll work with colleagues across countries, cultures and time zones on work with genuinely international reach, with the scale and stability of an established global business plus real influence over how we operate and where we go next.

Please check our Privacy Policy to find out more about who is administrator of your personal data after application, purposes and your rights.

Se você tem paixão por inovação e busca trabalhar em um ambiente que promove agilidade, colaboração e desafiados, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade!

Para nosso time de Engenharia, buscamos pessoas talentosas e capazes de construir sistemas complexos e de alta qualidade.

Você estará diretamente envolvido com o negócio através da construção e manutenção de nossos sistemas. Nosso principal pilar é a qualidade daquilo que entregamos, entendemos que o importante é fazer bem feito ao invés de fazer rápido. Focamos na simplicidade da solução, nas entregas em pequenas partes e na autonomia das pessoas desenvolvedoras, a partir de um trabalho colaborativo.

Como o nosso ecossistema está em constante evolução, esta oportunidade é focada em um de nossos produtos de ponta em Inteligência Artificial. Por isso, embora a maior parte do ecossistema Asaas utilize Java, esta estrutura é construída em .NET.

Buscamos profissionais com sólida base em engenharia de software, paixão por arquitetura moderna, autonomia para navegar em cenários ambíguos e total abertura para o ecossistema de agentes de IA!

Se interessou pela oportunidade mas não reside em Joinville? Não tem problema, possibilitamos o trabalho remoto/home office.

  • Transformar lógica de negócio em código de alta qualidade, defendendo a simplicidade e as boas práticas de arquitetura;
  • Participar ativamente da arquitetura, definição e implementação de novas funcionalidades, além da correção de bugs;
  • Compreender problemas complexos com pouca definição inicial e estruturar soluções técnicas robustas;
  • Revisar o código entregue pelos colegas de equipe, atuando como um facilitador e elevando a maturidade técnica do time;
  • Dividir grandes entregas em pequenos entregáveis coesos e de valor contínuo;
  • Monitorar a estabilidade, performance e o comportamento da solução implementada em produção;
  • Colaborar ativamente com melhorias, documentação e novos padrões na base de conhecimento da Engenharia.
  • Sólida experiência com o ecossistema .NET;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento Web;
  • Experiência na construção e consumo de APIs REST;
  • Vivência prática com bancos de dados relacionais (preferencialmente PostgreSQL);
  • Domínio de versionamento com Git e noções de pipeline de CI/CD;
  • Inglês técnico.

Informações adicionais

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento ou vivência com o ecossistema Angular;
  • Vivência com Inteligência Artificial (desenvolvimento de Agentes de IA, lógicas de automação ou uso de LLMs);
  • Experiência com integrações de WhatsApp API;
  • Noções de monitoramento de aplicações em produção (logs, performance e telemetria).

Modelo de trabalho

  • Carga horária de 8h por dia (segunda à sexta-feira - não compensamos os sábados);
  • Contratação CLT.

raw.description:
Salary Range $59,000 - $79,000*

Job Description:

WHO WE ARE:

Exemplar Luxury Group is the largest multi-brand luxury retailer in the world, comprising Saks Fifth Avenue, Neiman Marcus, Bergdorf Goodman and Saks OFF 5TH. Powered by our talented colleagues, we are redefining luxury shopping by offering each customer a personalized experience across our store network and e-commerce platforms. Through strong partnerships with the world’s most esteemed brands, cutting-edge technology and the industry’s most comprehensive luxury customer data, Saks Global is shaping the future of retail.

YOU WILL BE:

As the Assistant Buyer, you are a motivated individual who will participate in vendor selections and partnerships. The Assistant Buyer will assist in providing information for the monitoring of inventory productivity, and the analysis of vendor profitability, while providing data and analysis for price changes, and assist in entering price changes online.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Order Management

  • Liaise with Buyers, Associate Buyers, and brand partners to gather and confirm order details (e.g., item details, shipping details, delivery schedules, order prioritization), manage updates to buy sheets, and resolve discrepancies
  • Oversee offshore Merchandise Assistants’ creation and transmission of purchase orders to brand partners, ensuring timely delivery and accuracy of order details, overseeing communication between Merchandise Assistants and brand partners, and resolving or escalating any issues raised
  • Provide allocation direction to the Planning Allocation team and help manage allocations for high-touch categories such as Designer
  • Manage communication of receipt flow changes to the offshore team and ensure POs are maintained to ensure accurate view of ship windows, order quantities, and on-order

Market Preparation

  • Prepare Buyers for Market through working with Planners to provide comprehensive insights on historical performance (e.g., best and worst sellers by door), emerging trends, customer preferences, coordinating market appointments and periodically attending NY market
  • Support Buyer in style-out sessions including coordinating logistics and preparing insights to support assortment presentation
  • Initiate the development of strategic product assortments to drive sales and brand growth

Bottoms-Up In-Season Analysis

  • Act as primary point of contact on execution questions and feedback from brand partners, visual merchandising, site merchandising, stores, digital, marketing (incl. promos), planning (incl. pricing)
  • Constantly review business performance in close collaboration with Assistant Planners, communicating bottoms-up style insights to Buyers, recommending in-season actions (e.g., ask the vendor for ATS on sold out item) and helping to prepare for monthly OTB
  • Manage markdown cadence and oversee offshore execution of price changes (frequency varies by category), RTVs, etc. and resolve any escalated issues
  • Collaborate with offshore reporting team to generate custom Buying reports, maintaining structural changes to views and ensuring timeline delivery by offshore teams on expected cadences

WHAT YOU WILL BRING:

Required Qualifications (Minimum Requirements):

  • Manages ambiguity well, self starter, and is able to thrive in a fast paced environment
  • Strong accountability, and ability to multitask and prioritize independently
  • Generates a variety of approaches to problem solving quickly including new and novel ideas.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and can be both direct but diplomatic and gain trust from others quickly.
  • You often go above and beyond your goals. You are a consistent performer with a proven track record in driving positive outcomes through objectives and measures within a large complex organization.
  • Open to new perspectives and is willing to try new ways of working in our evolving business
  • Strong knowledge of and ability to apply retail math concepts, including elements of markup, margin planning, open to buy, and inventory productivity measures (WOS, T/O, GMROI).
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing
  • Excellent computer skills including MS Word and Excel, Powerpoint, Google Sheets/Docs/Slides
  • Proficiency in systems (RFS, AMS, PCW, NuOrder)
  • 1 - 2 years' experience as an Assistant Buyer, preferably in a major department store

YOUR LIFE AND CAREER AT EXEMPLAR LUXURY GROUP:

  • Opportunity to work in a dynamic fast paced environment at a company experiencing growth and transformation
  • Exposure to rewarding career advancement opportunities across the largest multi-brand luxury retailer from retail to distribution, to digital or corporate
  • Comprehensive benefits package for all eligible full-time employees (including medical, vision and dental)
  • An amazing employee discount

BENEFITS:

We offer the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, disability insurance, and a variety of additional voluntary benefits (such as critical illness, hospital and accident insurance).


Exemplar Luxury Group is an equal employment opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with Exemplar Luxury Group and would like to request special assistance or an accommodation, please contact .


Compensation for this role varies by geographic location. The listed range reflects multiple markets, including higher-cost areas. Actual starting pay will be determined based on work location, experience, and other job-related factors.

  • Time management skills

Licensure and Certification:

  • Current, unrestricted licensure in state of practice as a Registered Nurse (RN) is required

  • General office environment; may be required to sit or stand for extended periods of time

$83,000.00 - $132,800.00

raw.title: Fraud Data Analyst
raw.excerpt: About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.
raw.description:
About Sezzle:


With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Fraud Data Analyst to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for uncovering fraudulent activities and a strong understanding of fraud prevention strategies. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, investigating, and preventing fraudulent transactions and activities, utilizing your analytical skills and experience with SQL to query and analyze data. You will play a crucial role in protecting our company and our customers from financial loss and reputational damage.
Due to the requirements of the position, only English resumes will be accepted.

What You'll Do:
  • Monitor transactions and customer accounts to identify and investigate suspicious or fraudulent activity.
  • Utilize various fraud detection tools, systems, and techniques to identify emerging fraud trends and patterns.
  • Conduct in-depth investigations into suspected fraudulent activities, gathering evidence and documenting findings.
  • Analyze large datasets using SQL to identify anomalies, patterns, and insights related to fraudulent behavior.
  • Develop and implement fraud prevention rules, strategies, and controls.
  • Stay up to date with industry best practices, emerging fraud threats, and new technologies in fraud detection and prevention.

What We Look For:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g. Economics, Computer Science, Analytics, or a related field).
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in a fraud detection, prevention, or investigation role.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience working with SQL and Python.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
  • Understanding of common fraud typologies (e.g., account takeover, identity theft, payment fraud, etc.).
  • Experience with fraud detection tools and platforms is a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex issues.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • High level of integrity and a commitment to ethical practices
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Work experience in fintech, payments, lending, banking, or financial institutions is a plus
  • Degree in statistics, math, finance, economics, or related quantitative discipline; graduate degree a plus

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:


At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

raw.description:
Standard Job Description

Focuses on research & development of technologies that enable and advance semi and fully autonomous systems for both defense and commercial customers. Serves as the algorithm expert with up-to-date knowledge on modern AI research and may be involved in the inception of ideas and drive the development cycles from research to test of prototypes for a major project or component of a major project.Researches and discovers improvements to machine learning and robotic algorithms; Drives advancements in techniques used in signal processing, computer vision (CV), and control systems; Develops AI algorithms for mission systems; Applies latest research on AI algorithms and trains machine learning / deep learning models to solve a variety of problems; Investigates and applies the latest machine learning and deep learning techniques; Optimizes the performance of AI algorithms, applications, and platforms; Develops and documents algorithm and implementation requirements; Develops prototypes that will enable autonomous functionality in LM products and platforms; Interfaces with other teams involved the development lifecycle for perception, mission and motion planning, simulation and modeling, testing, etc.

The Astris AI Sales Engineer serves as the technical backbone of our AI Factory go-to-market motion. This role owns the demo environments, proof-of-concept architectures, and technical narrative that show prospective enterprise customers what AI Factory platform — can do. It combines hands-on AI/ML engineering skill with strong presentation ability to support Account Executives across the full commercial sales cycle, from first technical discovery call through proof-of-concept and close.

Demo & Technical Asset Development

  • Build and maintain reusable MLOps demo environments on Panel covering the full model lifecycle: experiment tracking, versioning, CI/CD for ML, deployment, and production monitoring
  • Develop industry-specific demo narratives and datasets (predictive maintenance, fraud detection, supply chain forecasting, and similar) that map Panel's capabilities to a prospect's actual workflows
  • Maintain demo infrastructure, including containerized and Kubernetes-based environments, so demos run reliably across customer meetings, trade shows, and remote sessions
  • Build reusable technical assets: reference architectures, ROI calculators, solution briefs, and competitive comparison sheets

Customer Engagement Support

  • Partner with Account Executives throughout the commercial sales cycle — qualification through close
  • Lead technical discovery sessions to understand a prospect's existing infrastructure, data environment, team structure, and integration constraints
  • Deliver customized demonstrations and technical presentations to audiences ranging from data scientists and ML engineers to CTO/CIO-level executives
  • Respond to RFIs/RFPs with accurate technical content and MLOps-specific competitive positioning
  • Build trusted-advisor relationships with customer technical stakeholders and support technical handoffs to Customer Success Engineers and Solution Architects once a deal closes

Technical Enablement & Collaboration

  • Maintain deep expertise in Panel and general MLOps best practices (model versioning, experiment tracking, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, governance)
  • Stay current on the broader MLOps and Kubernetes ecosystem (Kubeflow, MLflow, KServe, Ray, Argo, and similar) to keep demos and competitive positioning sharp
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to feed customer feedback and market signal into the Panel roadmap
  • Support partner-channel enablement (ISVs, SIs, cloud partners) with MLOps-focused technical training and co-selling assets

Basic Qualifications

  • 5–9 years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales Technical Consulting, or a hands-on ML engineering / MLOps role
  • Working proficiency in Python and at least one ML framework (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, or similar)
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain demo or POC environments end-to-end

Desired Skills

  • Hands-on experience with MLOps platforms such as Astris AI Factory, MLflow, Kubeflow, Weights & Biases, or similar tools
  • Working knowledge of generative AI / LLM concepts (RAG, agent frameworks)
  • Experience selling into manufacturing, supply chain, financial services, or technology verticals
  • Practical experience with Kubernetes (deploying, debugging, or operating workloads) and containerization

Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $150800.00 - $280000.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $135700.00 - $251900.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $120600.00 - $224000.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $108600.00 - $201600.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Ocala, FL; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only.
Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by

1) providing the best services for homebuyers

2) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance

3) to protect the whole home

As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: IT Helpdesk Technician

Location: India

Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our IT Helpdesk Technician with the Information Technology team.

Porch Group is looking for an IT Helpdesk Technician who will be responsible for analyzing, troubleshooting, and resolving end-user and technology issues for the Porch Group's Information Technology department. This role provides direct support to Porch Group employees via phone, chat, and standard remote tools, offering guidance and best practices on business-specific programs and technology.

The ideal candidate is comfortable troubleshooting IT products such as Microsoft Windows, Office 365, MacOS, MS Teams, Slack, Zoom, RingCentral, and other business-related hardware or software, and enjoys solving problems in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

What You Will Do As An IT Helpdesk Technician

  • Set up and ship equipment for employee use.
  • Monitor all work orders and requests and troubleshoot tickets for status and compliance with established timeframes for work performance.
  • Maintain help desk requests, ticket updates and status, general data entry, and data gathering from emails and phone calls for user support.
  • Re-image laptops and desktops for re-deployments.
  • Ensure proper installation of IT standards, including operating systems and standard software.
  • Answer user inquiries regarding computer software or hardware operation to resolve problems.
  • Document and maintain an IT knowledge base and maintain inventory of assets and equipment.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation and procedures, or train users in the proper use of hardware or software.
  • Install, maintain, support, and troubleshoot operating systems and a wide variety of software applications, peripheral devices, and network connectivity issues.
  • Answer questions in a friendly, professional manner to resolve computer problems for employees remotely via email, chat, or telephone, or in person.
  • Create, change, and delete user accounts.
  • Support scripting and automation efforts to help employees eliminate repetitive work.
  • Maintain security standards and patch management across supported endpoints.
  • Collaborate with others to resolve information technology issues.
  • Resolve computer software issues, questions, and problems.
  • Perform other IT related duties or projects, as assigned.

What You Will Bring As An IT Helpdesk Technician

  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written (English), attention to detail, dependability, cooperation, integrity, and analytical skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in an IT related field, or 3+ years of relevant on-the-job experience.
  • Knowledge of MS Windows and Mac OS X operating systems.
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills; able to assess prioritization by gauging business impact in consideration of competing priorities.
  • Strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with the ability to build credible relationships with multiple business functions.
  • Ability to work on multiple concurrent projects and tasks and switch focus as necessary.
  • Ability to adapt to rapidly changing priorities.
  • 3+ years of relevant corporate IT support operations work experience; preferably in a high-growth, dynamic SaaS environment.
  • Familiarity with regulatory compliance standards such as SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act), PCI (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard), and other relevant frameworks to ensure adherence to legal and security requirements.
  • Familiarity with the fundamentals of IP Addressing, DHCP, DNS, and basic routing skills.
  • IT certifications are a plus.
  • Candidates that have worked in IT for a United States based publicly owned company preferred.
  • Excellent written and communication skills in the English language.
  • Proven experience working with US based business teams.
  • Ability to work within core US business hours / time zone expectations - Eastern Standard Time (EST) overlap.

Technical Solutions Architect - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Technical Solutions Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Technical Solutions Architect to design and govern enterprise-grade application architectures spanning cloud platforms, integration ecosystems, data domains, and large business application portfolios. This role partners closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering leaders to translate strategic objectives into pragmatic, scalable, and maintainable technology solutions that align with enterprise architecture standards. The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of breadth across modern cloud and integration stacks, depth in at least one major enterprise platform, and the ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly to both engineering teams and executive leadership.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define end-to-end solution architectures for enterprise applications covering application, integration, data, security, and infrastructure layers.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to capture functional and non-functional requirements and translate them into reference architectures and target-state designs.
  • Lead architecture review boards, evaluating proposed designs against enterprise standards, security policies, and long-term roadmap considerations.
  • Design integration strategies across SaaS, on-premise, and hybrid landscapes, leveraging API gateways, event streaming, and managed integration platforms.
  • Establish architecture principles, technology selection guidelines, and reusable patterns for use across multiple delivery teams.
  • Collaborate with security architects to embed identity, data protection, and compliance controls into solution designs from the outset.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts including context diagrams, component models, sequence diagrams, and decision records.
  • Guide cloud migration, modernization, and re-platforming initiatives with a focus on cost, performance, and resilience.
  • Support proof-of-concept development to validate critical architectural choices before broader adoption.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams during solution delivery.
  • Track emerging technologies and recommend strategic investments that align with business priorities.
  • Drive standardization across application portfolios to reduce technical debt and operational complexity.
  • Engage with vendors and platform partners to evaluate roadmap fit and negotiate technical commitments.
  • Ensure that solutions meet regulatory, audit, and data governance requirements applicable to the business.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in software engineering or solution architecture roles.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting enterprise applications across at least two major cloud platforms.
  • Strong expertise in integration patterns, API design, and event-driven architectures.
  • Deep familiarity with at least one major enterprise platform such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, or Workday.
  • Working knowledge of identity, security, and data governance frameworks at enterprise scale.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience producing formal architecture artifacts and presenting them to senior leadership.
  • Track record of leading architecture reviews and influencing engineering direction across teams.
  • Strong understanding of cost optimization, scalability, and resilience trade-offs.
Preferred Qualifications
  • TOGAF, AWS, Azure, or GCP architecture certifications.
  • Experience with large-scale ERP, CRM, or HCM transformation programs.
  • Exposure to regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or life sciences.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture tooling such as LeanIX, Ardoq, or Sparx EA.
  • Experience driving cloud governance, FinOps, and cost transparency initiatives.
