JOB TITLE

Marketing & Leasing Coordinator

JOB ID

SILGOL1EA

INDUSTRY

Commercial Asset Management, Retail Property Management, and Investments

LOCATION

South Africa / LATAM

JOB STATUS

Full Time

WORK SCHEDULE

Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm (PST)

SALARY

$3000 to $3500 per month

TARGET START DATE

ASAP

ROLE OVERVIEW

About the Client:

Our client, a premier, vertically integrated commercial real estate (CRE) firm headquartered in Irvine, California, managing approximately $4 billion in assets. Their portfolio encompasses around 100 high-value retail properties across the United States, servicing nearly 1,000 commercial tenants.

Led by a seasoned executive team with roots in ultra-luxury hospitality and high-volume commercial transactions, the firm operates with a boutique, highly entrepreneurial, and fast-paced culture. They deeply value people over pedigree, prioritizing high emotional intelligence, street smarts, critical thinking, and a relentless drive for operational excellence.








About the Role:

The Marketing & Leasing Coordinator owns how the firm presents its commercial real estate portfolio and brokerage offerings to the market. Primary focus areas include maintaining property website content, creating high-end marketing collateral, managing online listing platforms, and driving scheduled outreach cadences.

This is a public-facing position operating exclusively with publicly marketable property data. This role does not require access to or handling of sensitive financial or legal data. The ideal candidate brings commercial real estate design standards, high attention to detail, strong spoken and written English, and hands-on experience using web and design tools to maintain a polished brand presence.


Key Responsibilities

Property Marketing & Collateral Development (~50%)

  • Collateral Creation: Build and update property flyers, leasing brochures, availability sheets, site plans, and presentation decks using brand standards.
  • Brand & Content Freshness: Ensure every flyer in circulation is accurate, visually appealing, and updated within a 90-day cycle.
  • Asset Management: Organize and maintain the centralized marketing asset library (logos, site plans, high-resolution photography, drone imagery, and aerials).
  • Outreach Campaigns: Draft property email blasts, broker announcements, and social media content (e.g., LinkedIn) using pre-approved templates and content.

Website & Digital Presence (~25%)

  • Website Management: Update property pages on the company website with photos, site plans, square footages, availability statuses, and contact details.
  • Rapid Turnaround: Publish new availability and remove leased suites within one business day of notification.
  • Site Quality & Analytics: Perform monthly audits for broken links, outdated collateral, or stale data. Track basic site analytics, reporting monthly on traffic and inquiry volume.
  • Web Enhancements: Collaborate on basic website improvements using CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow) and AI/development tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub).

Listing Platform Management (~15%)

  • Platform Ownership: Maintain active property listings across CoStar, Crexi, LoopNet, and other commercial real estate listing platforms.
  • Listing Audits: Reconcile all external listings against master availability lists monthly to ensure 100% accuracy in photos, square footage, and property descriptions.
  • Market Surveys & Performance: Track listing views, saves, and inquiries per property each month, maintaining a log of published market asking rates.

Leasing Coordination Support (~10%)

  • Inquiry Intake & Logging: Log every incoming broker and prospect inquiry same-day (source, property, square footage, intended use, contact details).
  • First-Touch Responses: Acknowledge inbound inquiries using standard approved templates and route them to the internal leasing team.
  • Pipeline Tracking: Maintain deal status trackers, logging "last touched" dates and running automated or templated follow-up cadences (at 7, 14, and 30 days).
  • Process Documentation: Help draft and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for marketing workflows, file management, and tracking systems.

.


Qualifications & Skills

Non-Negotiable Requirements

  • Commercial Real Estate (CRE) Experience: Must have direct prior experience in commercial real estate marketing or administration. Candidates must understand the distinct structural, visual, and analytical formatting required for CRE collateral compared to residential real estate.
  • Portfolio Submission: Applications will not be reviewed without a portfolio or work samples demonstrating previous commercial real estate flyers, brochures, digital marketing assets, or presentation decks.
  • Fluent/Native English Communication: Excellent verbal and written English skills are strictly required. The candidate must be able to draft polished, error-free external communications and interact seamlessly with brokers, prospects, and internal teams without communication barriers.
  • Scope & Access Restrictions: Must adhere strictly to data privacy boundaries—operating exclusively with publicly marketable property data with zero access to tenant financials, executed leases, or economic negotiation authority.

Tool & System Requirements

  • Design & Web Tools: Hands-on experience with design platforms (Canva, Adobe InDesign) and website content management systems (WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace). Familiarity with AI workflows (Claude, ChatGPT) for content efficiency is a plus.
  • CRE Platforms: Proficiency or quick adaptability with CoStar, LoopNet, and Crexi.
  • Software: Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Outlook) and SharePoint.

Performance Expectations & Metrics

  • Ac
  • curacy: Zero published errors in square footage, availability status, or contact information.
  • Response Speed: All inbound inquiries logged and acknowledged the same business day; website and listing platforms updated within 24 hours of notification.
  • Collateral Standards: No circulating flyer or marketing piece older than 90 days.
  • Reporting: Weekly pipeline summaries and monthly web/listing performance reports delivered consistently on schedule.

Strict Information Access & Scope Limitations

To maintain data security, this role is strictly scoped to publicly marketable information. The following access limitations are enforced via system permissions:

  • No Access To: Executed leases, amendments, LOIs, lease abstracts, rent rolls, tenant sales, tenant financials, bank details, operating budgets, underwriting models, ownership entity records, or HR/employee records.
  • No Economic Negotiation: No authority to quote, negotiate, or commit to financial terms (e.g., rent rates, free rent, tenant improvement allowances). All economic inquiries are transferred directly to leadership without comment.

raw.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Director of Development Engineering to join our team.

Position Description

The Director of Development Engineering oversees all civil, site, and nuclear engineering activities required to advance Aurora powerhouse sites through development and into construction readiness. Your team produces the technical deliverables — site layouts, basis-of-design packages, geotechnical and environmental assessments, and engineering inputs to permitting — that underpin state/local approvals and NRC licensing (coordinated with Oklo's Environmental & Permitting team), project financing, and construction handoff. Environmental & Permitting and Project Finance are coordinated with Oklo's dedicated teams.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Lead development engineering across all active sites: site layout, civil/grading design, geotechnical investigation, hydrology, and infrastructure planning
  • Solutions engineering for potential co-located buildings such as advanced manufacturing and data centers
  • Produce basis-of-design documentation sufficient for project finance due diligence and EPC handoff
  • Manage third-party engineering consultants and coordinate with Oklo's internal nuclear design team
  • Provide engineering inputs to NRC licensing and NEPA processes coordinated by Oklo's Environmental & Permitting team
  • Develop and maintain engineering standards, templates, and quality protocols for the Development organization
  • Partner with Oklo’s New Product Integration (NPI) team to translate reactor design requirements, siting criteria, and product evolution into site-specific technical constraints and development scope — ensuring early alignment between product design and site realities
  • Develop and own site constraints packages for each Aurora powerhouse development site, synthesizing geotechnical, hydrological, environmental, grid, and regulatory inputs into a single authoritative technical baseline that governs site selection, design, and permitting decisions
  • Integrate and quality-control deliverables from civil, geotechnical, environmental, and nuclear engineering consultants — ensuring all third-party work products are consistent, current, and accurately reflected in the site constraints package and project schedule
  • Own the development engineering schedule and provide cross-functional technical leadership to identify, prioritize, and mitigate technical risks and fatal flaws on project sites — coordinating with Project Development, Transmission & Interconnection, and Oklo’s Environmental & Permitting team to surface issues early and preserve development optionality
  • Lead structured technical risk reviews at each stage gate, evaluating site constraints packages against go/no-go criteria and escalating unresolved fatal flaw risks to the VP of Development with clear options analysis and recommended disposition
  • Build and manage a team of engineers across civil/site/electrical and nuclear development disciplines
  • Provide engineering support for Isotope production facilities, including facility layout, utility infrastructure design, and integration with co-located Aurora powerhouse systems
  • Lead development engineering for Nuclear Lifecycle Innovation Campuses (NLICs), coordinating multi-use site design across power generation, isotope production, and research facility components

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 12+ years in energy, infrastructure, advanced manufacturing or data center project development engineering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role
  • Strong civil/site engineering background; nuclear project experience highly valued
  • Experience producing engineering deliverables for project financing and EPC handoff
  • PE license strongly preferred; experience with DOE or NRC-regulated facilities a significant advantage

Competencies

We are looking for a Director of Development Engineering that is:

  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $225,000-$275,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

raw.description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About the role

The Operations Manager is part of Avalere Health’s Corporate Marketing Team, which is responsible for developing and delivering the corporate brand, thought leadership, PR, and integrated marketing activity. The role partners closely with digital specialists to ensure the platforms, systems, and data underpinning integrated campaigns operate reliably and efficiently, supporting increased awareness, strengthened reputation, and commercial opportunities.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Corporate Marketing, this role is accountable for the operational infrastructure that enables the wider team to deliver against the marketing goals of the Group corporate brand, as well as Avalere Health's three capabilities – Advisory, Medical, and Marketing.

The role is central to the effective functioning of Corporate Marketing, providing the team with the platform integration, resourcing visibility and performance insight required to plan and deliver on strategic goals with confidence.

What You'll Do

Operational excellence and process management

  • Develop a culture and processes of operational excellence within the Corporate Marketing team, leading on all Corporate Marketing process development and implementation.

  • Understand, evaluate, develop, and recommend project management and workflow processes that support the prioritization of tasks and improve efficiency and team collaboration.

  • Lead efforts to identify templates, tools, and resources — including applications for Artificial Intelligence — that could streamline campaign creation, simplify review processes, and improve the quality and efficiency of the team's work.

Internal partnerships and resource management

  • Manage how Corporate Marketing projects are resourced out to partner teams, including digital and creative teams.

  • Act as the central point of contact for coordinating resource requests with partner teams, ensuring requests are scoped clearly, timelines are realistic, and work is tracked through to delivery.

  • Maintain visibility of resourcing commitments across active projects, flagging conflicts or bottlenecks with partner team capacity early enough to inform planning.

  • Support prioritization discussions with accurate, up-to-date information on resourcing status and lead times from partner teams.

  • Act as the central point of coordination across Corporate Marketing, building strong working relationships with digital specialists, creatives and senior stakeholders across the business.

  • Balance competing operational demands while maintaining consistency and reliability across the team's systems.

Performance, metrics, and reporting

  • Manage and optimize metrics and ROI reporting for Marketing projects, including LinkedIn performance, paid campaigns, internal comms, and website traffic.

  • Enhance year-on-year campaign performance tracking for easy comparison and to inform future planning.

  • Review performance metrics regularly, interpreting the data to identify trends, areas for improvement, and possible correlations with external factors such as media coverage or world events.

  • Translating performance data into actionable insights that informs ongoing optimization and strategic decision-making.

Marketing technology (MarTech) and digital platform management

  • Manage MarTech systems day-to-day, including maintenance, optimizing usage, contracting and renewals, and scoping and implementing new systems as needed.

  • Understand, evaluate, and evolve the MarTech ecosystem, looking for tools that may offer improvements, new benefits, or cost savings compared to existing tools and processes.

  • Partner with the Digital Team to project manage new digital projects for the corporate brand, from planning to execution, including website updates, CMS management and uploads, SEO/SEM, eventual CRM development, and other projects with the digital team as needed.

  • Partner with digital specialists to drive SEO, GEO, and ad word strategy, ensuring content and campaigns achieve appropriate visibility with target audiences.

Business development support

  • Support the CRM integration project, partnering with our digital specialists to ensure the correct information surfaces on the platform.

  • Manage and optimize the leads process with BD teams.

Content and events operations

  • Project manage the next series of the Within Reach podcast, working with our producer to run the podcast from guest selection to scheduling, coordination, and publication.

  • Project manage marketing campaigns, including scoping resources, developing project plans and timelines, and ensuring smooth campaign development.

  • Support the Associate Director to manage internal Town Halls, ensuring internal events are delivered smoothly.

  • Support the Associate Director as needed with copywriting, editing, visual asset development, social post scheduling, Marketo builds and scheduling, and other associated tasks.

About You

  • Proven experience in a marketing operations, digital marketing, or campaign management role, ideally within healthcare, life sciences, or professional services.

  • Working knowledge of marketing automation and MarTech platforms (Marketo or equivalent, Bitly, Google Analytics), website CMS environments, and paid social/search advertising (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads).

  • Experience with CRM systems and an understanding of how marketing and CRM data connect.

  • Working knowledge of SEO/SEM fundamentals; familiarity with GEO (generative engine optimization) is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations and identify trends and correlations across data sets.

  • Experience developing and improving operational processes, workflows, and resourcing models, with a view towards operational maturity.

  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple platforms, projects, and stakeholders concurrently.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with specialist functions and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong writing and editing skills, with comfort supporting copy-focused tasks across corporate and internal communications.

  • Experience using AI-enabled tools to improve marketing effectiveness and team productivity.

What we can offer

You'll receive up to a 7% pension contribution, life insurance, income protection, and private medical insurance for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including flexible hybrid working, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. Location: Remote (United States)

Work Model: Remote

Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)

Compensation: $35–$50 per hour

About the Company

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity

This is a backend engineering internship on the systems that carry real product workflows. Candidate data arrives messy and at volume, has to be modelled well enough to search and score against, and then has to move reliably through jobs, integrations, and APIs that other parts of the product depend on. You will build and extend those systems, and you will be the one who finds out when they are wrong.

The work is a good fit for someone who enjoys correctness and reliability: designing a schema that will still make sense in six months, making a background job idempotent, or tracing a bad record back through three services to its source. Because the team is small, you will own services rather than tickets, and your work will be in production quickly.

Responsibilities

  • Build and extend backend services, APIs, and the data models behind them.
  • Design and maintain database schemas that support search, scoring, and reporting.
  • Build background jobs and integrations, and make them reliable enough to run unattended.
  • Investigate data quality and correctness issues, and fix them at the source.
  • Write code other engineers can read and extend, and review theirs.

Requirements

  • Strong programming fundamentals in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or a similar language.
  • Comfort learning backend systems, APIs, databases, and data modelling.
  • Interest in building reliable systems that support real product workflows.
  • Has shipped meaningful work before, whether side projects, class projects, open-source contributions, or a prior internship.
  • Strong problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn quickly.
  • Clear communicator who can work independently in a remote environment.

raw.title: Senior Public Policy Analyst
raw.excerpt: JOB SUMMARYThe University of Connecticut School of Social Work seeks qualified applicants to be hired as a Senior Public Policy Analyst (Research Associate I) to be part of the Innovations Institute at the University of Connecticut’s School of Social Work.
raw.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The University of Connecticut School of Social Work seeks qualified applicants to be hired as a Senior Public Policy Analyst (Research Associate I) to be part of the Innovations Institute at the University of Connecticut’s School of Social Work.

The position will be part of the School of Social Work’s growing portfolio of public policy, technical assistance, financing, and evaluation activities in partnership with local, state, and federal government agencies and organizations on behalf of children, youth, and families. Positions with Innovations Institute are fully remote with expected travel to UConn’s Hartford Campus twice annually. Innovations Institute will be hiring up to two (2) candidates.

The selected candidate(s) will apply knowledge, concepts, principles, and skills to multiple projects across the Innovations Institute. These projects will include working with federal, state, and/or local governments to support sustainable financing and integrated and customized policy approaches in public child- and family-serving systems. The senior public policy analyst(s) will engage in document and literature reviews; participate in and, depending on expertise, facilitate meetings, stakeholder interviews, and/or focus groups; prepare briefs, white papers, technical reports, presentations, and overview documents and analyses; and apply expert knowledge and skills related to public policy, financing, and implementation, particularly related to Medicaid financing and children’s behavioral health services.

The position is open for up to two senior public policy analysts who will work under the direction of Deborah Harburger, Assistant Extension Professor and Director of Policy and Financing at Innovations Institute. The selected candidate(s) may mentor or supervise other policy or program staff depending on qualifications. The selected candidate(s) is expected to collaborate across the Innovations Institute and the School of Social Work, as well as with consultants and organizations partnering with the Innovations Institute.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Minimum duties include:
  • Review, analyze, and summarize relevant peer-reviewed and gray literature and datasets to support the provision of technical assistance and the development of literature reviews, briefs, papers, and presentations.
  • Apply senior, in-depth knowledge, concepts, principles, and skills related to public policy, financing, and implementation, including related to Medicaid State Plans, amendments, and waivers and federal policy document development.
  • Participate in and lead substantial portions of meetings, including with state and local leadership.
  • Draft and review meeting notes. Be responsible for key action steps and assist the team with implementing action steps.
  • Conduct or review cost-benefit analysis of proposed recommendations.
  • Monitor key changes in children’s behavioral health, Medicaid, child welfare, and juvenile justice policy at the local, state, and national levels.
  • Review literature and research on current behavioral health topics. Summarize key policy topics for consumption by peers, senior leadership, or external entities.
  • Prepare and review proposals and contracts for actions.
  • Draft and maintain work plans and progress reports.
  • Assist in the preparation of written products for multiple audiences, including academic manuscripts, public-facing one-pagers, and technical reports for decision-makers. Write reports, white papers, position papers, briefs, presentations, strategies, toolkits, testimonies, legislation, regulations, policy directives, implementation guidance, and impact statements for internal and external audiences.
  • Provide presentations and technical assistance to internal or external entities on specific areas of expertise.
  • Maintain high standards in the work being performed and maintain awareness of trends and influences.
  • Assume responsibility for outcomes, make effective and timely decisions, and effectively use technology.
  • Use skill in relevant PC applications and programs such as Microsoft Office (particularly Word and Excel) to perform responsibilities.
  • Maintain productivity and use knowledge strategies to increase knowledge base.
  • Work independently under minimal supervision.
  • Prioritize ongoing and new projects necessary to implement a specific organizational program.
  • Write and present information in a clear and concise way. Interpret and understand written information and listen attentively to verbal and non-verbal cues that lead to a deeper understanding.
  • Work cooperatively with others and demonstrate professional, ethical, respectful, and courteous behavior when interacting with others. Comfortable with developing consensus across stakeholders.
  • Experience developing and maintaining effective working relationships with partners, including funders, internal colleagues, and other stakeholders. Experience partnering with diverse stakeholders to develop research agendas related to outcomes, feedback, and evaluations.
Opportunities may include:
  • Influence strategy, program, policy development, and best practices.
  • Engage in and facilitate strategic planning, internally and with external stakeholders, to achieve short- and long-range planning goals.
  • Serve as an expert resource to others internally and externally.
  • Work on ambiguous matters generally without precedent or structure and independently develop standardization and protocol.
  • Edit reports, white papers, position papers, briefs, presentations, strategies, toolkits, testimonies, legislation, regulations, policy directives, implementation guidance, and impact statements for internal and external audiences.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert related to financing strategies and policy options.
  • Use substantial latitude in decision-making.
  • Set and monitor goals and objectives to align with the defined strategy.
  • Depart from traditional approaches to develop and present novel solutions.
  • Supervise other policy or program staff.
  • Present work to a variety of audiences, including work at meetings and academic conferences.
  • Co-author academic manuscripts in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Contribute to the development and writing of federal, state, and private grant proposals.
  • Perform other duties as needed.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Demonstrated experience working in and with federal, state, and local public child- and family-serving agencies.
  • Demonstrated record of scholarship, including authoring or co-authoring high-quality reports, toolkits, and briefs related to public child- and family-serving systems.
  • Demonstrated experience working with multiple states on children’s public behavioral health system design, implementation, or initiatives.
  • Demonstrated understanding and knowledge of public child- and family-serving system design, service array (including mobile response and stabilization, intensive in-home services, peer support, and intensive care coordination), and financing, including senior expertise in Medicaid authorities and requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience authoring white papers or briefs and conducting high-level policy analysis.
  • Ph.D. with up to one year of post-degree experience or Master’s degree and eight to ten years of post-degree experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree or PhD in social work, psychology, public administration, public management, public policy, or a related field.
  • Experience providing consultation or technical assistance to multiple states, tribes, or territories on public children’s behavioral health systems and services.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively attend to various duties and projects simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of, expertise in, and commitment to systems of care and implementation science.

APPOINTMENT TERMS

These are full-time, end-date positions subject to renewal based upon funding and satisfactory performance. Positions with Innovations Institute are fully remote with expected travel to UConn’s Hartford Campus twice annually. Compensation will be based on experience and will range from $130,000 to $145,000 annually (full-time equivalent). For additional information regarding benefits, please visit UConn Health Benefits and explore the sections under the Benefits & Leaves and Engagement & Learning headers. Other rights, terms, and conditions of employment are contained in the collective bargaining agreement between the University of Connecticut and the American Association of University Professors UConn Chapter (AAUP).

TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

Employment of the successful candidate is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre-employment criminal background check.

TO APPLY

Please apply online at Faculty and Staff Positions, Search #499803.Upload a cover letter and resume that demonstrate how the candidate meets the minimum qualifications and, as applicable, the preferred qualifications. Upload the names of three professional references.Upload a writing sample that meets the following requirements:

  • Write a sample Policy Corner that could be used in a future edition of the TA Telegram, a bi-weekly electronic newsletter distributed to the Innovations Institute listserv, which includes policymakers, practitioners, researchers, and others across the country. (Examples of past Policy Corners: 1/12/26, 3/23/26, 4/20/26, 6/1/26, and 7/13/26).
  • The Policy Corner should be a brief spotlight on an issue from a public child- and family-serving system policy lens.
  • The Policy Corner should
    • Include a short and attention-grabbing title that is 4-8 words
    • Be approximately 5-8 sentences (300-500 words)
      • Include a very brief introduction to the topic, resource, or problem
      • Describe policy options, solutions, recommendations, and/or implications
      • Use embedded hyperlinks for resources cited
    • Include a bulleted list of an additional 3-5 publicly available resources for readers to learn more (not included in word count)

This job posting will remain open until filled.

All employees are subject to adherence to the State Code of Ethics.

All members of the University of Connecticut are expected to exhibit appreciation of, and contribute to, an inclusive, respectful, and diverse environment for the University community.

The University of Connecticut aspires to create a community built on collaboration and belonging and has actively sought to create an inclusive culture within the workforce. The success of the University is dependent on the willingness of our diverse employee and student populations to share their rich perspectives and backgrounds in a respectful manner. This makes it essential for each member of our community to feel secure and welcomed and to thoroughly understand and believe that their ideas are respected by all. We strongly respect each individual employee’s unique experiences and perspectives and encourage all members of the community to do the same. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, age, sex, marital status, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, genetic information, physical or mental disabilities, veteran’s status, status as a victim of domestic violence and/or sexual assault and/or trafficking in persons as defined by Connecticut law, prior conviction of a crime, workplace hazards to the reproductive systems, or gender identity or expression.

The University of Connecticut is an AA/EEO employer including for Disability and Veteran status.

raw.description:
We're the team iGaming operators turn to when growth matters most — and we're growing fast ourselves. At Receptional, you'll find colleagues who are bright, ambitious, and genuinely supportive. Specialists who do their best work together, sharing ideas, moving fast, and holding themselves to a high bar.

Whether you're starting out or stepping up, you'll get genuine investment in your development through our internal academy, real variety in your work, and a direct impact on some of the biggest names in the industry. Competitive benefits, flexible working, and a team that has your back.

We were named Marketing Services Supplier of the Year at the EGR B2B Awards 2026, and Best Medium Agency to Work For at the Company Culture Awards 2025 — recognition for the work we do and the place we've built to do it.

Paid search in iGaming is some of the most technically demanding PPC work in digital marketing. The budgets are significant, the compliance requirements are strict, and clients expect a senior point of contact who can think strategically as well as get into the weeds of an account. As a Senior Paid Search Manager at Receptional you'll be owning Google Ads strategy and execution across a portfolio of major iGaming clients — running campaigns, managing client relationships, and developing up to two direct reports. You'll work closely with the Head of Paid Search with genuine autonomy across your accounts and a clear path upward for the right person.

What We're Looking For


You'll need to be a confident practitioner and a credible leader — someone who can run complex paid search accounts autonomously while developing the people around them at the same time. Senior paid search in iGaming demands commercial sharpness, deep platform expertise, and the ability to present strategy to clients who know their numbers and will push back. You'll also be managing direct reports, so clear direction, honest feedback, and genuine investment in people development comes with the territory.

Essential:
  • 3+ years' paid search experience, ideally agency-side, with proven results managing Google Ads at scale
  • Strong campaign creation and optimisation experience — you know what good looks like and you can prove it
  • Google Ads certified — current and maintained
  • Strong client relationship management skills — you present with confidence and handle difficult conversations without escalating everything
  • Solid campaign planning capabilities — budgeting, forecasting, and performance management across multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Experience managing or mentoring direct reports — you've developed people, not just worked alongside them
  • Commercially minded and analytically strong — you work with data confidently and translate it into clear strategic recommendations
  • Comfortable using AI tooling to improve campaign efficiency and workflow automation

Desirable:
  • iGaming or regulated-sector experience — we'll get you up to speed if not
  • Microsoft Ads certified or actively working towards it
  • Experience liaising directly with Google or Microsoft platform partners
  • Contribution to new business proposals, audits, or award entries
  • Experience training others internally on paid search best practices

How you'll be measured

Campaign performance against agreed client KPIs, accuracy of budget and spend management, quality and timeliness of client reporting, direct report development progress, and contribution to new business activity.

What You'll Be Doing


This is a senior paid search role with real leadership responsibility. You'll be owning Google Ads strategy and execution across a portfolio of large iGaming clients — managing campaigns, running client relationships, and developing the team beneath you. The budgets are significant, the clients are commercially demanding, and you'll be expected to bring strategic thinking to every account you touch. You'll work closely with the Head of Paid Media while operating with genuine autonomy day-to-day.

In practice, that looks like:

  • Creating, managing, and optimising paid search campaigns across Google Ads — always with a sharp eye on performance against KPIs
  • Owning day-to-day client communication across your portfolio — building trusted relationships and providing strategic advice, not just reporting numbers
  • Developing paid search strategy plans in collaboration with the Head of Paid Media — contributing your own thinking at every stage
  • Conducting daily account checks to identify issues and opportunities before clients do
  • Managing and developing up to two direct reports — supporting their growth through regular 1-1s, constructive feedback, and hands-on guidance
  • Ensuring paid search best practices are implemented consistently across all managed campaigns and by your direct reports
  • Liaising with Google and Microsoft strategists to stay ahead of platform developments and maximise account performance
  • Using AI tooling to improve campaign efficiency and automate repeatable processes
  • Contributing to new business proposals, paid search audits, and award entries
  • Keeping Google Ads certification current

The Package


£42,000 - £50,000 depending on experience.
Remote-first position.

Your Growth, Supported
Defined career pathways, personal development plans, and regular appraisals so you always know where you stand and what's next. Team training budgets, a Training Academy, an AI-powered learning platform, and a genuine commitment to promoting from within.

Pay and Rewards That Reflect Your Work
Competitive salaries benchmarked annually, a company bonus paid twice a year, enhanced pension contributions as your career develops, a Long-Term Incentive Plan, and generous referral bonuses. Good work gets rewarded here.

Your Contribution, Recognised
Monthly MVP Award (£100), Values Champion recognition (£25 plus a prize wheel spin up to £100), and an annual Player of the Season award (up to £250). Weekly shout-outs and appreciation from colleagues and managers are just part of how we work.

Health and Wellbeing
Free annual health checks, flu jabs, and eye tests. Access to mental health first aiders, confidential counselling sessions, a cycle-to-work scheme, and five paid sick days on top of SSP. We take looking after our people seriously.

Time That's Yours
25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) rising to 30 with tenure, your birthday off, flexible working hours, hybrid and remote options, and two weeks working abroad. Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, and work that fits around your life, not the other way around.

A Team Worth Being Part Of
Regular Lunch 'n' Learns, quarterly off-sites, monthly socials, two paid volunteering days, an annual charity partnership chosen by the team, and an AI Taskforce putting innovation in everyone's hands. We're building something together — and that should feel like it.

raw.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a proactive and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote UGC Program Manager, Social & Performance Creative opening.

As the UGC Program Manager, Social & Performance Creative, you will build and scale the company's UGC and social media systems to support aggressive DTC growth goals. You will oversee the sourcing, coordination, and execution of UGC and video creatives for paid and organic channels, while helping strengthen the company's online presence, customer trust, and conversion performance across key touchpoints. You will contribute directly to the company's growth by ensuring a constant pipeline of high-quality creative assets, managing social media execution, and creating scalable processes and SOPs that allow the system to grow efficiently over time.

About the company:
The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.
Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Build & Scale UGC and Video Creative Production Pipeline

  • Build and manage a consistent UGC sourcing and production pipeline for paid ads, website assets, and social media content.
  • Coordinate creators, briefs, scripts, references, and deliverables to ensure a steady flow of high-quality video and photo assets.
  • Manage and organize creative assets, ensuring files are properly stored, categorized, and accessible for the marketing and DTC teams.
  • Collaborate with the DTC and creative teams to iterate on top-performing creatives and continuously improve performance.
  • Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines, customer positioning, and conversion goals.

Execute Social Media Content & Community Growth

  • Manage and grow the company's Facebook and Instagram presence through consistent posting and content execution.
  • Coordinate and publish organic social media content, including reels, posts, stories, and UGC-based assets.
  • Help strengthen customer trust and brand positioning through clear, engaging, and customer-focused content.
  • Monitor content performance and audience engagement, identifying opportunities for improvement and optimization.

Support Paid Social & Performance Creative

  • Collaborate with the DTC and paid media teams to develop UGC and social creatives optimized for Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ads.
  • Coordinate production and delivery of creatives that support ad testing, scaling, and conversion optimization efforts.
  • Assist in identifying winning creative angles, hooks, and content formats based on performance insights and feedback.

Create SOPs & Scalable Processes

  • Build and document clear SOPs and workflows for UGC sourcing, creator management, content production, asset organization, and publishing processes.
  • Help establish scalable systems that support long-term creative production and social media growth.
  • Continuously improve internal processes to increase efficiency, consistency, and execution quality.

Qualifications:

  • 1+ year of experience managing or coordinating UGC and video creative production for ads, social media, or eCommerce brands.
  • Preferred 1+ year of experience managing organic social media content and execution for Facebook and Instagram.
  • Preferred 1+ year of experience working with Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ad creatives and performance-focused content.
  • Nice to have: 1+ year of experience with additional paid or organic platforms such as TikTok or YouTube.
  • Experience coordinating creators, content production, or creative workflows in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Drive, Notion, Airtable, CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar platforms.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple moving parts, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.

Core Competencies & Values:

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Pandoblox is building the future of data consulting by leveraging an elite team of practitioners amplified by AI to deliver enterprise-quality data platforms (Signal OS) to mid-market companies. We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer who balances a mastery of data-engineering craft with a strong data analyst edge. This is a hands-on, individual contributor delivery role where you will transform raw source systems into trusted, governed data marts that drive executive decisions and feed AI agents.

The position is structured around roughly 70% hands-on building, 25% client domain discovery/analysis, and 5% collaborator engineering practices.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

In this role, you'll get to...

  • Stand up and operate per-client data ingestion (ODBC, API, and file sources) into the warehouse via our ELT layer.
  • Run rigorous row-count and parity checks to verify raw landings directly against the client’s source systems.
  • Own end-to-end pipeline operations across concurrent clients, directly diagnosing freshness issues, failure alerts, infrastructure costs, and incidents.
  • Build and maintain isolated, three-layer dbt projects (staging → intermediate → marts) for each client assignment.
  • Construct robust fact and baseline models that reproduce a client’s exact source-of-truth numbers, producing reconciliation documentation for client sign-off.
  • Perform engineering standards rigor by applying version-controlled, tested, peer-reviewed, and reproducible data practices utilizing a disciplined local-to-CI workflow.
  • Apply right-size engineering rigor appropriately for a startup environment, partnering cleanly with platform engineering without gold-plating solutions.
  • Sit directly with client operators, controllers, and analysts to pull essential domain logic and uncover system patterns.
  • Translate discovery conversations directly into clear metric definitions within the semantic layer and queryable business marts.
  • Own core business-rule tests and metric definitions (Cube.dev) powering executive dashboards and natural-language AI querying.
  • Construct the quality framework using automated dbt tests, anomaly checks, freshness monitoring, and PII awareness.
  • Optimize and structure context-rich datasets with clean joins and clear descriptions so AI agents can reason correctly via the signal-mcp tool server.
  • Ensureall ongoing data operations capture structured traces that continuously feed our cross-client intelligence layers.
  • Collaborate and train other team members
  • Perform other duties as required by the role

REQUIREMENTS:

On day one, we'll expect you to…

  • Have 7+ years of experience in data engineering or analytics engineering, with a proven history of delivering trusted data end-to-end.

  • Have experience in at least 2 of these industries: Sales, Marketing, Finance & Finance related, Media

  • Possess deep, hands-on production ownership of cloud data warehouses, focusing heavily on query optimization, cost strategy, partitioning, clustering, and dataset architecture.

  • Have deep knowledge for cloud data warehouse production experience, with Google BigQuery strongly preferred (Snowflake, Redshift, or equivalent is acceptable).

  • To be expert-level capabilities with dbt Core, building production projects from scratch, managing layers, and setting up automated testing frameworks.

  • Have strong dimensional modeling foundations, including Kimball methodologies, conformed dimensions, and canonical entity design.

  • Have proven capabilities integrating and unifying data from complex systems such as ERP (NetSuite, SAP), CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot), and HRIS (ADP).

  • Possesses the ability to confidently lead discovery workshops with non-technical executive stakeholders, controllers, and operational leads.

  • Have a track record of shipping right-sized, trustworthy data outcomes under fast-paced startup or multi-client consulting settings.

  • Have an experience operating within capable teams utilizing modern Git practices, branching, code reviews, and keyless production deployments via CI.

  • Possesses motivation to remain a hands-on builder in dbt and BigQuery daily, supported by AI agent tooling rather than transitioning into people management.

  • Possess capability to easily wear the analyst hat, extracting business needs, reverse-engineering domain models, and reconciling numbers against source-of-truth reports.

  • Have strong written and verbal English communication skills

  • Have a fully functional and up-to-date computer with which to perform duties

  • Be willing to install next generation end point protection on the computer

  • Be a current resident of the Philippines and can perform work from there

  • Be willing to work within US Pacific timezone (8am - 5pm PST, 12AM - 9AM Manila time) or during client hours as required

  • Be willing to undergo a 90-days probationary period upon initial hire

  • This is a remote (work from home) job

raw.description:
About Scale

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

About The Role

We're looking for a Regulatory Affairs Specialist to support compliance across our dietary supplement product lines. Reporting to the Regulatory Affairs Manager, you'll help ensure our labels, claims, and promotional materials meet FDA and FTC requirements — reviewing and interpreting regulatory standards, keeping documentation organized, and flagging risk before it reaches the market.

This is a hands-on, detail-driven role for someone who already knows their way around the dietary supplement space. You understand that claims have to be substantiated — that we can't just say things — and that supplements operate under real regulatory constraints. You'll work closely with Marketing, R&D, Product Development, and Quality as part of a small, high-trust regulatory team, with room to deepen your expertise over time.

What You'll Do

Claims & Promotional Review

  • Review and approve promotional materials — commercial scripts, social media content, email, and marketplace listings — for compliance with FDA and FTC standards.
  • Apply structure/function and advertising requirements to flag risky language and recommend compliant alternatives.
  • Help ensure product claims are properly supported before they go live.

Substantiation Support

  • Support the claims substantiation process by reviewing and organizing supporting evidence and maintaining substantiation records.
  • Understand and apply the "competent and reliable scientific evidence" standard to assess whether a claim is adequately backed.

Labeling, SOPs & Compliance

  • Review supplement labels to ensure packaging and ingredient disclosures meet applicable requirements.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining regulatory SOPs, processes, and internal guidance.
  • Conduct or assist with Serious Adverse Event Reporting (SAER) investigations and documentation.

Monitoring & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Monitor evolving FDA, FTC, and NAD developments — including warning letters and relevant industry litigation — and translate them into practical takeaways for the business.
  • Prepare and present industry updates at recurring team meetings (e.g., a monthly regulatory round-up), keeping cross-functional partners aware of what's happening and why it matters.
  • Partner with Marketing, R&D, Product Development, and Quality to provide practical regulatory guidance throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Manage the company’s trademark program: conduct initial trademark searches, maintain records, and coordinate with legal counsel for USPTO submissions.

Who You Are

You care about getting the details right, and you understand that good compliance protects the brand and the customer. You're a partner to the business, not a gatekeeper.

  • Detail-Oriented: You care about the details — because you know they add up to better, more trustworthy outcomes.
  • Clear Communicator: You express ideas clearly and make regulatory concepts easy to understand for non-regulatory teammates.
  • Organized & Deadline-Driven: You keep meticulous records and juggle competing priorities with ease, knowing that timely, well-organized documentation often gates product release.
  • Proactive: You anticipate needs, take ownership, and ask for support when needed.
  • Empowered Collaborator: You work across teams with trust and respect, and move projects forward through collective effort.

What You'll Need

  • 2–3 years of regulatory affairs experience in dietary supplements — this is our top priority. Not a first regulatory job, but not a senior-level tenure either.
  • A working understanding that product claims must be substantiated and that supplements operate under FDA and FTC regulation.
  • Experience reviewing labels and/or promotional materials for compliance.
  • Familiarity with DSHEA, 21 CFR Part 111, and structure/function claim basics.
  • Bachelor's degree in a life science, food science, or related field.

Preferred

  • Exposure to adjacent categories — cosmetics (MoCRA) or food/beverage — is a plus, though dietary supplement experience matters most.
  • DTC or eCommerce experience, including online marketplace (e.g., Amazon) compliance.
  • Comfort with quality or product documentation basics — reviewing specifications or Certificates of Analysis (COAs) and meeting the documentation timelines that gate product release.
  • Experience assisting with SOP development or regulatory process improvement.
  • Prior experience working within AI systems (Claude, Notion AI, etc.).

What We Offer

  • Salary: $75,000- $85,000
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
  • Fully remote, full-time position
  • Monthly work-from-home stipend
  • Generous paid time off program
  • Discounted products
  • An amazing team to work alongside

raw.description:
Accounting Manager

Counterpart is the first Agentic Insurance™ platform, combining trusted insurance expertise with cutting-edge AI to deliver tailored management and professional liability solutions. By integrating Agentic Underwriting™, Agentic Broker Services™, Agentic Risk Mitigation™, Agentic Claims Management™, Agentic Coverage™, and Agentic Capacity™ into one powerful platform, Counterpart empowers brokers - and the businesses they serve - to do more with less risk. Backed by A rated carriers, Counterpart has been recognized by CB Insights as a 2025 “Top 50 Insurtech,” by Great Place to Work, and by Business Insurance as one of its 2025 “Best Places to Work.”

As Accounting Manager, you run the day-to-day financial operations within Agentic Finance - bordereau and premium reconciliation, carrier and claims payments, premium accounts receivable, accounts payable, expense management, financial reporting, audit administration, and tax filings - that keep Counterpart, Agentic Programs™, and Counterpart Insurance Company running. You own accounts receivable, accounts payable, expense management, and vendor administration outright, and you support the Controller on bordereau, carrier payment operations, audit administration, and financial reporting - with a path to taking ownership of bordereau and carrier payment operations as those processes stabilize. You build and run the agents that make this execution more efficient as the company scales. You report to the Controller.

YOU WILL:

Own Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Expense Management, and Vendor Administration

  • Own premium accounts receivable from brokers end-to-end - invoicing and installment billing, cash application against policies and endorsements, and aging and collections follow-up - so premium owed to Counterpart is collected on time and applied accurately.
  • Own the reconciliation of broker premium remittances into the premium trust account, clearing unapplied cash before it ages and escalating past-due balances and write-off candidates to the Controller.
  • Own execution of Counterpart's spend-management automation - full accounts payable automation, invoice coding, and card-spend policy enforcement.
  • Own employee expense reimbursement administration, setting the standard for review before sign-off by Controller.
  • Own vendor records and documentation, including W-9 collection, and manage the relationships behind recurring vendor and brokerage-fee payments.
  • Own recurring program-level reimbursement invoicing end-to-end, from calculation through submission.

Support Bordereau, Carrier Payment Operations, and Claims Payments

  • Prepare bordereau assembly and the premium reconciliation process across all carrier and reinsurance relationships, resolving discrepancies before they reach the Controller.
  • Maintain the carrier payment calendar, prioritizing and resolving issues against each carrier's timing requirements for the Controller's approval.
  • Prepare monthly loss fund reporting to carrier partners - bank-to-book reconciliation, top-up requests, and check registers - resolving variances directly with carrier contacts.
  • Execute claims payments from loss fund accounts under the Controller's payment authority, partnering directly with the Claims team on payment timing and exceptions.

Support Audit Administration

  • Administer the response process for the annual company audit, carrier audit financial requests, and the R&D tax credit - compiling documentation, drafting responses, and managing the deadline calendar, while the Controller leads the auditor and tax-advisor relationships.
  • Support Counterpart Insurance Company's statutory (STAT) reporting cadence and regulatory filings, providing the underlying data and documentation the Controller needs for CIC's STAT close.
  • Maintain and continuously improve the accounting due dates calendar.

Support Financial Reporting

  • Prepare and distribute the recurring carrier partner reporting package - unaudited financials, cash position summaries, and other standard deliverables on a monthly and quarterly basis, for the Controller's review and sign-off.
  • Partner with the Controller on evaluating and coordinating contractor, vendor, or offshore support for these processes as the accounting function grows.

Drive Agentic Automation Across Accounting Operations

  • Build and use agents to automate premium receivable cash application, bordereau assembly, premium reconciliation, and claims payment processing.
  • Feed clean, structured financial data and workflows into Counterpart's Intelligence System.
  • Decide where agents replace manual work versus where judgment is still required, and partner with the technical platform team to build and continuously improve those workflows.

YOU HAVE:

  • 5-7 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, ideally at a high-growth company; insurance, insurtech, or fintech experience is a plus but not required.
  • A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Working knowledge of GAAP and STAT (Statutory Accounting Principles), and comfort operating within a regulated, multi-entity insurance business.
  • A track record of owning and improving accounting processes end-to-end - not just executing tasks.
  • Hands-on experience with an accounting system or ERP (QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or similar) and an AP/spend platform (Ramp, Bill.com, or similar).
  • A demonstrated track record of using AI tools or agents to redesign reconciliations, payment processing, and routine bookkeeping.

raw.description:
Elite is the trusted automation platform for law firm operations across most of the world’s largest and most successful law firms. Elite has guided firms through every technology shift and today delivers the only cloud-native SaaS platform that unifies financial, invoice, time, and data management into a single system of action. With embedded AI, predictive analytics, and integrated payments, Elite’s products enable firms to shorten billing cycles, reduce write-offs, and unlock firm-wide insights, making financial operations the foundation for law firm innovation and growth. Learn more at elite.com.

Position Overview

Elite is hiring a Director , Platform & Intelligence Value Stream to own the value stream end to end — the shared platform foundation every Elite product is built on, together with the productization of our AI and data capabilities. You will own the roadmap for orchestration, conversational AI, rules, unified access, and the event backbone, and turn those services into a reusable foundation that our financial, work-to-cash, and internal business product lines build on rather than around.

This is both a strategy role and a delivery role. You will carry the what and why for the stream — a single prioritized backlog, roadmap sequencing, and requirements translation through release commitment and delivery — pair daily with an engineering delivery unit, and lead a small standing team of domain and analyst talent. Because the platform is horizontal, you will sit upstream of every customer-facing product line, and you will be measured on the return the stream delivers rather than on output volume.

Work Arrangement:​Remote​

Responsibilities

Own the Platform & Framework Foundation

  • Own the product roadmap for Elite's shared platform services — including workflow orchestration, conversational AI, and business rules — and sequence their maturity from foundation to scale.
  • Own the product direction for unified access and entitlements — authorization, user management, data-level security, and subscription-driven feature access across Elite applications.
  • Treat the platform as a product with internal customers, defining the patterns, contracts, and adoption paths by which other product teams consume shared services, so capability is built once and reused.
  • Partner with Engineering on the shared infrastructure and sequencing that let product teams build on the platform rather than around it.

Productize AI & Data

  • Own productization of workflow- and agent-driven capabilities that move customers beyond traditional reporting toward AI that takes action inside their day-to-day financial and legal workflows.
  • Turn data assets into productized offerings on a modern cloud data platform, with clear value metrics and pricing.
  • Shape product and go-to-market strategy for integrations that give customers richer, real-time access to their data, including through third-party AI tools.

Lead the Value Stream

  • Define and prioritize a single backlog around customer outcomes and return on investment, and drive it from backlog through release commitment and delivery.
  • Set quarterly outcomes for the stream and point the paired delivery unit at the highest-value work; own feasibility, trade-offs, escalations, and backlog readiness.
  • Lead and grow the stream's standing team of domain and analyst talent, raising the bar on domain depth and AI fluency.
  • Act as the product voice in architectural and platform prioritization, steering infrastructure investment toward the capabilities that drive customer outcomes and revenue.

Build Governance In from the Start

  • Partner with Security and Architecture from the outset of each initiative to build data governance, access control, auditability, and appropriate safeguards into agentic products and integrations that handle privileged and financial data.
  • Ensure agents inherit user-level permissions, including data-level security, so intelligence and automation stay within firm entitlements by design.

Commercialize and Enable

  • Define value metrics and commercial models that make return on investment legible to customers and to the business.
  • Enable Sales and Services with clear narratives, value propositions, and routing guidance for platform, AI, and data capabilities.
  • Use usage data, customer insight, and financial metrics to drive prioritization for adoption, retention, and revenue impact.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support departmental and company objectives.​

Qualifications

  • ​​Bachelor's Degree​ or equivalent education and experience.
  • 10+ years in product management, including direct ownership of platform, data, analytics, or AI/ML products, with at least three years leading product managers or end-to-end delivery.
  • Demonstrated experience productizing AI/ML or agentic capabilities into shipped B2B products — not only analytics or BI reporting. This is a core requirement.
  • Hands-on experience productizing platform or foundational services — workflow and orchestration, identity and entitlements, rules engines, or shared data services — consumed by multiple product teams.
  • Experience building or productizing data offerings on a modern cloud data platform or lakehouse architecture (for example Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake), with the technical fluency to make sound build trade-offs.
  • Experience packaging, pricing, and commercializing data products or platform integrations, including connectors or APIs that expose data to third-party tools or AI assistants.
  • Direct experience with data governance, access control, or compliance in a regulated or sensitive-data setting, and comfort partnering closely with Security and Architecture.
  • A track record of end-to-end delivery ownership — turning strategy into measurable, shipped outcomes — with fluency in backlog management and outcome metrics.
  • Proven people leadership: hiring, developing, and directing product and analyst talent, and leading through influence across Engineering and business partners.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management, with a bias toward focus, prioritization, and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience building or operating complex B2B SaaS platforms in ERP, financial systems, legal technology, or another regulated environment, preferred.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps or comparable backlog and delivery tooling, preferred.
  • Ability to travel up ​10–25%​as business needs require
  • Role requires the following physical capacity:​​Sedentary: primarily desk/computer work​
  • Must be legally authorized to work in​​United States​; ​Elite does not provide employment sponsorship for this position​

Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation Package ($211,500- $235,000 base salary + variable component)
  • Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage (Health, Dental, Vision)
  • Retirement Savings Plan with an Employer Contribution
  • Professional Development Opportunities
  • Time Off
  • Wellness Initiatives
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Generous Global Parental Leave
  • Calm, free premium subscription
  • Employee Discount Program

Please note that we do not offer sponsorship for this position.

Additional Information

At Elite Technology, we embrace an employee-centric, flexible work model that empowers you to do your best work in the environment that suits you. However, we also recognize the importance of in-person collaboration for key moments that truly matter.

In our flexible remote approach, you have the freedom to choose a workspace within your home country that best fits your needs. Our corporate offices are located in New York City, Los Angeles, Costa Rica, and the Philippines, providing additional options for those who prefer or need a hybrid work environment.

Our diverse global team spans the U.S., Canada, U.K., Costa Rica, the Philippines, and Australia. Please note that at this time, we are unable to hire employees located in Quebec or Ontario Provinces, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Louisiana, and Oklahoma.

As a global business, we rely on diversity of culture and thought to deliver on our goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law.

We are not accepting applications submitted through recruiting agencies.
