Sr. Product Manager II, ClinicalKey Nursing

Would you like to shape AI-first tools that help nurses deliver better care?

Are you ready to connect complex products into seamless healthcare experiences?

About the Team

Join the Nurse Readiness team at Elsevier as we create the next generation of digital experiences for nurses. Our team develops trusted solutions that help nurses access evidence-based knowledge, build confidence, and deliver exceptional patient care throughout their careers. Working alongside clinicians, educators, designers, engineers, and product leaders, we combine Elsevier's world-class content with modern technology to solve meaningful challenges for healthcare organizations worldwide. This role offers the opportunity to shape connected product experiences that simplify workflows, reduce friction, and help customers get more value from the solutions they use every day.

About the Role

As Senior Product Manager, ClinicalKey Nursing, you are a strategic, technically savvy product manager with experience building platform or ecosystem products. You will report to the Vice President of Product and lead the vision, strategy, and delivery of key capabilities within Elsevier's enterprise nursing workspace. You excel at connecting products into seamless customer experiences, influencing across multiple product teams, and translating customer workflows into clear product strategy and specifications. You are a strong collaborator, an exceptional communicator, and comfortable working closely with engineering, UX, and AI-assisted development teams.

In this role, you will play a key role in Elsevier's AI-first product development approach as you identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve discoverability, and introduce shared capabilities that strengthen the overall experience without disrupting the unique strengths of each individual product.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the VP Product and other product leaders on strategic vision, informed by customer research, product analytics, and market insights.

  • Create and execute a roadmap to create a cohesive and intuitive experience across multiple products, in partnership with other product managers across the nursing portfolio.

  • Define platform capabilities that improve navigation, discoverability, personalization, administration, reporting, and overall usability across the Nursing ecosystem.

  • Prototype and validate cross-product concepts quickly, using customer feedback, AI-assisted tools, and iterative experimentation to refine product direction before development.

  • Collaborate with engineering and platform product managers to define platform architecture, including APIs, authentication, shared services, and modular user interfaces that enable products to work together effectively.

  • Lead AI-first, spec-driven product development by translating customer needs, workflows, and business objectives into clear product specifications that guide design, engineering, testing, and delivery.

  • Partner closely with engineering, UX, and AI development teams to iteratively refine specifications, validate assumptions through rapid experimentation, and ensure solutions meet customer needs before implementation.

  • Serve as an advocate for nursing customers, ensuring product decisions reflect real-world workflows and customer needs.

  • Use customer insights, product analytics, and market trends to prioritize investments and guide roadmap decisions.

  • Partner with UX, engineering, clinical, commercial, and content teams to deliver high-quality, scalable experiences that ensure alignment with customer needs, product excellence, regulatory compliance, and successful market delivery.

  • Define success metrics and continuously evaluate ecosystem performance to proactively improve adoption, engagement, and customer satisfaction.

Requirements

  • 10 years of experience delivering customer-facing SaaS or enterprise software products, with 8+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex cross-functional initiatives.

  • Experience building or managing platform products, integrated product experiences, or enterprise software ecosystems.

  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically across multiple products while balancing customer needs, technical considerations, and business priorities.

  • Strong technical acumen, including experience working with APIs, integrations, authentication, and modern application architectures.

  • Exceptional customer discovery and user research skills, with a passion for understanding customer workflows and translating insights into product strategy.

  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and build alignment across multiple product organizations.

  • Strong analytical skills with experience using product metrics and customer insights to drive decision making.

  • Strong understanding of healthcare technology, clinical workflows, learning platforms, or education technology is a plus.

  • Experience working within AI-assisted software development environments, using structured specifications to guide engineering, testing, and delivery is a plus.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant discipline. Experience in healthcare technology, enterprise software, or education technology is preferred. Masters degree in technical subject (Computer Science or Engineering discipline) is strongly preferred, but not essential.

Work in a Way That Works for You
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working Pattern
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

About the Business
A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world's grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world

raw.description:
MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
  • Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
  • Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
  • Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.

Strategic Account Management & Network Development

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
  • Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
  • Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
  • Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
  • Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.

Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement

  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
  • Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
  • Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
  • Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.

Influence & Impact

  • Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
  • Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
  • Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries

Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact

  • Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
  • Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
  • Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
  • Identify recurring customer, access, and patient-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Insights

  • Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, Analytics, and Advocacy.
  • Work seamlessly across field roles to coordinate account strategy, align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and ensure consistent follow-through while respecting functional boundaries.
  • Capture and communicate timely, objective, and actionable field insights that can inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, customer experience, and execution priorities.
  • Contribute actively to business reviews, training programs, team meetings, launch readiness, and cross-functional initiatives; share best practices and support the success of the broader organization.

Entrepreneurial Drive, Resilience & Culture

  • Operate with a high degree of ownership, self-motivation, resourcefulness, and initiative in an unstructured, rapidly evolving rare disease environment.
  • Create appropriate engagement opportunities in underdeveloped accounts and markets, test new approaches, learn quickly, and translate insights into action.
  • Maintain sustained drive, discipline, and performance through pressure, uncertainty, obstacles, delays, and discouragement; recover quickly and remain focused on long-term goals.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning; actively seek feedback and apply coaching to strengthen clinical, strategic, and selling capabilities.
  • Model Mirum's values and the highest standards of ethical conduct, compliance, transparency, inclusion, and respect in every internal and external interaction.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive sales experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently delivering business results in a complex specialty, rare disease, orphan drug, or high-science market.
  • Rare disease experience is highly preferred; experience in hepatology, gastroenterology, pediatric specialty care, or another complex specialty market is highly desirable.
  • Strong clinical aptitude and demonstrated ability to learn, retain, and communicate complex disease-state, diagnostic, mechanism-of-action, clinical-data, and product information.
  • Experience with account-based selling across health systems, centers of excellence, multidisciplinary care teams, referral networks, and influential healthcare professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to use insight-led or challenger-style selling to constructively challenge the status quo, influence behavior, and advance customer decision-making.
  • Working knowledge of access and reimbursement dynamics, patient support pathways, and the role of patient services in rare disease markets.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to interpret performance data, identify insights, develop territory and account strategies, and translate plans into consistent field execution.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, communication, presentation, judgment, and ability to build trust with diverse and highly sophisticated customers.
  • Proven self-motivation, resourcefulness, resilience, organization, and ability to prioritize and perform independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
  • Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, and Analytics.
  • Commitment to ethical conduct, compliance, and approved promotional practices, with sound judgment in complex customer and patient-related situations.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 70%, including frequent overnight travel and occasional weekend commitments.

raw.title: Application Security Engineer
raw.excerpt: At MyFitnessPal, we believe good health starts with what you eat.
raw.description:
At MyFitnessPal, we believe good health starts with what you eat. We provide tools, resources and support to enable users to reach their health goals.

We are looking for a Security Engineer II with a focus on Application Security to join the MyFitnessPal Security team. Our users rely on MyFitnessPal to power their health and fitness journeys every day, and you will leverage your technical skills to secure the code, applications, and development processes that create the MyFitnessPal product experience. In addition to technical expertise, you'll find that your teammates value collaboration, mentorship, and inclusive environments.

About the team:

The Productivity Engineering: Automation & Self-Service (PEAS) team is responsible for the automation, CI/CD, and self-service platforms that product teams rely on to build, test, and ship features quickly and safely.

The PEAS team is part of the Technology Operations (TechOps) organization, which includes IT, Infrastructure, Security, Reliability, and DevOps/DevEx disciplines. TechOps seeks to enable MyFitnessPal to "ship with confidence" by delivering a secure, reliable, and low-friction runway to build and operate software at scale. Within TechOps, you'll represent the Security discipline — protecting the applications and development processes that keep our mobile and backend software safe for millions of users.

Essential Duties:

As a Security Engineer II, you will own the day-to-day operation of our application security vulnerability management program and act as a trusted security partner to product engineering teams. You'll triage what our tooling and researchers find, drive it to remediation, and build the automation that makes the whole program run with less manual effort. This is a hands-on technical position with real ownership and substantial opportunity for growth.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own day-to-day application security vulnerability management: triage findings from SAST, SCA, DAST, and mobile security tooling, assign severity and due dates, propose remediations, and drive tickets through our SVM process to resolution
  • Operate and grow our bug bounty program — scoping engagements, triaging researcher submissions, validating findings, and coordinating with vendors
  • Leverage AI and agentic tooling (for example, Claude Code and agentic pipelines) to accelerate security workflows — from vulnerability triage and enrichment to automated remediation support — and help ensure our AI-assisted development practices remain secure
  • Build and maintain security automation (for example, in our SOAR platform and with Python) that normalizes vulnerability intake, drives notifications and SLAs, and produces the metrics and reporting that keep the program transparent
  • Partner with product engineering teams on remediation — joining triage and refinement discussions, answering questions, and representing security as a business enabler rather than a blocker
  • Perform security reviews of new features, services, and third-party integrations, providing pragmatic, risk-based guidance
  • Advocate secure coding practices and contribute to developer-facing security documentation and training
  • Administer and tune application security tooling across the SDLC, and help evaluate and implement new security technology
  • Support identity and access management workflows and the automation behind them

Qualifications to be successful in this role:

  • 2-4 years of experience in security engineering, application security, software engineering, or a closely related role
  • Understanding of application security assessment techniques (e.g., SAST, DAST, SCA, penetration testing) and the steps to remediate findings
  • Knowledge of secure development practices for web and mobile applications (e.g., OWASP Top 10, OWASP MASVS)
  • Experience working with AI/agentic-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude Code or similar AI coding assistants, LLM-powered workflows, or agentic automation) and enthusiasm for applying it to security work
  • Experience performing security triage, investigation, and vulnerability management, including communicating findings and remediation guidance to engineers
  • Familiarity with auto-scaling cloud microservices and associated technologies (e.g., containerization, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code)
  • Strong communication skills, enabling collaboration across cross-functional teams, and the judgment to raise a security finding and land it as a shared problem to solve, not a fight to win
  • Ability to create documentation that describes technical details clearly, including for non-technical audiences
  • Ability & desire to learn new product lines and technologies quickly & efficiently
  • Education and/or certifications equivalent to BS in Computer Science or IS related field; GIAC (e.g., GWEB, GCIH), OSCP, CSSLP, Security+, or vendor-specific certifications are a plus

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience automating security processes (e.g., Python, SOAR platforms, workflow automation) is strongly preferred
  • Experience with security scanning in CI/CD pipelines and orchestration tools (e.g., GitHub Actions) is a plus
  • Experience operating or triaging for a bug bounty program is a plus

Values you’ll model

  • Be Kind and Care — build with empathy; assume positive intent; support teammates and members.
  • Live Good Health — champion healthy habits and balance in how we work and what we ship.
  • Be Data-Inspired — ground decisions in research and data; measure what matters.
  • Champion Change — lean into ambiguity; iterate, learn, and improve continuously.
  • Leave it Better than You Found It — raise quality, clarify systems, and document as you go.
  • Make It Happen — bias to action; deliver impact with craft and accountability.

The reasonably estimated salary for this role at MyFitnessPal ranges from $90,000 - $130,000. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, MyFitnessPal offers a wide range of comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, parental planning, mental health benefits, annual performance bonus, a 401(k) plan and match, responsible time off, monthly wellness and technology allowances, and others.

Exciting Full-Time Employee Benefits, Perks and Culture

Face-to-Face Connections: We value personal connections. Enjoy opportunities to meet and connect with your team members in person to help forge meaningful relationships that extend beyond the virtual realm. Teams meet as often as needed and all of MyFitnessPal gathers annually.

Flexibility At Its Best: Achieve the work-life balance you deserve. Enjoy a flexible time-off policy with our Responsible Time Off benefit.

Give Back: Use your volunteer days off to support what matters most to you. Each full time teammate receives 2 days per calendar year to give back to their community through service.

Mentorship Program: Take control of your career through our mentorship program where, if you’d like, you will be matched with a teammate who can help you scale your skills and propel your growth.

Family-Friendly Support: Embrace the journey with confidence and care. Enjoy our paid maternity and paternity leave, to provide time to balance family responsibilities with your career and take the time needed to strengthen family relationships. We understand the complexities of starting or expanding a family, which is why we provide best-in-class comprehensive assistance for fertility-related matters.

Wellness Comes First: Live Good Health is one of our core values. Receive a monthly Wellness Allowance, empowering you to focus on your physical and mental well-being by choosing from a range of wellness initiatives, including dedicated mental health days.

Celebrate Greatness:Your hard work deserves recognition! Our reward and recognition platform empowers peers to acknowledge and reward each other for the exceptional contributions they make.

Elevate Your Health & Fitness: Get access to MyFitnessPal Premium, allowing you to take your fitness, health and wellness journey to new heights.

Unlock Your Potential: Access our virtual learning and development library, and participate in training opportunities to continuously grow and enhance your skills.

Championing Inclusion: Our dedicated DEI Committee actively fosters a diverse and inclusive workplace by setting actionable goals and evaluating progress across the organization.

Healthcare Matters: Your well-being is our priority. Take advantage of our competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits that cater to your holistic healthcare needs. Feel secure and supported on your wellness journey.

Secure Your Future: Benefit from our retirement savings program, giving you peace of mind for your financial goals. Reach them sooner with MyFitnessPal’s competitive employer match.

At MyFitnessPal, our mission is to enable people to make healthy choices. And it wouldn't be possible without our team. We celebrate the unique POV that each person brings to the table and believe in a collaborative and inclusive environment. As an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any unlawful discrimination on the basis of race, religion, military or veteran status, sex, gender, marital status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability. These are our guiding ideologies and apply across all aspects of employment.

Description

VAST Data is the data platform company for the AI era. We are building the enterprise software infrastructure to capture, catalog, refine, enrich, and protect massive datasets and make them available for real-time data analysis and AI training and inference. Designed from the ground up to make AI simple to deploy and manage, VAST takes the cost and complexity out of deploying enterprise and AI infrastructure across data center, edge, and cloud. Our success has been built through intense innovation, a customer-first mentality, and a team of fearless VASTronauts who leverage their skills and experiences to make real market impact. This is an opportunity to be a key contributor at a pivotal time in our company’s growth and at a pivotal point in computing history.

We’re looking for a relentless, hands-on Sales Data Management Specialist to safeguard the accuracy and completeness of our global commercial data. In this role, you will combine proactive sales rep engagement, direct Salesforce management, Google Sheets wizardry, and SQL querying. You will serve as the engine powering RevOps data integrity-doing whatever it takes, from placing direct calls to tracking down missing deal details across international teams, to ensure our CRM is clean, structured, and actionable.

This is a hybrid operational and data-driven role, ideal for an assertive go-getter who is fearless about holding sales reps accountable across regions, loves diving into data, and thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth global environment.

What You’ll Do:

Proactive Data Chasing & Rep Engagement (40%)

  • Proactively track down sales reps via calls, Slack, and email to hunt down missing or incomplete deals, deployments, accounts and contacts data.
  • Hold reps accountable to global data entry standards and follow up relentlessly until required fields are populated.
  • Act as the frontline gatekeeper to ensure no opportunity, renewal, or account moves forward without complete data.
  • Drive high urgency around CRM hygiene across global sales teams and regional territories.

Salesforce Updates & Hygiene Management (30%)

  • Update, clean, and maintain key fields across Salesforce Accounts, Opportunities, Contacts, Assets and other objects.
  • Perform routine data audits, bulk updates, and field validations to maintain high data quality standards.
  • Identify missing metadata across active deal pipelines and resolve data discrepancies swiftly.
  • Enforce standardized data entry rules to ensure consistent pipeline and forecast reporting globally.

Google Sheets & SQL Data Operations (30%)

  • Build, maintain, and format advanced Google Sheets to track missing data, audit pipelines, and map inputs.
  • Run simple SQL queries to extract raw data, identify missing records, and cross-reference CRM inputs.
  • Reconcile datasets across systems to ensure Salesforce records match operational source files.
  • Deliver clean, structured datasets to RevOps leadership to support real-time decision-making.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Revenue Operations, Sales Analytics, Field Sales, and Sales Leadership globally to eliminate operational data gaps.
  • Support Deal Desk and Finance teams by ensuring pipeline data is verified before quarter-end closes.
  • Serve as a central point of contact for sales reps needing quick assistance with data updates.

Requirements

  • Experience: 2+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Data Coordination, or a high-volume SDR/BDR role within a global SaaS/tech environment.
  • Proactive & Fearless Mindset: Highly assertive communicator who is comfortable picking up the phone, jumping on calls, and pushing sales reps to get the data needed.
  • Salesforce Proficiency: Direct experience updating fields, managing records, and navigating Salesforce (SFDC) object structures.
  • Spreadsheet Expertise: Advanced proficiency with Google Sheets (XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Pivot Tables, data cleaning formulas).
  • Basic Technical Skills: Ability to write and run simple SQL queries to pull, filter, and cross-reference datasets.
  • Detail Orientation & Tenacity: High attention to detail with an uncompromising drive to see data tasks through to completion across multiple time zones.

  • A track record of turning technical sessions into scoped follow-on engagements — quantifiable in pipeline or expansion revenue, not just satisfaction scores
  • Comfort operating in regulated, enterprise environments, including security and governance review of AI tooling
  • The composure to demo or debug live, in real time, without a script

Strongly Preferred, Not Required

  • Direct experience in banking, financial services, insurance, or another regulated industry
  • Experience as a sales engineer or solutions consultant at an enterprise software or AI company
  • Contributions to internal Anthropic-based tooling — custom MCP servers, shared skill libraries, or agent orchestration frameworks

E por que fazemos tudo isso?

Porque acreditamos que somente um ambiente de crescimento exponencial vai nos fazer chegar aonde queremos: usar a tecnologia para transformar a vida de pessoas, potencializar talentos desperdiçados por falta de acesso e posicionar regiões desprivilegiadas como polos de tecnologia de qualidade.

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★
QuickBooks Financial Controller
Location: Remote — Canada, Central America, South America, or Europe
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
Industry: Interior Design / Professional Services
Compensation:$2,000 – $4,000 USD/month
English Proficiency:C1/C2 English Required
Schedule: Full-Time | Required overlap with U.S. business hours
Reports To: CFO


About the Company
Our client is a U.S.-based luxury interior design firm specializing in bespoke, high-end environments that combine exceptional design, craftsmanship, functionality, and personalized client service.
The company is strengthening its internal finance operations and is looking for an experienced accounting professional who can bring the same level of precision and attention to detail to its financial function.
About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished QuickBooks Financial Controller with deep, hands-on QuickBooks expertise to take ownership of the company's accounting operations.
Reporting directly to the CFO, you will have full responsibility for the General Ledger, lead the transition from an outside accounting firm to a fully in-house accounting function, manage monthly close and reconciliations, prepare financial reporting, and oversee the Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable team.
QuickBooks expertise is essential for this position. This role requires more than day-to-day usage. You must be comfortable configuring and optimizing QuickBooks and have experience with QuickBooks implementations.
This is a hands-on position for someone who is highly accurate, independent, comfortable working in a fast-paced remote environment, and willing to support operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting when needed.
Why This Opportunity?
  • Take full ownership of the company's accounting operations and General Ledger.
  • Become the internal QuickBooks expert for the organization.
  • Work directly with the CFO and play a key role in strengthening the finance function.
  • Lead the transition from outsourced accounting to a fully in-house operation.
  • Manage and improve accounting processes, controls, and reporting.
  • Work remotely with significant autonomy and responsibility.
What You'll Do
QuickBooks & General Ledger
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks to support the company's accounting structure and reporting requirements.
  • Lead or support QuickBooks configuration and implementation initiatives.
  • Lead the transition of the General Ledger from an outside accounting firm to an in-house function.
  • Maintain, reconcile, and close the books monthly.
  • Establish and maintain the Chart of Accounts and appropriate classification standards.
Financial Reporting & Cash Management
  • Prepare accurate financial statements across the company's business divisions.
  • Prepare and review Profit & Loss (P&L) statements.
  • Oversee bank reconciliations.
  • Monitor the company's cash position.
  • Maintain accurate and reliable financial information for CFO review.
Team Leadership & Client Support
  • Supervise Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable specialists.
  • Review and approve invoices, hours reports, and client statements before distribution.
  • Review and approve payroll, vendor payments, and expense submissions.
  • Interface with clients regarding accounting-related requests when required.
  • Ensure accounting work completed by the team meets established standards.
  • Support operational and non-accounting matters that may arise within a small-team environment.
Tax & Accounting Controls
  • Coordinate payroll tax, sales tax, and 1099-related matters.
  • Execute accounting policies established by the CFO accurately and consistently.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a high standard of accuracy.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • Prior experience as a Financial Controller, Senior Accountant, or similar senior accounting professional with full ownership of the General Ledger.
  • Advanced, hands-on QuickBooks expertise.
  • Professional experience with QuickBooks Online and/or QuickBooks Desktop.
  • Experience configuring QuickBooks and/or leading a QuickBooks implementation.
  • Strong experience managing the General Ledger, reconciliations, and month-end close.
  • Experience preparing financial statements and P&L reports.
  • Strong understanding of Chart of Accounts structures and accounting classifications.
  • Experience overseeing or working closely with Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistently low error rates.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to execute accounting policies and procedures with precision.
  • Comfortable supporting operational responsibilities beyond traditional accounting.
  • C1/C2 English proficiency, both written and spoken.
  • Ability to work with required overlap during U.S. business hours.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience transitioning an accounting function from an external accounting firm to an in-house team.
  • Experience with BigTime or similar project accounting software.
  • Previous experience in professional services, interior design, architecture, construction, or project-based businesses.
  • Experience supervising accounting or bookkeeping professionals.
How Success Is Measured
Success in this position will be measured by your ability to:
  • Maintain an accurate and reliable General Ledger.
  • Independently execute reconciliations and month-end close.
  • Configure and optimize QuickBooks according to business requirements.
  • Successfully support the transition to an in-house accounting function.
  • Deliver accurate and timely financial reporting.
  • Maintain strong accounting controls and a consistently low error rate.
  • Effectively oversee AP and AR activities.
  • Work independently while executing CFO policies accurately.
  • Communicate professionally with U.S.-based colleagues and clients.
Video Presentation Required
As part of your application, please submit a short video in English introducing yourself and briefly summarizing your accounting background, followed by a 30-second to 1-minute overview of your QuickBooks experience, including how many years you have used it professionally, whether you have worked with QuickBooks Online and/or Desktop, your main responsibilities in the system, and any experience configuring QuickBooks or leading an implementation.
Why Join Us?
  • $2,000 – $4,000 USD/month, based on experience and location.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Direct exposure to the CFO and company leadership.
  • Significant ownership of the accounting function.
  • Opportunity to lead an important financial operations transition.
  • Long-term, full-time contractor opportunity.
  • Short initial trial period to ensure mutual fit.
Important Notes
Advanced QuickBooks expertise is a core requirement for this position. Basic familiarity, occasional use, or self-taught exposure without substantial professional experience will not be sufficient.
Candidates should be prepared to clearly explain their years of QuickBooks experience, versions used, responsibilities within the system, experience running monthly close, and any QuickBooks configuration or implementation experience.
C1/C2 English is mandatory. The role operates entirely in English with a U.S.-based team and, at times, directly with clients.
This is a permanent, full-time contractor opportunity with a short initial trial period.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

Dental Insurance Specialist Position Summary

As part of our Dental Billing Services (DBS) team, the Insurance Specialist will provide Revenue Cycle Management to dental practices across the country by completing client-elected services such as claim submission, claim follow up, payment posting, and benefit verification with data entry.

Why does this role matter?
DBS provides revenue cycle management for dental practices across the country, so this person has a direct hand in whether our clients get paid accurately and on time. Claim submission, follow-up, payment posting, and benefit verification are the work that keeps a practice financially healthy and doing that work well is a big reason clients stay with us. It's a client-facing role at the center of how DentalXChange simplifies the business of dentistry.

What impact will the new hire have in their first 6 months?
The new hire will start as an Insurance Specialist, learning the DXC core values, our client relationships, and systems. Most importantly, they will learn how we deliver excellence daily, across all scopes of our services which impact our client experience. They will then move into an Account Manager role , where they own the client relationship, oversee the accuracy and timeliness of the work on their accounts, and deliver the monthly ROI reporting and Quarterly Business Reviews that our clients count on. By month six they should be the trusted point of contact for their book of accounts, helping onboard new clients, run audits, and bring newer team members up to speed.

What's the growth trajectory for this position?
Growth is built into the role. The Insurance Specialist role moves to an Account Manager role within a couple of months rather than after a year of tenure.

What You'll Be Doing As Our Dental Insurance Specialist

  • In serving our dental practice clients, complete a variety of dental services within multiple dental practice management software while maintaining PHI and HIPAA standards. Services may include claim submission, claim follow up, payment posting, and benefit verification with data entry.
  • Manage day-to-day client communication and ongoing relationships as it relates to client satisfaction and retention, optimizing practice operations and enhancing profitability.
  • Document all work in forms, spreadsheets and client software, as outlined in our standards.
  • Contact insurance companies to obtain and record accurate and timely information.
  • Send daily summary of tasks completed to dental office staff.

Join Our Team and Make a Difference!

Are you looking for an impactful role where you finish the workday knowing you helped someone? Whether you are part of our care coordination team or play a supporting role, the work our colleagues do every day enables us to collectively reach our mission of getting people the care they need when they need it. By staying committed to our core values of Think Big, Go Fast, Deliver Awe, Win Together and Care Deeply,we can positively impact the lives of the injured workers we serve and get them back to the things that matter most in life.

Salary Range:

This compensation range considers a wide range of factors, including, but not limited to, skill set, experience and training, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate is not adjusted for geographic differential associated with the location where the position may be filled. At One Call, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

What We Provide in Return for Your Commitment to Our Mission
We offer a vast array of benefits to help support the whole you, including:

  • Remote Work: We are a remote-first company, and almost all positions receive the flexibility of working from home.
  • Generous Time Off: Besides 8 company holidays and 2 personal days every year, all colleagues receive a minimum of 18 days of paid time off.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package: Including medical, dental, vision, and pet insurance; 401(k) matching program; and company-paid life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage.
  • Supportive Services: Just like our colleagues get injured workers the care they need when they need it, we want to do the same for our colleagues in their time of need. We offer a Colleague Assistance Program that provides free counseling and financial services, and our One Call Foundation, a non-profit arm of our company, provides colleagues financial assistance during times of unexpected hardships.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Software Engineer is responsible for one or more steps in the development life cycle including designing, coding, testing, implementing, maintaining and supporting software applications used by internal business partners and/or external customers. The Engineer works with business analysts, technical product managers, and other internal business partners to ensure that development tasks are delivered on time and within budget and may provide recommendations for the development of new or updated code.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides application software development services or technical support typically in a defined project.
  • Follows One Call SDLC Standards
  • Develops program logic for new applications or analyzes and modifies logic in existing applications.
  • Codes, tests, debugs, documents, implements and maintains software applications.
  • Maintains, tests and integrates application components.
  • Ensures that system improvements are successfully implemented.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of One Call systems and the workers compensation industry.
  • Participates in Planning and analysis phase of SD projects
  • Analyzes requirements and translates business requirements into product designs.
  • Writes technical specifications and other forms of documentation.
  • Suggests technical alternatives and improves/streamlines processes and systems.
  • Completes project assignments and special projects commensurate with job expectations.
  • Conducts planning, analysis and forecasting activities to plan projects and tasks.
  • May provide leadership and/or guidance to other technical professionals.

EDUCATIONAL AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or the equivalent combination of education, training, or work experience. Additional experience preferences by job level are outlined further below.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Knowledge of end-to-end systems development life cycles (i.e., waterfall, iterative, agile, and other modern approaches to software development)
  • Proficiency in business modeling and requirements definition
  • Excellent customer service skills that build high levels of customer satisfaction for internal and external customers
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to technical and non-technical audiences of various levels in the organization (e.g., executive, management, individual contributors)
  • Willingly shares relevant technical and/or industry knowledge and expertise with other resources
  • Excellent problem-solving and time management skills
  • Resourceful and proactive in gathering information and sharing ideas
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work in an environment that aligns with the company's diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging standards.
  • Ability to work both independently and in a team environment.
  • Demonstrate our core values of Think Big, Go Fast, Deliver Awe, Win Together and Care Deeply.

PHYSICAL/MENTAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • This position will be performed in the colleague’s home. Work-from-home requirements include the colleague’s ability to set up computer equipment within their home office. Occasional in-person team meetings may be required depending on the position.
  • This job is primarily sedentary and may involve repetitive motions; the colleague must be able to remain in a stationary position for extended periods of time, operate a computer and other office equipment, assess information and files stored electronically, and converse/exchange accurate information with others, simultaneously.
  • The colleague must be able to discern text displayed on a monitor, input data into specific fields using a keyboard, and adjust focus to distances of up to three feet.
  • The colleague must have the ability to learn new tasks, follow established processes, maintain focus, complete tasks independently, complete multiple tasks simultaneously, communicate professionally with colleagues and customers, and complete tasks in situations that have a speed or productivity requirement.
  • The colleague must be able to manage moderate to significant mental stress as a result of, but not limited to, a dynamic and heavy workload.

Please be advised that job descriptions typically change over time as business needs, job requirements, and employee skill levels change. As such, One Call retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time.

Software Engineer

Entry level professional role. Basic skills with moderate level of proficiency. Has general understanding of principles in one or more programming languages and at least one system development life cycle model. Generally performs single-function tasks that tend to be of small to moderate size and scope. Works independently under close to moderate supervision. raw.excerpt: TechOps Engineer - Senior About the Role? We're hiring a Senior TechOps Engineer to own the reliability, security, and automation backbone of our contact center technology platform.
raw.description:
TechOps Engineer - Senior

About the Role?

We're hiring a Senior TechOps Engineer to own the reliability, security, and automation backbone of our contact center technology platform. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role for someone who thinks architecturally, moves decisively, and takes genuine pride in the systems they build. You'll set the technical direction for our infrastructure, mentor a growing team, and be the person who prevents problems before they become incidents.

What do we do?

ACD Direct, Inc. is an innovative, virtual company that thrives on brokering solutions for our non-profit clients. ACD’s heartbeat and competitive edge is powered by our people. Our company has grown from providing routine call center services to providing high-level, full-scale donor support resources and products. Our proprietary scripting engine, web forms and custom-built reporting enable clients to successfully conduct large-scale fundraising campaigns with accuracy and creativity. ACD is a B2B Contact Center Technology company building and operating the infrastructure that keeps modern contact centers running at scale. Our platform is cloud-native, security-first, and built by a fully distributed team spread across the United States. We move fast, document everything, and treat operational excellence as a core value - not an afterthought.

Limitations:

Applicant preferred to be located within a 50 mile radius of Salt Lake City, Utah. Although position is remote employee will be required to visit data center on a quarterly basis. It is not required for the employee to be located in the state of Utah.

What will you do?

  • Design and implement robust CI/CD frameworks for serverless and containerized (Kubernetes/Docker) applications.
  • Lead the transition to fully versioned infrastructure - owning IaC strategy using Terraform, Pulumi, or Bicep to ensure environment parity and rapid recovery.
  • Own the availability, performance, and survivability of production environments; define and monitor SLOs/SLIs to maintain 99.9%+ uptime targets.
  • Serve as the primary owner of the organization's security posture - implement automated vulnerability scanning, IAM least-privilege policies, and audit logging for strict PCI DSS compliance.
  • Partner with QA and Software Engineering leads to embed DevSecOps practices into the early stages of the SDLC.
  • Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) for complex system failures and drive implementation of preventative automations to eliminate repeat incidents.
  • Architect and improve monitoring, alerting, and observability tooling across all production and non-production environments.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level TechOps engineers - conducting code/config reviews, sharing expertise, and contributing to team capability development.
  • Champion TechOps best practices across the team; set the documentation and process standards others follow.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate new technologies and deliver infrastructure roadmap items on time.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Systems Engineering.
  • Deep expertise with CI/CD pipelines and release automation across complex, multi-environment systems.
  • Strong cloud platform mastery (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - you can architect a solution and then build it.
  • Expert-level Kubernetes experience; comfortable designing and troubleshooting production container workloads.
  • Advanced IaC proficiency using Terraform, Pulumi, Bicep, or equivalent - you treat infrastructure like software.
  • Demonstrated experience owning PCI DSS compliance for a production environment.
  • Strong background in security engineering: IAM, vulnerability management, automated scanning, and audit logging.
  • Ability to define and track SLOs/SLIs and translate reliability data into infrastructure improvements.
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and raising the overall skill level of a team.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; you can explain trade-offs to engineers and business stakeholders alike.
  • Self-directed and highly organized - thrives in a fully remote, async-first environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with contact center platforms (Genesys, Five9, Amazon Connect, Twilio, or similar).
  • Exposure to SMS/telecom infrastructure and carrier APIs.
  • Background in B2B SaaS or telecom infrastructure environments.
  • Contributions to open-source DevOps or infrastructure tooling.
  • Certifications in AWS, Azure, GCP, or Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD).

Leadership and Scope

As our Senior TechOps Engineer, you'll have broad scope and genuine ownership - not just execution tickets. You'll drive architectural decisions, define standards the rest of the team follows, and be an active voice in shaping our infrastructure roadmap. We're a lean team, which means your fingerprints will be on everything. That's a feature, not a bug. This role reports directly to the Technology Operations Manager and works closely with Engineering and Security leadership. You will be the go-to infrastructure authority for the organization.

How we will support you?

Salary:

  • $86,000-100,000/yr depending on experience level

- Remote and Inoffice Work

- Equipment Provided:

  • Laptop
  • Headset
  • Monthly Cell Phone Stipend
  • Monthly Internet Stipend

- Benefits:

  • Medical/Vision and Dental Insurance
  • Personal Accident Insurance
  • 401(k)/Roth with matching
  • Tiered PTO based upon length of employment
  • Discounts & Life Services offered through Optum EAP

- Team Environment – The opportunity to work with a great team who strives for excellence, where the average tenure is well over 6 years. (Not bad for a company who has been in business for 20 years!)

**ACD Direct, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate based on any status protected under federal, state, or local law. We are a fully remote company. Our team spans every U.S. time zone and we are committed to building an inclusive, async-friendly culture where great work speaks for itself.

raw.description:
Sagility combines industry-leading technology and transformation-driven BPM services with decades of healthcare domain expertise to help clients draw closer to their members. The company optimizes the entire member/patient experience through service offerings for clinical, case management, member engagement, provider solutions, payment integrity, claims cost containment, and analytics. Sagility has more than 25,000 employees across 5 countries.

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Clinical Operations Supervisor / Team Lead to lead a team of Registered Nurses (RNs) and/or Care Coaches supporting Care Management programs. This position is responsible for driving operational performance, quality outcomes, member satisfaction, employee engagement, compliance, and workforce effectiveness while fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and servant leadership.
The Supervisor serves as the frontline leader for daily operations and is responsible for coaching, mentoring, developing, and supporting associates to meet client expectations, operational goals, quality standards, and regulatory requirements. This role acts as a key liaison between frontline staff and leadership while collaborating closely with Workforce Management, Quality, Training, Compliance, Human Resources, and Business Operations teams.
The ideal candidate is a strong people leader who combines operational excellence, data-driven decision making, effective coaching techniques, and a passion for employee development and member outcomes. Relevant operational frameworks, coaching resources, team lead standards, mentoring tools, and care management support materials are commonly used within the program to drive consistency and performance.
Depending on business needs, the Team Lead may operate in a dual Team Lead/Trainer capacity, supporting new hire classes during Training, OJT, and Nesting before transitioning to full operational leadership responsibilities. This model promotes continuity of support, accelerates associate readiness, and strengthens new hire success throughout the employee lifecycle.

Job title:

RN Supervisor - Care Management (Temporary/Seasonal)

Job Description:

Operational Leadership

  • Oversee day-to-day operations of a team of RNs and/or Care Coaches supporting Humana programs.
  • Serve as the first point of escalation for associate questions, process concerns, member issues, and system-related challenges.
  • Monitor productivity, quality, attendance, adherence, member engagement, service levels, and operational performance metrics.
  • Ensure team compliance with client, company, CMS, HIPAA, and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage staffing coverage, queue performance, and workload distribution to achieve operational goals.
  • Support workforce and attendance management activities through timely communication of staffing concerns and schedule variances.
  • Verify associate readiness, system functionality, and connectivity prior to shift start and escalate issues as needed.
  • Provide real-time support and guidance to associates regarding workflows, policies, systems, and member interactions.
  • Provide virtual support and maintain awareness of team performance, engagement, and operational needs throughout the workday.
  • Identify operational risks, performance barriers, and workflow inefficiencies and implement corrective actions.
  • Support audits, client requests, compliance reviews, and operational readiness activities.

Performance Management & Coaching

  • Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly performance metrics using dashboards, reports, and operational tools.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one coaching focused on productivity, quality, documentation accuracy, compliance, attendance, and member experience.
  • Complete coaching documentation and maintain accurate employee performance records.
  • Develop and track action plans for underperforming associates.
  • Lead performance improvement plans, corrective actions, attendance management activities, and disciplinary processes when necessary.
  • Recognize and reward top performers to support employee engagement and retention.
  • Conduct performance evaluations and talent assessments.
  • Utilize root cause analysis and performance trends to drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Clinical Quality & Member Outcomes

  • Ensure adherence to care management workflows, call handling standards, clinical documentation requirements, and member engagement practices.
  • Partner with Quality and Training teams to identify performance trends and improve outcomes.
  • Participate in calibration sessions to ensure consistency in quality expectations and scoring methodologies.
  • Drive improvements in member satisfaction, quality scores, compliance metrics, and client performance indicators.
  • Reinforce best practices related to care plans, assessments, outreach, and documentation standards.

Employee Development & Engagement

  • Develop and maintain Individual Development Plans (IDPs) for assigned associates.
  • Identify and cultivate future leaders, mentors, trainers, and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
  • Support onboarding, mentoring, nesting, and production readiness activities for new associates.
  • Conduct team huddles, engagement activities, recognition events, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team culture.
  • Partner with associates to achieve career development and professional growth goals.
  • May occasionally serve as an interim trainer or facilitator for new hire classes, refresher training sessions, process updates, remediation training, and operational readiness programs.
  • Collaborate with Training and Operations leadership to reinforce curriculum objectives and ensure successful transition of new hires into production environments.
  • Support onboarding, nesting, and production readiness activities for new hires, ensuring a successful transition from training to independent production.
  • May serve in a dual-purpose Team Lead/Trainer capacity based on business needs, supporting both training and operational functions.
  • Deliver or facilitate portions of new hire training, refresher sessions, process updates, and remediation training as assigned.
  • Provide ongoing coaching and performance support during Training, OJT, Nesting, and Early Production phases.
  • Partner closely with Training teams to monitor learner progress, identify knowledge gaps, and implement development plans to improve readiness.
  • Serve as a consistent point of contact for assigned new hire waves from training through production to promote continuity, engagement, and performance success.
  • Support onboarding and production certification activities to ensure associates meet program readiness and compliance requirements prior to independent production.
  • Collaborate with Trainers, Mentors, SMEs, and Operations Leadership to ensure a seamless transition from classroom learning to production environments.
  • Identify and escalate learner performance concerns, behavioral issues, attendance challenges, or readiness risks that may impact operational success.
  • Facilitate knowledge-sharing sessions, best-practice discussions, and peer learning opportunities to strengthen team capability and performance.

Communication & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Cascade process updates, client communications, policy changes, and operational announcements in a timely manner.
  • Serve as a liaison between frontline staff and leadership.
  • Collaborate with Workforce Management, Quality, Training, HR, Compliance, Business Excellence, and Operations teams.
  • Participate in leadership meetings, calibration sessions, governance reviews, and client discussions as needed.
  • Escalate business risks, concerns, and operational issues proactively.
  • Promote alignment across teams and geographies to ensure consistency in execution and performance.

Administrative Responsibilities

  • Complete and maintain required operational documentation, including:
    • Weekly coaching logs
    • Team huddle agendas
    • Performance reviews
    • Attendance tracking
    • Corrective action documentation
    • Individual Development Plans
    • Annual performance evaluations
    • Client and operational reporting requests
  • Maintain accurate associate records and compliance documentation.
  • Ensure timely completion of all assigned administrative tasks and deliverables.

Required Qualifications

Education

Required:

  • Active unrestricted U.S. Registered Nurse (RN) License

Experience

Required:

  • Minimum two (2) years of post-licensure clinical experience.
  • Minimum one (1) year of leadership, mentoring, coaching, Team Lead, or supervisory experience.
  • Experience working in healthcare operations, BPO’s, care management, case management, disease management, utilization management, or a contact center environment.

Preferred:

  • Previous experience supporting Medicare Advantage, SNP, Medicaid, or managed care populations.
  • Experience leading remote, hybrid, or geographically dispersed teams.
  • Experience facilitating training sessions, new hire onboarding, or classroom instruction.
  • Experience serving as a Trainer, SME, Mentor, Team Lead, or Supervisor within a healthcare environment.

Knowledge, Skills & Competencies

Leadership & People Management

  • Strong coaching, mentoring, and employee development skills.
  • Ability to lead difficult conversations with professionalism and consistency.
  • Proven ability to manage performance, engagement, and accountability.

Operational Excellence

  • Strong understanding of productivity, quality, attendance, adherence, service levels, and workforce management principles.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Analytical & Problem Solving

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends, assess risks, and implement effective solutions.
  • Proficiency in performance reporting and data-driven decision making.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across multiple departments and levels of leadership.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, reporting tools, workforce management applications, and operational dashboards.
  • Ability to learn and navigate multiple healthcare systems and client platforms.

Success in This Role Means

  • Delivering strong quality, productivity, adherence, and member outcome results.
  • Building an engaged, high-performing team culture.
  • Developing future leaders, SMEs, and trainers.
  • Ensuring compliance with client and regulatory requirements.
  • Driving continuous improvement through coaching, collaboration, and operational excellence.

raw.description:
About Avalere Health

United by one profound purpose: to reach EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.
Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.
Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.
Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We are an accredited Fertility Friendly employer with our Fertility Policy, enhanced parental leave, and culture of flexibility ensuring every employee feels supported across their family planning journey and can work in a way that suits their family’s needs.
We are deeply invested in supporting professional growth for our employees through day-to-day career experiences, access to thousands of on-demand training sessions, regular career conversations, and the opportunity for global, cross-capability career moves.
We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

About the role

The Operations Manager is part of Avalere Health’s Corporate Marketing Team, which is responsible for developing and delivering the corporate brand, thought leadership, PR, and integrated marketing activity. The role partners closely with digital specialists to ensure the platforms, systems, and data underpinning integrated campaigns operate reliably and efficiently, supporting increased awareness, strengthened reputation, and commercial opportunities.

Reporting to the Associate Director of Corporate Marketing, this role is accountable for the operational infrastructure that enables the wider team to deliver against the marketing goals of the Group corporate brand, as well as Avalere Health's three capabilities – Advisory, Medical, and Marketing.

The role is central to the effective functioning of Corporate Marketing, providing the team with the platform integration, resourcing visibility and performance insight required to plan and deliver on strategic goals with confidence.

What You'll Do

Operational excellence and process management

  • Develop a culture and processes of operational excellence within the Corporate Marketing team, leading on all Corporate Marketing process development and implementation.

  • Understand, evaluate, develop, and recommend project management and workflow processes that support the prioritization of tasks and improve efficiency and team collaboration.

  • Lead efforts to identify templates, tools, and resources — including applications for Artificial Intelligence — that could streamline campaign creation, simplify review processes, and improve the quality and efficiency of the team's work.

Internal partnerships and resource management

  • Manage how Corporate Marketing projects are resourced out to partner teams, including digital and creative teams.

  • Act as the central point of contact for coordinating resource requests with partner teams, ensuring requests are scoped clearly, timelines are realistic, and work is tracked through to delivery.

  • Maintain visibility of resourcing commitments across active projects, flagging conflicts or bottlenecks with partner team capacity early enough to inform planning.

  • Support prioritization discussions with accurate, up-to-date information on resourcing status and lead times from partner teams.

  • Act as the central point of coordination across Corporate Marketing, building strong working relationships with digital specialists, creatives and senior stakeholders across the business.

  • Balance competing operational demands while maintaining consistency and reliability across the team's systems.

Performance, metrics, and reporting

  • Manage and optimize metrics and ROI reporting for Marketing projects, including LinkedIn performance, paid campaigns, internal comms, and website traffic.

  • Enhance year-on-year campaign performance tracking for easy comparison and to inform future planning.

  • Review performance metrics regularly, interpreting the data to identify trends, areas for improvement, and possible correlations with external factors such as media coverage or world events.

  • Translating performance data into actionable insights that informs ongoing optimization and strategic decision-making.

Marketing technology (MarTech) and digital platform management

  • Manage MarTech systems day-to-day, including maintenance, optimizing usage, contracting and renewals, and scoping and implementing new systems as needed.

  • Understand, evaluate, and evolve the MarTech ecosystem, looking for tools that may offer improvements, new benefits, or cost savings compared to existing tools and processes.

  • Partner with the Digital Team to project manage new digital projects for the corporate brand, from planning to execution, including website updates, CMS management and uploads, SEO/SEM, eventual CRM development, and other projects with the digital team as needed.

  • Partner with digital specialists to drive SEO, GEO, and ad word strategy, ensuring content and campaigns achieve appropriate visibility with target audiences.

Business development support

  • Support the CRM integration project, partnering with our digital specialists to ensure the correct information surfaces on the platform.

  • Manage and optimize the leads process with BD teams.

Content and events operations

  • Project manage the next series of the Within Reach podcast, working with our producer to run the podcast from guest selection to scheduling, coordination, and publication.

  • Project manage marketing campaigns, including scoping resources, developing project plans and timelines, and ensuring smooth campaign development.

  • Support the Associate Director to manage internal Town Halls, ensuring internal events are delivered smoothly.

  • Support the Associate Director as needed with copywriting, editing, visual asset development, social post scheduling, Marketo builds and scheduling, and other associated tasks.

About You

  • Proven experience in a marketing operations, digital marketing, or campaign management role, ideally within healthcare, life sciences, or professional services.

  • Working knowledge of marketing automation and MarTech platforms (Marketo or equivalent, Bitly, Google Analytics), website CMS environments, and paid social/search advertising (Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads).

  • Experience with CRM systems and an understanding of how marketing and CRM data connect.

  • Working knowledge of SEO/SEM fundamentals; familiarity with GEO (generative engine optimization) is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations and identify trends and correlations across data sets.

  • Experience developing and improving operational processes, workflows, and resourcing models, with a view towards operational maturity.

  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple platforms, projects, and stakeholders concurrently.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with specialist functions and senior stakeholders.

  • Strong writing and editing skills, with comfort supporting copy-focused tasks across corporate and internal communications.

  • Experience using AI-enabled tools to improve marketing effectiveness and team productivity.

What we can offer

You'll receive up to a 7% pension contribution, life insurance, income protection, and private medical insurance for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including flexible hybrid working, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 25 days of annual leave plus two personal well-being days, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.
Access free counselling through our employee assistance program, as well as personalized health support. Enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey, as well as on-demand support from our partner Peppy. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.
We encourage all applicants to read our candidate privacy noticebefore applying to Avalere Health.

Location: Remote (United States)

Work Model: Remote

Industry: AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)

Compensation: $35–$50 per hour

About the Company

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity

This is a backend engineering internship on the systems that carry real product workflows. Candidate data arrives messy and at volume, has to be modelled well enough to search and score against, and then has to move reliably through jobs, integrations, and APIs that other parts of the product depend on. You will build and extend those systems, and you will be the one who finds out when they are wrong.

The work is a good fit for someone who enjoys correctness and reliability: designing a schema that will still make sense in six months, making a background job idempotent, or tracing a bad record back through three services to its source. Because the team is small, you will own services rather than tickets, and your work will be in production quickly.

Responsibilities

  • Build and extend backend services, APIs, and the data models behind them.
  • Design and maintain database schemas that support search, scoring, and reporting.
  • Build background jobs and integrations, and make them reliable enough to run unattended.
  • Investigate data quality and correctness issues, and fix them at the source.
  • Write code other engineers can read and extend, and review theirs.

Requirements

  • Strong programming fundamentals in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or a similar language.
  • Comfort learning backend systems, APIs, databases, and data modelling.
  • Interest in building reliable systems that support real product workflows.
  • Has shipped meaningful work before, whether side projects, class projects, open-source contributions, or a prior internship.
  • Strong problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn quickly.
  • Clear communicator who can work independently in a remote environment.
