raw.description:
★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Account Executive – Influencer Marketing

Location: Remote — Mexico
Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
Employment Type: Full-Time (Contractor)
Number of Openings: 1 Position
Industry: Influencer Marketing / Marketing Technology / Advertising
Compensation:$1,000 – $2,000 USD/month base + uncapped variable compensation (OTE approximately 50/50)
Experience: 2+ years
Languages: Native Spanish + Professional English
Travel: Occasional travel for key brand meetings
Start Date: As Soon As Possible

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing influencer marketing and creator technology company helping consumer brands across Latin America manage creator partnerships and campaigns more efficiently.

Its technology brings the influencer marketing workflow into a single platform, supporting areas such as creator discovery, campaign management, content review, contracts, payments, CRM, and performance analytics. The company combines technology, AI-powered capabilities, and a curated creator network to help brands execute UGC and influencer campaigns from initial brief through final delivery.

Operating in the rapidly evolving creator economy, the company is building a more scalable and technology-driven way for brands to work with creators across Latin America.

About the Role

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Brand Partnerships Lead to become the company's first dedicated sales hire and help build its commercial engine across Spanish-speaking Latin America.

This is a true full-cycle sales role. You will prospect, qualify, run discovery, develop proposals with operations, negotiate, close, and manage your accounts through their first renewals and early expansion.

You'll also work directly with the founder to build the commercial playbook from the ground up. This is not a role for someone waiting for inbound leads or a finished sales process. You'll be expected to create pipeline, close business, experiment, document what works, and use AI to automate repetitive parts of your workflow.

What You'll Do

Build & Own Your Pipeline

  • Build your own pipeline of consumer brands, particularly across beauty, personal care, and CPG.

  • Prospect brand managers, marketing directors, and other relevant decision-makers across Spanish-speaking Latin American markets.

  • Own outbound prospecting and consistently generate your own meetings.

  • Use email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and other relevant channels to move opportunities forward.

Run Full-Cycle Sales

  • Conduct consultative discovery to understand each brand's objectives and marketing needs.

  • Work with operations to design the right creator seeding or influencer marketing program.

  • Prepare proposals, present solutions, negotiate contracts, and close new business.

  • Own accounts through their initial renewals and early expansion before transitioning consolidated relationships.

Build an AI-Native Sales Process

  • Use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar AI platforms as part of your daily sales workflow.

  • Build your own automations for account research, call preparation, follow-ups, reporting, and other repeatable processes.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to automate administrative work so you can focus on high-value sales conversations.

Build the Commercial Playbook

  • Work directly with the founder to develop the company's sales methodology.

  • Document objections, outbound sequences, follow-up strategies, call learnings, and best practices.

  • Help create the commercial foundation that future sales hires will use.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience selling media, agency services, influencer marketing, martech solutions, or similar services to brand teams in Latin America.

  • Proven sales performance against quota, with the ability to discuss previous results using specific numbers.

  • Strong experience self-sourcing pipeline and personally prospecting for new business.

  • Experience managing a full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and closing.

  • Experience selling directly to brand managers, marketing leaders, or similar decision-makers.

  • Native Spanish.

  • Professional English for working with tools and documentation in both languages.

  • Strong understanding of WhatsApp as a professional sales channel, including follow-up and deal progression.

  • Genuine daily use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or similar platforms.

  • Ability to demonstrate real examples of how you have automated or improved parts of your sales process using AI.

  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-moving remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling to beauty, personal care, CPG, or other consumer brands.

  • Background in influencer marketing, creator economy, UGC, digital media, or marketing technology.

  • Existing relationships with marketing decision-makers in Latin America.

  • Experience working in an early-stage startup or entrepreneurial environment.

This Role Is NOT for You If...

  • You depend on someone else to fill your calendar with meetings.

  • You haven't personally prospected for new business within the last year.

  • You're looking to manage a sales team before proving you can personally sell.

  • You expect to receive a finished sales playbook instead of helping build one.

  • You're uncomfortable experimenting with AI and automation as part of your daily workflow.

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

During the selection process, we will pay particular attention to:

  • Verifiable quota attainment and sales results.

  • Ability to consistently generate self-sourced pipeline.

  • Full-cycle closing experience.

  • Experience selling marketing-related solutions to LATAM brands.

  • Consultative selling and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to sell naturally through WhatsApp.

  • Practical, demonstrable use of AI and automation in sales.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset, ownership, and independence.

What Success Looks Like

  • You consistently generate qualified opportunities without relying on inbound leads.

  • You build relationships with relevant consumer brands across target markets.

  • Opportunities progress effectively from discovery through proposal and close.

  • New accounts successfully reach their first renewals and expansion opportunities.

  • Repetitive sales activities are increasingly automated.

  • Your documented processes become the foundation of a scalable commercial playbook.

Why Join Us?

  • Become the first dedicated sales hire and have a direct impact on how the commercial organization is built.

  • Work closely with the founder throughout the sales process.

  • Join a technology-driven company operating at the intersection of AI, influencer marketing, and the creator economy.

  • Build processes rather than simply inherit them.

  • Fully remote work across Latin America.

  • Base salary plus uncapped variable compensation, with OTE structured approximately 50/50.

  • Occasional travel for important brand meetings.

Important Notes

  • This is a highly hands-on individual contributor sales role.

  • Candidates must have personally prospected for new business within the last year.

  • Candidates should be prepared to discuss previous quota performance and sales results with specific numbers.

  • Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate how they currently use AI and automation in their sales workflow.

  • This position requires significant ownership of pipeline generation, closing, and early account development.

This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

title: Solutions Engineer
description: Canvas Medical is accelerating everyday medicine with an EMR platform built for healthcare automation.

raw.title: Solutions Engineer
raw.excerpt: Canvas Medical is accelerating everyday medicine with an EMR platform built for healthcare automation.
raw.description:
Canvas Medical is accelerating everyday medicine with an EMR platform built for healthcare automation. We create modern, elegant front- and back-end tooling to enable new ways for developers and clinicians to integrate data, automate workflows, and collaborate to solve healthcare's toughest challenges. In doing so we advance our mission to give care teams superpowers with software.
Canvas is institutionally backed by some of the greatest technology investors in the world (funded notable health tech companies such as GoodRx, Oscar Health, and Hims & Hers Health).
Role Description
We're hiring a Solutions Engineer to join our Engineering team and build the technical bridge between customer needs and platform capabilities. This role is the engineering counterpart to our Solutions Consultants—where they translate customer needs into requirements, you'll transform those requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions that push the boundaries of our platform.
As a Solutions Engineer, you'll architect and implement custom solutions using the Canvas SDK, build reusable plugins and integrations, and extend our platform's capabilities to meet complex healthcare automation challenges. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to prototype rapidly, validate technical approaches, and deliver production-ready solutions that delight customers. This is a builder role where you'll directly impact how healthcare providers leverage our EMR platform while contributing to the evolution of our developer tools and SDK.
The ideal candidate brings strong engineering fundamentals, passion for healthcare technology, and exceptional ability to navigate between rapid prototyping and production-quality code. You'll thrive in collaborative environments, balance customer urgency with engineering excellence, and drive technical decisions that scale. We're looking for someone who experiments fearlessly, iterates quickly, and can build elegant solutions from the ground up while maintaining the robustness required for healthcare systems.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Solution Development
  • Build production-ready solutions using the Canvas SDK, demonstrating mastery of event-driven architectures, handlers, and effects
  • Transform PRDs from Solutions Consultants into elegant, maintainable code that solves real healthcare workflow challenges
  • Create robust plugins and integrations that extend platform capabilities while maintaining HIPAA compliance and clinical documentation standards
  • Develop and maintain a library of reusable components and patterns that accelerate future solution delivery
  • Platform Enhancement & Innovation
  • Identify gaps in SDK capabilities and contribute directly to platform improvements through pull requests and feature development
  • Design and implement new SDK features that enable broader solution patterns across the customer base
  • Build developer tools and utilities that improve the efficiency of both internal teams and external developers
  • Create technical documentation, integration guides, and reference implementations for complex solutions
  • Cross-Functional Technical Leadership
  • Partner with Solutions Consultants to validate technical feasibility and architect optimal approaches
  • Collaborate with core engineering teams to align custom solutions with platform roadmap and architectural standards
  • Enable customer success through technical workshops, debugging sessions, and solution handoffs
  • Mentor Solutions Consultants on technical concepts and best practices for SDK usage

Qualifications

  • Required Experience & Background
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 2+ years of professional software development experience with modern web stacks
  • Demonstrated ability to build end-to-end solutions from requirements to production deployment
  • Strong problem-solving skills with ability to navigate ambiguous technical challenges
  • Technical Skills & Capabilities
  • Proficiency in Python is mandatory.
  • JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks (React preferred) are a bonus.
  • Experience with API design, event-driven architectures, and plugin-based systems
  • Strong understanding of software design patterns, testing practices, and code maintainability
  • Comfort with rapid prototyping while maintaining production-quality standards
  • Experience with version control, CI/CD pipelines, and modern development workflows
  • Healthcare & Domain Expertise
  • Interest in healthcare technology and improving clinical workflows through automation
  • Understanding of healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7) or willingness to learn quickly
  • Ability to translate clinical requirements into technical architecture decisions
  • Appreciation for the complexity and criticality of healthcare systems
  • Personal Attributes
  • Builder mentality—passionate about creating solutions that directly impact users
  • Collaborative approach to problem-solving with strong communication skills
  • Growth mindset with ability to learn new technologies and domains rapidly
  • Pragmatic engineering approach—knows when to build for today versus tomorrow
  • Customer empathy with drive to understand and solve real user problems
  • Nice-to-Have Qualifications
  • Experience building or maintaining SDKs, developer tools, or platform products
  • Background in healthcare IT, EMR integrations, or clinical systems
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements (HIPAA, FDA guidelines) for healthcare software
  • Experience with Python for backend services or data processing
  • Prior experience in customer-facing engineering or solutions architecture roles
  • Contributions to open-source projects or technical community engagement

What Success Looks Like at 90 Days

  • Ship 5+ production-ready solutions that demonstrate deep understanding of the Canvas SDK and platform capabilities
  • Contribute at least 2 meaningful enhancements to the SDK or developer tools based on customer solution needs
  • Establish strong working relationships with Solutions Consultants and become go-to technical partner for complex implementations
  • Create technical documentation and reference implementations that enable self-service solution development

Growth Path

Solutions Engineers at Canvas have multiple growth trajectories. Within 12-18 months, high performers evolve into senior solutions engineers who architect our most complex customer implementations and drive platform strategy. Many transition into core platform engineering roles, bringing deep customer context to shape product development. Others grow into technical leadership positions, building and scaling our solutions engineering practice. This role offers unique exposure to both customer challenges and platform internals, positioning you to influence Canvas's technical direction and healthcare impact.

Location

Remote/San Francisco/Washington DC
We are a fully remote, distributed team but encourage in-person collaboration in our office in San Francisco, or one of our satellite locations which for this role is in Washington DC. We encourage people to do their work when and where they perform at their best. Because of this structure, strong written communication skills, time management skills, and personal accountability are very important to us.
Canvas Medical provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
Research shows that women and other minority groups might avoid applying if they don't meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet everything listed in the job posting.

raw.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

About the Role

We're looking for a Communications Associate who can help shape how ActAI is introduced to the world.

You will develop our external narrative, work closely with founders and leadership, build relationships with global media, and ensure every public communication reflects the quality and ambition of the company.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be writing, editing, pitching stories, preparing announcements and working directly with senior leaders on communications strategy.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Develop and execute ActAI's global communications strategy.

  • Build relationships with technology, business and mainstream media.

  • Develop media angles and proactively secure high-quality press coverage.

  • Write and edit press releases, announcements, company updates and executive communications.

  • Shape company messaging, positioning and product narratives.

  • Prepare founders and executives for media interviews, conferences and public appearances.

  • Develop communication plans around product launches, partnerships and major company milestones.

  • Monitor media coverage and identify opportunities to strengthen A1's brand.

  • Work closely with product, recruiting and leadership teams to ensure consistent external messaging.

  • Support crisis communications and reputation management when required.

What You Will Need

  • Experience in PR, corporate communications or media relations within technology companies.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills with the ability to explain complex products clearly.

  • Strong relationships with technology and business journalists.

  • Experience managing communications for product launches or major announcements.

  • Excellent judgement and ability to develop compelling narratives.

  • Comfortable working directly with founders and senior leadership.

  • Able to operate independently in a fast-moving environment with minimal direction.

  • Strong attention to detail and high standards for quality.

raw.excerpt: Position Summary The Construction Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, monitoring, and updating project schedules to support the successful delivery of construction projects.
raw.description:
Position Summary

The Construction Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, monitoring, and updating project schedules to support the successful delivery of construction projects. This position works closely with project managers, superintendents, engineers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients to establish realistic project timelines, track progress, identify potential delays, and support timely project completion.

The Construction Scheduler plays a key role in providing accurate schedule information to the project team and management, identifying schedule risks, and supporting recovery plans when projects fall behind schedule.

Key Responsibilities

Project Scheduling

  • Develop detailed baseline schedules for construction projects in accordance with contract requirements and project objectives.
  • Create and maintain project schedules covering engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout activities as applicable.
  • Develop activity sequences, durations, logic relationships, milestones, and critical path activities.
  • Coordinate schedule development with project managers, superintendents, engineers, subcontractors, and other project stakeholders.
  • Ensure schedules accurately reflect project scope, contract requirements, and planned construction methods.
  • Establish and maintain appropriate schedule coding, calendars, work breakdown structures, and activity classifications.

Schedule Updates & Progress Tracking

  • Update project schedules regularly based on actual field progress and information provided by the project team.
  • Collect and verify progress information from field personnel, subcontractors, vendors, and other stakeholders.
  • Track actual start and finish dates, remaining durations, percentage complete, quantities, and milestones.
  • Compare planned progress against actual progress and identify variances.
  • Maintain accurate records of schedule changes, revisions, and project milestones.

Schedule Analysis

  • Monitor the critical path and near-critical activities.
  • Identify potential delays, schedule risks, and impacts to project milestones.
  • Perform schedule variance and trend analysis.
  • Evaluate the impact of changes, RFIs, submittals, procurement issues, design changes, weather events, and other factors affecting the schedule.
  • Provide recommendations to the project team regarding schedule mitigation and recovery strategies.
  • Assist with time-impact analysis and extension-of-time evaluations when required.

Coordination & Reporting

  • Work closely with project management and field operations to ensure schedule information reflects current project conditions.
  • Participate in project coordination, progress, and scheduling meetings.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly schedule reports for project management and clients.
  • Provide schedule updates, look-ahead schedules, milestone reports, and critical-path analyses.
  • Communicate schedule changes and potential impacts to relevant project stakeholders.
  • Assist project managers and superintendents with short-term planning and sequencing.

Look-Ahead Planning

  • Develop and maintain detailed short-term and look-ahead schedules.
  • Coordinate upcoming activities with field supervision and subcontractors.
  • Identify constraints that could prevent planned work from progressing.
  • Track required materials, manpower, equipment, inspections, approvals, and other prerequisites.
  • Assist the project team in developing recovery schedules when required.

Change Management

  • Incorporate approved change orders, design changes, scope changes, and other modifications into project schedules.
  • Assess schedule impacts associated with changes and delays.
  • Maintain a clear record of schedule revisions and changes to key milestones.
  • Coordinate with project controls and commercial teams regarding schedule impacts on cost and contract requirements.

Project Closeout

  • Track completion of outstanding construction activities, inspections, punch-list items, commissioning, and turnover requirements.
  • Maintain the schedule through project completion and closeout.
  • Support the preparation of final schedule reports and project documentation.
  • Assist with collecting schedule information for lessons learned and historical project data.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Project Management, Business, or a related field is preferred.
  • 3–7 years of experience in construction scheduling, project controls, construction management, or a related field.
  • Experience developing and maintaining construction schedules for commercial, industrial, civil, infrastructure, or other construction projects.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, project execution, and scheduling principles.
  • Experience with scheduling software such as Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, or equivalent scheduling platforms.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, contracts, and project documentation.
  • Understanding of critical path methodology and schedule logic.
  • Experience with progress measurement and schedule performance reporting.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Project or Primavera P6 is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Oracle Primavera Cloud, or similar construction/project management platforms.
  • Experience with earned value management or other project controls methodologies.
  • Experience preparing baseline schedules and schedule narratives.
  • Experience with delay analysis, time-impact analysis, and recovery scheduling.
  • Experience working on large-scale or complex construction projects.
  • Professional certifications such as PSP (Planning & Scheduling Professional), PMI-SP, PMP, or CCM are a plus.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong understanding of construction activities and sequencing.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to analyze large amounts of project data and identify trends.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with project management, field personnel, subcontractors, engineers, and clients.
  • Ability to identify potential schedule issues before they affect major milestones.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects or priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong understanding of critical path and schedule logic.
  • Ability to work independently while supporting a collaborative project team.
  • Strong presentation and reporting skills.

Working Conditions

  • Primarily office/project-site based depending on project requirements.
  • Regular interaction with construction sites and field personnel may be required.
  • Occasional travel between project sites may be required.
  • May require extended hours to support critical project milestones, schedule updates, or recovery planning.

Performance Measures

Success in this position will be measured by:

  • Accuracy and reliability of project schedules.
  • Timely completion of schedule updates and reports.
  • Effective identification and communication of schedule risks.
  • Accuracy of progress measurement and forecasting.
  • Successful monitoring of critical-path activities.
  • Timely identification of potential delays and impacts.
  • Effectiveness of recovery and mitigation schedules.
  • Quality of coordination with project management and field teams.
  • Compliance with contract and company scheduling requirements.
  • Support of projects achieving planned milestones and completion dates.

Requirements

This is a full time role

Up to $8/hr

100% Remote

Role Title: Vlogger (Insta360, DJI Osmo, GoPro MAX)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging expert Vloggers to contribute to a cutting-edge customer project focused on capturing high-quality, naturalistic video data using 360° and action cameras. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Contributors will record themselves performing everyday activities across indoor, outdoor, and vehicle environments using compatible equipment, providing crucial video resources for advanced AI research.

Scope of Work

  1. Capture a diverse set of continuous video clips (minimum 60 seconds each) of everyday activities in a range of environments, including indoor, outdoor, and in-vehicle settings.
  2. Consistently utilize compatible 360° or wide-angle cameras (e.g., Insta360, DJI Osmo, GoPro MAX series) with at least 170° FOV and 720p resolution, ensuring stable, third-person perspective according to project standards.
  3. Implement appropriate mounting solutions, such as backpack or vehicle mounts, to maintain a clear third-person view where your entire body and surroundings are visible throughout each activity.
  4. Follow provided guidelines and instructions for camera placement, activity selection, and safety to ensure data consistency and collection integrity.
  5. Document, organize, and submit video files in accordance with project specifications, ensuring all deliverables meet technical and quality requirements.
  6. Communicate proactively and clearly in both written and verbal form regarding progress, questions, and any technical challenges.
  7. Adapt to occasional updates in collection tasks, environments, or technical requirements as defined by project needs.

Compatible camera examples include:

  1. Insta360 X3, X4, X5, X6
  2. DJI Osmo 360
  3. GoPro MAX, MAX2
  4. Other action or 360° cameras that meet the minimum 170° FOV and 720p requirements

Examples of compatible third-person mounting rigs include:

  1. Insta360 Third-Person Backpack Mount and other harness-mounted extension systems.
  2. Owning a compatible backpack or vehicle mount is a plus and may let you start collecting sooner.

Third-Person Camera Setup

  1. Mounted above and behind you
  2. Angled slightly downward
  3. Positioned far enough back to keep your entire body consistently visible
  4. Stable enough to maintain the required third-person perspective during normal movement

If using a camera with less than 360° FOV, the mounting setup must position the camera far enough away to keep your entire body in frame while also capturing the surrounding environment. Your full body should remain visible throughout normal movement without frequently leaving the frame.

Handheld selfie sticks, chest mounts, shoulder clips, and stationary tripods do not meet the required third-person perspective.

Expected Recording Tasks may include:

  1. Natural everyday activities
  2. Indoor and outdoor activities
  3. Walking and moving through different environments
  4. Vehicle navigation and driving-related recordings
  5. Other similar real-world activities provided in the collection instructions

For vehicle navigation tasks, the camera must be securely mounted to the vehicle.

Recording Requirements

  1. Capture a variety of activities and environments
  2. Each continuous clip must be at least 60 seconds long
  3. Record at a minimum resolution of 720p
  4. Follow the required camera position for each assigned task
  5. Keep the relevant activity and surrounding environment consistently visible
  6. Follow all provided recording and safety instructions

About Us…

In 2005, brothers Dimitri and Steve Osler set out to reimagine how businesses communicate, and that vision became Wildix. Today, from our headquarters in Tallinn, Estonia, Wildix is one of the world’s fastest-growing UCaaS companies, with 300+ team members from 15+ nationalities, working across Europe, the UK, the Americas and beyond. We serve businesses in 135+ countries through a partner-first ecosystem, delivering secure, intuitive solutions that keep companies connected, productive and ready for what’s next.

At Wildix, we don’t just build technology, we live it. As a remote-first company, we rely on our own platform every day to collaborate globally and innovate fast. What we offer

🚀 Career Growth & Development – Access to programs and events to keep you at the top of your game.

💰 Compensation – The total compensation for this role is between £50K and £75K gross per year of basic salary plus a variable commissions scheme, which will be discussed during the interview process. The final offer will fall within this range, and reflects the candidate’s skills, experience, and work location.

Happy with them? We offer even more! Our Benefits are country-specific, you can ask your recruiter for more information

Interview Process

We Are Wildix

Wildix is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome all applicants regardless of race, gender, age, religion, or any other characteristic. Everyone is encouraged to apply and is welcome to join our Blue Ecosystem.

raw.description:
Job Description

  • Position Title: Clinical Skills & Group Practice Instructor – Distance Learning
  • Department: Academic Faculty
  • Reports To: Campus Director / Academic Director
  • Institution: Vancouver College of Counsellor Training (VCCT)

Position Summary

The Clinical Skills & Group Practice Instructor facilitates interactive clinical skills training sessions for students enrolled in VCCT's distance-learning counselling programs. The role focuses on helping students develop applied counselling competencies through role-play exercises, group supervision, ethics discussions, and simulated counselling scenarios.

The instructor supports students in translating theoretical knowledge into practical counselling skills including reflective listening, empathy, emotional attunement, ethical decision-making, and therapeutic communication. The role also includes facilitating group therapy simulations and preparing students for practicum placements, ensuring students are professionally prepared for real-world counselling environments.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Skills Training

  • Facilitate live online clinical skills practice sessions for distance-learning students.
  • Conduct role-play simulations of counselling scenarios.
  • Teach and demonstrate counselling micro-skills including reflective listening, empathy, rapport building, and therapeutic communication.

Provide constructive feedback to support student skill development.

  • Group Therapy Simulation & Supervision
  • Facilitate group counselling role-play sessions to help students practice group facilitation techniques.
  • Act as Group Supervisor, observing student-led group sessions and providing reflective feedback.
  • Support student understanding of group dynamics, participation management, and therapeutic group processes.

Ethics & Professional Practice

  • Facilitate case discussions and ethical scenario analysis relevant to counselling practice.
  • Guide students in applying ethical frameworks, confidentiality standards, and professional boundaries.

Practicum Preparation

  • Support students in preparing for practicum placements.
  • Respond to student questions related to practicum expectations and readiness.
  • Guide students on professional behaviour, client interaction, documentation practices, and ethical conduct in counselling environments.

Interactive Learning & Student Engagement

  • Use virtual learning platforms to facilitate breakout room discussions and supervised practice sessions.
  • Create experiential learning activities that strengthen counselling competencies.
  • Foster a safe, respectful, and inclusive learning environment that supports meaningful learning.

Qualifications

Education

  • Master's degree in Counselling, Psychology, Social Work, or a related field preferred.
  • Diploma in Counselling with significant professional experience may be considered.

Professional Credentials

Active professional designation such as Registered Clinical Counsellor (RCC) with the BC Association of Clinical Counsellors or equivalent (e.g., CCC with the Canadian Counselling and Psychotherapy Association).

Must hold a recognized Clinical Supervisor designation or supervisor training enabling supervision of counselling students.

Must be in good standing with their professional association.

Experience

  • Experience providing counselling or psychotherapy services.
  • Experience facilitating group counselling or group therapy sessions.
  • Experience mentoring or supervising students or trainees.
  • Experience facilitating skills-based training for adult learners.
  • Familiarity with online teaching platforms and breakout-room facilitation.

Core Competencies

  • Strong interpersonal and facilitation skills
  • Ability to guide experiential learning and counselling practice
  • Competence in group counselling facilitation
  • Ability to provide constructive supervision and feedback
  • Strong ethical awareness and professional judgment
  • Ability to create psychologically safe learning environments

Working Conditions

  • Remote instructional delivery through VCCT's virtual learning platform.
  • Sessions conducted in an interactive online format.
  • Scheduling based on program cohort requirements.

Growth Opportunity

VCCT is a growing institution committed to developing strong faculty members. Instructors who demonstrate exceptional teaching quality, student engagement, and alignment with VCCT's academic standards may be considered for expanded responsibilities and increased teaching hours, with the potential to transition into a full-time instructional role as program needs grow.

raw.description:
¿Qué es?

Un CFO Service Designer es un profesional especializado en la definición, autoría, mantenimiento y gobierno de requisitos a nivel de cliente para programas de vehículos actuales y futuros. Su rol es clave para garantizar que las necesidades del cliente y del negocio se traduzcan en requisitos claros, verificables, trazables y alineados con los objetivos del programa, las restricciones arquitectónicas, los estándares aplicables y las expectativas del cliente.

¿Cómo lo hace?

Colabora con equipos multifuncionales (Planificación de Producto, Ingeniería de Sistemas, HMI, Software, Hardware y Validación) para descomponer necesidades de clientes y stakeholders en requisitos funcionales y no funcionales a nivel de plataforma.

Analiza y valida requisitos para asegurar que sean completos, consistentes, factibles, no ambiguos y alineados con los objetivos del programa.

Gestiona la trazabilidad bidireccional desde las necesidades del cliente hasta los requisitos de sistema, subsistema, software, hardware y validación.

Facilita revisiones cruzadas para resolver conflictos, brechas, suposiciones y dependencias de interfaz con stakeholders globales.

Utiliza herramientas como IBM DOORS Next Gen para autorizar, trazabilidad, revisión y reporte de requisitos.

Incorpora estándares de seguridad (ISO 26262), ciberseguridad, regulatorios e industriales en los requisitos del producto.

Trabaja con equipos de validación para definir criterios de aceptación, métodos de verificación y confirmar la cobertura de requisitos.

Importancia:

Su trabajo es esencial para asegurar que los productos automotrices (como sistemas eléctricos, de propulsión o autónomos) cumplan con los requisitos del cliente, los estándares de calidad y los plazos corporativos, minimizando riesgos técnicos, de tiempo y costos.

Requirements

Habilidades Técnicas Obligatorias:

Conocimiento en Ingeniería de Sistemas Automotrices:

Nivel: Intermedio (5-8 años de experiencia)

Incluye: Descomposición funcional, interfaces, arquitecturas y la interacción entre software, hardware, red y componentes físicos.

Gestión de Requisitos:

Nivel: Intermedio (5-8 años de experiencia)

Incluye: Definición, autoría, análisis, revisión y gestión del ciclo de vida de requisitos.

Conocimiento de ISO 26262:

Nivel: Intermedio (5-8 años de experiencia)

Incluye: Implicaciones para la definición, asignación, trazabilidad y verificación de requisitos relacionados con la seguridad.

Interpretación de Requisitos Regulatorios y Estándares:

Nivel: Intermedio (5-8 años de experiencia)

Incluye: Traducción de requisitos regulatorios, estándares y mejores prácticas de la industria en requisitos de producto claros y trazables.

Prácticas de Ingeniería de Requisitos (INCOSE):

Nivel: Intermedio (5-8 años de experiencia)

Incluye: Elicitación, descomposición, asignación, análisis, trazabilidad, verificación, validación y gestión de cambios.

Comunicación Técnica:

Nivel: Intermedio (5-8 años de experiencia)

Incluye: Redacción de requisitos técnicos precisos, facilitación de revisiones multifuncionales y explicación de contenido técnico a audiencias no técnicas.c

Actividades del Puesto:

Gestión de Requisitos:

Crear, autorizar, revisar, aprobar, establecer líneas base, mantener y realizar seguimiento del estado de los requisitos a lo largo del ciclo de vida del producto.

Análisis de Requisitos:

Asegurar que los requisitos sean claros, completos, consistentes, factibles, no ambiguos, probables y alineados con los objetivos del programa, restricciones arquitectónicas, estándares aplicables y expectativas del cliente.

Revisiones Multifuncionales:

Facilitar revisiones de requisitos con equipos multifuncionales para resolver brechas, conflictos, suposiciones y dependencias de interfaz con stakeholders globales.

Aplicar estándares y mejores prácticas consistentes en la autoría de requisitos.

Definición y Descomposición de Necesidades:

Liderar la definición y descomposición de necesidades de clientes y stakeholders en requisitos funcionales y no funcionales a nivel de plataforma para nuevas características.

Adaptación de Requisitos de Plataforma:

Adaptar y gestionar requisitos de plataforma aprobados para aplicaciones específicas del programa, documentando desviaciones justificadas y manteniendo la alineación con la intención global de la característica.

Identificación de Necesidades del Cliente:

Utilizar benchmarking competitivo, clínicas de voz del cliente, información de campo y retroalimentación de stakeholders para identificar necesidades del cliente y convertirlas en entradas de requisitos medibles y criterios de aceptación.

Trazabilidad Bidireccional:

Mantener trazabilidad bidireccional desde las necesidades y requisitos del cliente hasta los requisitos de sistema, subsistema, software, hardware y validación.

Evaluar cambios en los requisitos para determinar su impacto técnico, de tiempo, costo, cumplimiento y validación.

Gestionar cambios a través del proceso de revisión y control de cambios aprobado.

Colaboración con Equipos de Validación:

Asociarse con equipos de validación para definir criterios de aceptación y métodos de verificación.

Confirmar la cobertura de requisitos, apoyar la resolución de problemas y asegurar que los requisitos aplicables de seguridad, ciberseguridad, regulatorios e industriales estén incorporados y documentados.

TalentWise is seeking a Director of Recruiting & Business Development to help grow our commercial staffing and recruiting business.

  • Earn based on the business and placements you generate.

As IMCP expands its digital presence—online courses, certifications, group coaching, subscriptions, and other educational offerings—exceptional, resonant social media content is critical for audience engagement, growth, and thought leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analytical mindset: not just reporting metrics, but interpreting audience behavior and deriving actionable insights.

Our Benefits

Position Title: Business Development Representative

Location: United Kingdom or Europe

Employment Type: Full-Time

Onsite, Remote or Hybrid: Remote/Flexible

Department: Marketing

Hiring Manager: Manager of Business Development

Travel: Minimal

COMPANY SUMMARY:

Here at Aprimo, our mission is to empower the marketing organisations of today to build the brands of tomorrow. Aprimo is a pioneer of the marketing resource and digital asset management space, and we deliver an innovative, industry-leading SaaS solution that changes the way companies like AT&T, National Park Foundation, Laborie, and Bank of America work, create, collaborate, and learn in order to deliver exceptional brand experiences at scale.

Aprimo helps enterprises unleash the power of their content by providing a marketing automation software and digital asset management software that manages the behind-the-scenes activities involved in marketing. Our product allows companies to manage content planning, creation and distribution all in one place, store content and media in a shared repository, and receive in-depth insights into how content performs.

Founded in 1998, Aprimo has five offices internationally, including Chicago headquarters, and offers a flexible work-from-home/remote-work policy.

Named a Leader in Digital Asset Management (DAM) and Marketing Resource Management by Forrester and winner of the 2021 Tech Cares Award for our work with Aprimo HELPS, we build on the power of our people to make an impact both in our industry and in our communities.

POSITION SUMMARY:

At Aprimo, the Business Development Representative (BDR) will work with Demand Generation to assist Account Executives (AE) to drive new business revenue. You will be required to utilise leading sales technology to meet activity and opportunity quotas per month.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

  • Work with Demand Generation to identify target prospects/stakeholders to engage with
  • Work with marketing and Account Executives to create and drive a nurture program to support pipeline development
  • Build targeted lists for your outreach using ZoomInfo , Cognism and Salesforce
  • Work with prospects to identify business challenges through structured discovery conversations, with a ‘solution first’ mindset to align their challenges with the values and outcomes Aprimo can provide
  • Generate high-quality first-time appointments per month for your Account Executive to attend
  • Continue development and maintain a qualified opportunity pipeline that exceeds 3x of the team annual quota
  • Identify any gaps in KPI’s against strategic territory plan
  • Utilise existing networks and relationships to build new business
  • Accurately document information on each opportunity through Aprimo’s SFDC CRM tool while always recording/maintaining next steps/actions
  • Share inputs and collaborate with other departments in preparing sales materials, presentations, and driving new initiatives
  • Develop and maintain market knowledge and competitor positioning to be a credible advisor in this space
  • Identify and attend relevant industry events that support pipeline creation
  • Additional responsibilities and duties may be assigned as required

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS & WHY YOU’RE A GREAT FIT FOR THE ROLE:

  • The Essentials
    • A minimum of 1-year experience in a similar role within a software provider, SaaS, digital or technical sales environment
    • 1-2 years of related experience (marketing, sales, consulting, business process)
    • Fluency in English is required
    • Previous history meeting target goals
    • Proven track record of generating opportunities in a purely new business BDR/MDR role – strong performance against target
  • Additional Successful Qualities
    • Self-starter mentality with the ability to work independently
    • The ability to focus on identifying and selling to business challenges, not just the technology
    • The ability to demonstrate understanding of digital landscape and importance of multi-channel communications
    • An agile mind and a person who thrives in a fast moving sales environment
    • Aptitude to manage numerous requests and time demands concurrently, while achieving goals from assigned territory
    • Proven business development success through effective use of core sales tools: Salesforce, Intent, LinkedIn SalesNav, ZoomInfo, Microsoft Office etc
    • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with a distributed sales team
    • Capability of understanding customer pain points, requirements and correlating potential business to value that can be provided
    • Promotes a strong sense of urgency for reaching goals and key deliverables. Acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company

APRIMO CULTURE & WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:

  • Aprimo offers a forward-thinking, progressive and employee-first culture that is based in both collaboration and flexibility with team members who are friendly, intelligent and enthusiastic people that are committed to the product and mission here at Aprimo.
    • With 5 offices worldwide and teams spread throughout the US, EMEA and Philippines, our multicultural teams work cross-departmentally and across continents and cultures towards a shared goal.
    • We offer a diverse environment that promotes DEI efforts, values multiple perspectives and fresh thinking and which includes Aprimo HELPS, an employee resource group (ERG) that is dedicated to giving back to our local communities
  • Through its relaxed environment, Aprimo embodies a more casual “Silicon Valley” atmosphere.
    • We have a casual dress code that allows employees to express themselves as individuals and which fosters a creative and free-thinking approach to problem solving and business solutions. And it also allows us to wear hoodies and shorts during internal meetings.
  • Flexible work schedules and all positions allowing for either entirely remote or hybrid working arrangements create a deeply rewarding work-life balance.
    • With flexible work schedules, employees can attend to personal matters, such as stepping away to pick up their children from school or to get a much-needed haircut.
    • In a recent internal survey, 89% of staff cited work-life balance as being one of the most rewarding aspects of working at Aprimo!
  • Part of the key to our success is that team members are not only successful at collaboration and open communication, but that they are also given a great deal of autonomy and freedom in their own individual roles.
    • Our culture is not a micro-managing environment – rather, employees are encouraged to be self-starters, to voice new ideas, and to exercise ownership in their individual roles.
    • As such, individual team members can leave a lasting impact and footprint within the organization – in fact, our average employee tenure is 7.7 years.
  • Aprimo employs a “choose your own adventure” approach to career advancement.
    • Staff members are not siloed into roles and for many of our teams there is no set ladder that one needs to climb to achieve growth and promotion.
    • Rather, we emphasize an organic approach to career development in which employees can and do frequently transition into newly created roles within their own teams or transition into other departments based on their interests in exploring new skills and responsibilities.
    • For additional learning and development, we recently rolled out Udemy, which is an online learning platform that employees have access to and which features over 200,000 courses on a wide variety of business topics.
  • Ranked #1 in AI Metadata & Search by Forrester, Aprimo sits on the cutting-edge of technology and is paving new paths forward by incorporating AI (artificial intelligence) into our product offerings.
    • We offer generative AI in a secure environment built for brand safety and governance. Our AI-powered content operations platform, with industry leading digital asset management (DAM) software at its core, helps to optimize the creative process and improve the user experience with better search, recommendations, categorization and summarization.
    • Our AI empowers marketing teams to automate tasks, analyze data, and personalize content, ensuring scalability without sacrificing productivity.
    • AI automatically identifies asset characteristics and transforms them into words a human would search for. Translation, image alterations, personalization, and more are all streamlined by AI.
    • With our platform, marketers can efficiently produce a larger volume of content, engage customers on a personalized level, curate relevant materials, and make data-driven decisions to drive their content strategies forward.
    • Our AI offers up to 72% increase in discoverability and productivity, up to 61% reduction in production time, and up to 66% faster time to market.

APRIMO BENEFITS WE OFFER:

  • Target Compensation: Annual base salary target of the euro or British pound equivalent of $55,000 USD and commissions target of $30,000 USD, depending on job related knowledge, skills, and level of experience. This is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, or other law.
  • Competitive benefits coverage that begins on the first day of employment

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be able to remain in stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods and performing sedentary work that primarily involves sitting/standing
  • Must be able to move about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another
  • Must be able to perform light physical work that includes lifting or moving objects up to 20 lbs. or medium work that includes moving objects up to 50 pounds on occasion
  • Must be able to communicate with others to exchange information, including conveying detailed or important spoken instructions to others accurately, loudly, or quickly
  • Must possess the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication at normal speaking levels
  • Must be able to repeat motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers (i.e., repeated typing, etc.)
  • The worker is required to have close visual awareness to perform an activity and to assess the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned, such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.
  • This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, etc.

EEO STATEMENT:

Aprimo provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identification, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Aprimo complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

ADA STATEMENT:

Aprimo is required to make a reasonable accommodation to the known disability of a qualified applicant or employee if it would not impose an "undue hardship" on the operation of the employer's business. Undue hardship is defined as an action requiring significant difficulty or expense when considered in light of factors such as an employer's size, financial resources and the nature and structure of its operation.

  • Assist with the development and preparation of supporting proposal materials, capability presentations, and bid-defense slides.

Who We Are

ABOUT ENOVIS™

Enovis Corporation (NYSE: ENOV) is an innovation-driven medical technology growth company dedicated to developing clinically differentiated solutions that generate measurably better patient outcomes and transform workflows. Powered by a culture of continuous improvement, global talent and innovation, the Company’s extensive range of products, services and integrated technologies fuels active lifestyles in orthopedics and beyond. For more information about Enovis, please visit www.enovis.com.

What You'll Do

At Enovis™, we’re building the future of orthopedic surgery—and we’re looking for passionate innovators to help lead the way. As a key member of our Enabling Technologies team, you’ll play an integral role in advancing ASTRA™, our next-generation surgical platform that connects pre-op planning with real-time execution. ASTRA™ combines augmented reality, AI, and smart navigation to help surgeons perform joint replacements with greater precision, efficiency, and confidence. This is your opportunity to help shape smarter tools that deliver better outcomes and expand access to advanced surgical care.

Because that’s how we change the lives of patients for the better. And that’s how we create better together. Why work at Enovis? See for yourself.

As a key member of the Enabling Technologies team you will play an integral part in helping Enovis drive the medical technology industry forward through transforming patient care and creating better patient outcomes.

Job Title:

Associate Director, Global Product Management – ET

Reports To:

Vice President, Global Product Management and U.S. Marketing

Location:

, Remote - US

Business Unit Description:

Enabling Technologies

High Level Position Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Global Product Manager to lead the global strategy, adoption, and portfolio evolution of the ASTRA Arvis platform across knee, hip, and shoulder arthroplasty applications.

This role will be responsible for maximizing the commercial success of the existing ASTRA Arvis portfolio while defining the future roadmap that drives sustained growth and competitive differentiation. The Senior Global Product Manager will partner closely with surgeons, commercial leaders, R&D, clinical affairs, and regional teams to identify unmet customer needs, improve product adoption, guide next-generation enhancements, and expand the platform's global footprint.

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker who understands orthopedic enabling technologies, can translate clinical and market insights into product roadmaps, and thrives operating at the intersection of technology, commercialization, and customer engagement.

Enovis is a leader in medical technology and has continued to grow our organization and product space.

Job Responsibilities:

Global Portfolio Leadership

  • Own the global product strategy for the ASTRA Arvis platform across knee, hip, and shoulder applications.
  • Develop and execute multi-year portfolio roadmaps that support global market expansion, adoption, and long-term growth objectives.
  • Drive strategic prioritization of future platform enhancements, software capabilities, workflow improvements, and new clinical applications.
  • Serve as the global business owner for ASTRA Arvis, ensuring alignment between customer needs, market opportunities, and development investments.

Market Expansion & Adoption

  • Lead initiatives to accelerate surgeon adoption, utilization, and clinical engagement across global markets.
  • Partner with regional commercial teams to identify barriers to adoption and develop strategies to increase platform utilization and procedural pull-through.
  • Evaluate global market opportunities and recommend strategies to expand ASTRA Arvis into new geographies, customer segments, and care settings.
  • Monitor key business metrics, adoption trends, and customer feedback to identify growth opportunities and inform strategic decision-making.

Strategic Product Planning

  • Develop business cases and investment recommendations for future product and platform initiatives.
  • Define product requirements and strategic priorities for next-generation ASTRA Arvis solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, competitive offerings, and market trends to maintain differentiation and support sustained leadership.
  • Lead voice-of-customer activities across surgeons, hospitals, distributors, and clinical stakeholders to guide future development efforts.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with R&D, software engineering, systems engineering, clinical affairs, quality, regulatory, operations, and commercial teams to deliver product enhancements and new capabilities.
  • Provide strategic direction throughout the product lifecycle, from concept through commercialization and post-launch optimization.
  • Influence resource allocation, roadmap prioritization, and development tradeoffs to maximize customer and business value.
  • Act as the primary product management representative for ASTRA Arvis across executive leadership, commercial organizations, and development teams.

Key Opinion Leader Engagement

  • Establish and maintain relationships with leading surgeons, technology users, and industry experts.
  • Lead surgeon advisory boards, customer feedback forums, and market development activities.
  • Partner with clinical and medical education teams to evaluate emerging clinical needs and technology trends.

raw.description:
About vidIQ

vidIQ helps millions of YouTube creators grow through data, education, and AI-powered tools. Our mission is to be the smart copilot every creator needs. We're looking for a hands-on Product Growth Lead who can find opportunities and build the solution—whether that's a product experience, acquisition loop, lifecycle program, partner motion, or lightweight internal tool.


About the Role

This is a hands-on product growth role, not performance marketing or demand generation. You’ll work directly across the product-led funnel, from acquisition and signup through onboarding, activation, conversion, monetization, and retention. You’ll identify opportunities, prototype and build solutions yourself using AI tools, ship experiments, measure the results, and decide what to scale, revise, or stop.

What You'll Build

  • New product-led acquisition, referral, and distribution loops across creators, affiliates, partners, and organic channels.

  • Faster paths from signup to first value, especially during a creator's first 30 minutes with vidIQ.

  • Personalized onboarding and education based on a creator's size, experience, and goals.

  • Better purchase experiences across pricing, packaging, checkout, subscriptions, and payment recovery.

  • Lifecycle experiences that give creators a reason to return and make progress with vidIQ.

  • Experiments across the complete journey from first touch to engaged, paying, retained creator.

You'll own the complete growth cycle: find the opportunity, define the experience, build or directly enable it, launch it, learn from the result, and decide what comes next.

What You’ll Do

  • You'll be the DRI for identifying growth opportunities, choosing which ideas deserve a test, and recommending what vidIQ should ramp, revise, hold, or stop.

  • Prototype ideas and ship to production yourself using a frontier AI stack (Claude Code, Codex) plus a bespoke vidIQ deployment harness that keeps shipping risk low.

  • Bring in Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Partnerships, or Finance when their expertise materially improves the outcome.

  • Turn successful experiments into durable product, channel, partner, or lifecycle growth loops.

  • Build an internal agent brain on what vidIQ tried, learned, scaled, and stopped so the next experiment starts smarter.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • You genuinely care about solving problems for creators because you are one—with 100+ followers or subscribers—or are close to someone who is.

  • You have a track record of growing B2C, prosumer, subscription, product-led, or creator-economy products.

  • You're a builder with strong product judgment. You independently identify opportunities, decide what to try, and turn ambiguous problems into working experiences.

  • You have designed, launched, and analyzed A/B tests that measurably improved activation, conversion, monetization, retention, or efficient acquisition.

  • You can move comfortably across product, marketing, lifecycle, partnerships, and data without treating organizational boundaries as blockers.

  • You use AI and automation throughout your workflow to research, prototype, build, and iterate faster while remaining accountable for quality.

  • You communicate clearly, create momentum without reporting authority, and know when to ask for help.

This Role Is Not

  • A people-management role or a mandate to build a new team.

  • A role where other teams do all the building while you coordinate.

  • A paid-media, lifecycle, CRM, or product-marketing specialist role.

  • A traditional Product Manager role where other teams do all the building while you coordinate.

  • A generic Head of Growth role centered on agencies, org design, or executive presentations.

Location&Availability

100% global remote; at least six working hours overlapping 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time

Perks and Benefits

  • Work Remotely: Embrace the freedom to choose your ideal workspace anywhere in the world.

  • Flexible Time Off: We support a flexible vacation policy allowing you to take time off when you need to recharge.

  • Communication Stipend: Enjoy a monthly stipend to cover your phone and internet expenses, helping you stay connected effortlessly.

  • Global Impact: Join our diverse team that’s shaping the future of the creator economy across the globe.

Compensation

This is a remote position open to candidates worldwide. Engagement structure (employee or contractor) will be determined in accordance with local labor law based on the candidate's location.

Compensation will be structured in accordance with local employment requirements — as salary for employees or as fees for contractors — with stock option grants where applicable. Your exact rate will be determined based on your experience, skills, and level, as well as current market benchmarks.

The base compensation range for this role is $140,000 – $200,000 (annualized; pro-rated based on engagement terms).

If you're a growth leader who builds—not just recommends—we'd love to hear from you. Tell us about a growth loop you personally launched, what you built, and the result it produced.

Staff Attorney - LM07EESr Staff Attorney - LM07DE

We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future.

The Hartford currently has an in-house opportunity for a Staff Attorney or Senior Staff Attorney to litigate cases throughout the Austin, San Antonio, Houston areas. This position is an ideal fit for an experienced Attorney with significant trial and litigation experience in construction site accidents, premise liability, products liability, and commercial automobile accidents. The Senior Staff Attorney will strive to deliver the best possible result in pending litigation. In this position the attorney reports to the Staff Legal Managing Attorney. The ideal candidate is an experienced Attorney with considerable trial experience and demonstrates the ability to independently handle cases from inception through trial.

RESPONSBILITIES:

  • Handle complex and high exposure litigation
    • Analyze intricate substantive and procedural legal and factual issues, conduct extensive, well-reasoned legal research, independently develop and present defense strategies on behalf of clients
    • Prepare complex pleadings, written discovery, depositions, motions and briefs in support of defense strategies without supervision because of level of experience and expertise
    • Provide effective and timely communications, information, legal advice and other services to clients and claims customers on legal and factual issues in a technology driven environment
    • Communicate with the court, witnesses, opposing counsel and co-counsel in a manner consistent with established office procedures
    • Provide for the prompt, efficient and effective disposition of assigned cases
    • Independently prepare and present witnesses and evidence at trials, judicial hearings and alternative dispute resolutions
    • Research, draft, file and argue appellate briefs in reviewing courts on behalf of clients
    • Provide opinions to Managing Attorney, staff, clients and claims customers

QUALIFICATIONS:

Note: This position may be filled as a Staff Attorney or Senior Staff Attorney commensurate with candidate’s experience.

Qualified Staff Attorney candidates will possess the following requirements:

Juris Doctorate (JD) from accredited law school and license to practice in Texas state and local federal courts

Member in good standing of applicable Bar Association
Minimum of 3 years of civil tort matters experience

Strong legal research and writing skills

Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize duties and time are a must
Strong communication, computer and technological skills and the ability to quickly leverage new software as required
Demonstrated expertise and familiarity in the handling of claim cases and litigation

Qualified Senior Staff Attorney candidates will possess the following requirements:
Juris Doctorate (JD) from accredited law school and license to practice in Texas state and local federal courts
Member in good standing of applicable Bar Association
Minimum of 5+ years of civil tort matters experience
Documented first or second chair jury trial/appellate preferred

Strong legal research and writing skills

Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize duties and time are a must
Strong communication, computer and technological skills and the ability to quickly leverage new software as required
Demonstrated expertise and familiarity in the handling of claim cases and litigation

Core Competencies Required:

• Strategic Thinking

• Operational Excellence

  • Leadership
    • Business Knowledge and Decision Making
    • Effective Relationships
    • Excellent writing skills

• Strong communication skills

WHAT ELSE CAN YOU TELL ME?

This position offers a remote work arrangement for candidates residing in the San Antonio, Austin, or Houston, Texas areas.

Compensation

The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short-term or annual bonuses, long-term incentives, and on-the-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is:

$118,800 - $198,600

Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases.

We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.

Senior Director, Emerging Science & Pipeline Strategy Marketing Community Lead

As the Senior Director, Emerging Science & Pipeline Strategy Marketing Community Lead, you are accountable for shaping the future HCP commercial portfolio through early commercialization strategy, customer ecosystem development, launch readiness, and transition planning across emerging assets and strategic opportunities.

Reporting to the VP, HCP Experience, you will partner closely with Therapeutic Community Leads, Indication Strategy Leads, Customer Engagement & Experience, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Business Development, Insights, and other enterprise partners to bring commercial and customer perspective into emerging opportunities, inform asset and development decisions, and prepare assets to transition successfully into therapeutic communities.

Roles & Responsibilities

Emerging Science & Pipeline Strategy

  • Lead HCP commercial strategy across pipeline assets, future indications, exploratory opportunities, partnerships / licensing opportunities, and other strategic opportunities.

  • Translate enterprise HCP Experience priorities into early commercialization strategies that support launch readiness, customer ecosystem development, portfolio growth, and informed investment decisions.

  • Maintain the community-level view of emerging customer needs, therapeutic landscapes, KOL networks, academic centers, referral dynamics, and other stakeholders shaping future market development.

  • Assess emerging opportunities and provide commercial perspective on relative priority, customer opportunity, readiness, resource needs, and strategic optionality.

  • Partner with asset, development, Medical Affairs, Business Development, and commercial teams to ensure customer and ecosystem insights inform asset strategy, evidence planning, launch planning, and market development.

  • Elevate emerging customer, scientific, market, and pipeline insights to senior leaders to inform prioritization and investment decisions.

Customer Ecosystem, Launch Readiness & Transition

  • Develop an integrated Emerging Science & Pipeline Strategy plan connecting customer insights, KOL strategy, launch readiness, pipeline opportunities, and cross-functional priorities.

  • Lead early customer planning, including ecosystem mapping, emerging KOL identification, academic center prioritization, and customer journey implications.

  • Shape early HCP education and engagement approaches in partnership with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Customer Engagement & Experience, Insights, and TLL leadership.

  • Establish launch and transition readiness criteria for movement of assets into Neurology, Rheumatology, or future therapeutic communities.

  • Lead transition planning to ensure customer ecosystem continuity, clear handoffs, resource readiness, and accountability as assets move into scaled execution.

  • Monitor scientific, market, customer, and competitive dynamics and adjust priorities and transition plans as the pipeline evolves.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Capability Building

  • Serve as a senior HCP marketing and commercialization leader across emerging science, pipeline strategy, and early commercialization.

  • Build strong partnerships across Therapeutic Communities, Portfolio Marketing, Customer Engagement & Experience, Field, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Business Development, Market Access, Patient Experience, Digital, Insights, and other enterprise functions.

  • Align priorities, resolve emerging asset and launch-readiness trade-offs, and ensure progress against Emerging Science & Pipeline Strategy priorities.

  • Champion data-enabled and AI-supported approaches that improve early commercialization and pipeline decision-making.

  • Lead, coach, and develop direct reports and your network of empowered teams, building capability in customer insight, pipeline prioritization, ecosystem shaping, early commercialization, and launch readiness.

  • Foster a culture of customer-centricity, accountability, collaboration, innovation, strong compliance, and sound judgment.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of HCP marketing, early commercialization, pipeline strategy, customer engagement, launch readiness, and lifecycle management in complex healthcare markets.

  • Strong ability to understand and shape emerging scientific ecosystems, KOL networks, academic centers, referral dynamics, and future customer communities.

  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate competing pipeline opportunities, assess commercial readiness, and make clear recommendations across emerging assets.

  • Experience translating emerging science, customer insight, and market dynamics into commercialization implications and actions.

  • Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to synthesize scientific, customer, market, and cross-functional input into clear direction.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, resolve trade-offs, and lead effectively in a complex network of empowered teams.

  • Strong leadership presence and ability to coach, develop, and inspire teams through ambiguity and change.

Education, Experience & Qualifications

  • BA/BS required; advanced degree preferred.

  • Approximately 15+ years of relevant biotech or pharmaceutical commercial experience, including significant leadership in early commercialization, pipeline strategy, HCP marketing, launch planning, therapeutic area strategy, or portfolio strategy.

  • Demonstrated leadership across pipeline strategy, early commercialization, launch readiness, and therapeutic area strategy across multiple assets, indications, or lifecycle stages.

  • Experience prioritizing emerging opportunities and leading complex, matrixed work across multiple assets, functions, and competing priorities.

  • Strong understanding of HCP customer journeys, KOL engagement, disease-state education, customer ecosystem development, and launch readiness in specialty, rare disease, biologics, or similarly complex markets.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, develop talent, and manage complex commercialization initiatives through growth, ambiguity, and change.
