Growth & Acquisition Marketing Manager

The Global Talent Co. · Remote · Full-time

About the Opportunity

The Global Talent Co. is recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing DTC wellness brand whose mission is simple: help people live healthier. They're scaling their customer acquisition engine and looking to connect it more tightly to the full customer journey.

About the Role

We're looking for a Growth & Acquisition Marketing Manager to own our client's customer acquisition strategy across paid media and emerging growth channels. You'll manage their paid media agency, set acquisition strategy, guide creative testing, oversee media investment, and make sure every paid dollar is directly tied to DTC growth goals.

This role sits at the center of the digital growth engine — working closely with the Lifecycle & Retention Manager, e-commerce team, creative partners, and agency teams to keep the customer journey connected from first impression to purchase and beyond. You'll own strategy, performance accountability, budget planning, reporting, and the business decisions behind paid acquisition.

The ideal candidate is a strategic operator who understands performance marketing and paid platforms inside and out — analytical, commercially minded, creative, and comfortable pushing back on agency recommendations to make sure media investment is working as hard as possible.

What You'll Do

Acquisition Strategy Own acquisition strategy across paid media and emerging growth channels — Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, affiliate, influencer, retail media, and beyond. Build plans that support product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and always-on growth, balancing efficiency, growth, and long-term customer value.

Agency Leadership & Performance Accountability Own the day-to-day relationship with the paid media agency. Hold them accountable to performance targets, reporting quality, and testing velocity. Review plans, challenge assumptions, and translate agency output into clear decisions for the internal team.

Budget Management & Forecasting Own paid media budget planning, pacing, and investment recommendations. Build monthly and quarterly plans tied to DTC revenue goals, and monitor CAC, MER, ROAS, and new customer acquisition to keep investment sharp.

Creative Testing & Growth Insights Build a creative testing roadmap with the agency and creative team. Brief creative needs from customer insights and performance data, and share what's working across email, SMS, website, social, and brand marketing.

Reporting & Analytics Own weekly and monthly reporting on paid acquisition — new customers, revenue, CAC, MER, ROAS, conversion rate, AOV, payback, and channel performance — and turn the data into business recommendations, not just campaign updates.

Cross-Channel Collaboration Partner with Lifecycle & Retention, e-commerce, Creative, Brand, Innovation, CX, and Sales to keep acquisition strategy connected to the rest of the business.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in growth, acquisition, performance, or digital marketing

  • Proven experience managing paid media programs, in-house or through an agency

  • Experience managing agency relationships and holding partners accountable

  • Strong grasp of customer acquisition, media investment, and channel strategy

  • DTC, Shopify, CPG, wellness, beauty, food, or beverage experience strongly preferred

  • Comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • Strong communicator — can present performance insights and recommendations clearly

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience

Technical Skills

  • Strong command of Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, affiliate, paid social, and paid search

  • Fluent in acquisition metrics: CAC, MER, ROAS, new customer revenue, conversion rate, AOV, LTV, payback

  • Experience with GA4, Shopify analytics, ad platform reporting, dashboards, UTMs, pixels, and conversion tracking

  • Solid budget management and forecasting skills

  • Experience building testing frameworks across creative, audience, landing page, and channel mix

Who You Are

Passionate about health and wellness. Driven by growth but disciplined about efficiency and profitability. Commercially minded, analytical, and creative — someone who connects marketing activity to revenue outcomes and isn't afraid to challenge an agency's recommendation. A self-starter who moves quickly and takes ownership in a high-growth environment.

raw.excerpt: About A1There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native.
raw.description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. Work directly with engineers on system design, evaluation, and trade-offs-defining requirements, but shaping how the system works for global users. You work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and system constraints, and are responsible for turning AI potential into real, reliable behavior in a real-world application.

What You'll be Doing

  • Research and define end-to-end AI system requirements from capability to behavior to user impact

  • Translate model capabilities, data constraints, and evaluation results into clear product and system decisions

  • Make hard trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, and UX

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and mobile engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback

  • Drive execution with clear specs, strong judgment, and disciplined prioritization

  • Ensure systems ship quickly, safely, and reliably, with strong feedback loops

  • Own product quality end-to-end - correctness, predictability, and user trust

What You Will Need

Technical foundation

  • Strong grounding in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and system design.

  • Solid understanding of ML fundamentals and how modern AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfort reading, reviewing, and discussing technical design documents.

AI & ML experience

  • Hands-on exposure to AI-powered products, including LLM-based systems.

  • Experience working with model evaluation, prompt or pipeline iteration, and feedback loops.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, bias, and drift.

Product leadership

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Proven ability to work closely with senior engineers and ML teams.

  • Strong judgment and decision-making ability in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • Ability to balance ambition with technical and operational reality.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

Join BLP Digital — The #1 Solution for ERP Automation

BLP Digital is redefining ERP automation with agentic AI. Spun out of ETH Zurich and HSG, we build AI agents that automate finance, procurement, logistics, sales, and more for some of the world's largest enterprises. We solve real enterprise problems with cutting-edge technology and a strong sense of ownership.

Our solution is live in 40+ countries, used by 550+ customers, and automates 70,000+ processes every day, including for Fortune 500 companies. As one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scaleups, our success stems from deep expertise in technology and business processes, delivering a product with outstanding product-market fit, proven by a growing global customer base.

We've recently welcomed Goldman Sachs Alternatives as a growth investor, and we're now expanding into the UK with the launch of our London office. We are just getting started. Ready to build the future? Join BLP Digital today.

Location: This is a full-time position and can either be filled on-site at our office in central Zurich, Switzerland or remotely from Europe - This is a hybrid role (3-4 days in the office, 1-2 days working from home).

Job Summary

As Integrations Engineer, you will play a crucial role in enabling our customers to connect their ERP systems with BLP Digital’s platform. This involves designing and implementing interfaces, handling a variety of protocols such as REST, SOAP, and direct database access, and managing file transfers. Additionally, you will map incoming EDI and e-invoice formats to align with our standards. Working closely with our Project Team and client stakeholders, your role will be essential to the technical integration of new clients, contributing directly to our business growth. Proficiency in German is a requirement, as the majority of our customers are based in the DACH region.

Main Duties:

  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to enable seamless ERP integration.

  • Work on our standard API’s using Go and Java, including further development and task execution.

  • Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols (REST, SOAP, direct DB access, file transfers).

  • Translate and map incoming EDI and e-invoice formats to our standards.

  • Explore new ERP systems and determine optimal communication methods.

  • Document new interfaces and features.

  • Work with existing customers and maintain their interfaces.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • 3 years of experience in technical role, ideally linked to integrations and/or ERP systems

  • Proficiency in English, on top proficiency in German is preferred.

  • Experience with Go, Java, REST/SOAP, and SQL.

  • Ideally, professional experience in a client-facing role.

  • Structured and self-reliant working approach.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Benefits:

  • Generate real impact and lasting value with your work.

  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of ERP process automation innovation.

  • Fast-tracked promotions and an attractive bonus scheme, including company shares.

  • A collaborative environment that values teamwork and excellence.

  • Exposure to state-of-the-art technologies and continuous learning opportunities.

  • Choose your own hardware and join regular team events.

  • If the role is filled remotely from Europe: Paid visits and stay in Zurich to get to know the team in person.

Overview

Dane Street is seeking experienced Board-Certified Orthopedic Spine Surgeons licensed in Tennessee to join our growing panel of independent physician reviewers. In this role, you will apply your clinical expertise to conduct comprehensive medical record reviews and provide objective, evidence-based opinions on cases involving spinal conditions, injuries, treatments, and surgical interventions.

This fully remote opportunity offers flexible scheduling and the ability to customize your workload while working as a 1099 independent contractor.

Position Description

As a Physician Reviewer, you will evaluate medical records, prepare concise clinical summaries, and provide independent medical opinions in response to specific questions posed by our clients. Reviews may include assessments of medical necessity, appropriateness of care, causation, impairment, treatment recommendations, and other issues related to orthopedic spine care.

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Reviewing medical records and supporting documentation
  • Conducting evidence-based clinical assessments
  • Preparing clear, comprehensive written reports
  • Participating in peer-to-peer discussions when necessary
  • Answering client-specific questions regarding orthopedic spine diagnoses, treatment plans, and surgical interventions
  • Applying current clinical guidelines and standards of care to all reviews

Areas of Expertise

  • Orthopedic Spine Surgery
  • Degenerative Spine Conditions
  • Cervical, Thoracic, and Lumbar Disorders
  • Spinal Trauma and Injury
  • Minimally Invasive Spine Procedures
  • Spinal Fusion and Reconstructive Surgery
  • Non-Operative and Surgical Spine Management

Join a team that values your expertise and commitment to improving the quality, accuracy, and consistency of healthcare assessments. Your clinical knowledge plays a critical role in supporting high-quality medical determinations.

Requirements

  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO)
  • Board Certification in Orthopedic Surgery
  • Fellowship training and significant experience in Spine Surgery preferred
  • Current, unrestricted Tennessee medical license
  • Active clinical practice or recent experience in orthopedic spine surgery
  • Minimum of 5 years of post-residency clinical experience
  • Ability to attend required orientation and training sessions
  • Maintain all applicable licensure, certifications, credentialing, and professional requirements necessary to perform reviewer services

Benefits

  • Independent consultant role with flexible scheduling
  • Ability to choose case types and workload based on availability
  • No physician-patient relationship established; no treatment is rendered—reviews are advisory in nature only
  • Streamlined case assignment and management through a user-friendly online portal
  • Administrative support provided by Dane Street, including record collection and organization
  • Fully prepared cases with chronological medical records and applicable clinical guidelines
  • Initial training, ongoing support, and a dedicated point of contact
  • Predictable workflow with opportunities for supplemental professional income

Dane Street is committed to partnering with highly qualified specialists who bring clinical excellence, objectivity, and professionalism to every review.

raw.excerpt: About Virtru:While the rest of the security industry obsesses over locking data down to prevent it from being lost or stolen, we're doing something fundamentally different at Virtru.
raw.description:
About Virtru:

While the rest of the security industry obsesses over locking data down to prevent it from being lost or stolen, we're doing something fundamentally different at Virtru. We're setting data free so that you can intentionally share it with others, but without sacrificing security, privacy, or control.

We've created both a suite of powerful data protection applications and an open platform that's sparking an ecosystem of innovation. Through the Trusted Data Format (TDF) open standard, we're not just protecting data; we're creating a new paradigm where security enables sharing rather than preventing it.

Think of us as the Android of data protection: a robust platform with an open core that developers and partners can build upon, coupled with our own best-in-class applications that showcase what's possible when you reimagine security from the ground up.

Backed by Iconiq Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Foundry Capital, and Tiger Global, we're helping Fortune 500 companies and government agencies discover that true data security means having the freedom to share, collaborate, and innovate — without compromise.

Compensation: $155,000-200,000/year

Team & Position Details:

As a Senior Backend Software Engineer, you will be a core contributor to our Go-based backend and the open-source OpenTDF project, building the foundational services that power our entire data security platform. This is a hands-on role where you will tackle complex engineering challenges, architecting and implementing solutions that serve a diverse range of enterprise and federal customers. You will join a small, focused team with opportunities to collaborate with teams across Virtru's broader engineering organization.

You will thrive in this role if you are a resilient problem-solver who is comfortable navigating the unique challenges of on-premise, air-gapped, and cloud-native environments. If you are passionate about building robust, secure, and scalable systems and want to make a significant impact on a growing platform, we encourage you to apply.

As a Senior Backend Software Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, build, and maintain our core backend platform and services using Go.
  • Contribute directly to the open-source OpenTDF project, shaping its future and ensuring its success.
  • Tackle complex engineering challenges related to data security, scalability, and distributed systems in a multi-language environment.
  • Engineer and deploy solutions for complex enterprise and federal customer environments, including on-premise, air-gapped, and cloud-native deployments, using Terraform and GitOps tooling.
  • Collaborate on the architecture and implementation of our multi-language SDKs (Go, Java, JavaScript) to ensure they integrate seamlessly with the backend.
  • Mentor fellow engineers through constructive code reviews, pair programming, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.
  • Develop well-defined written design documents and contribute to a culture of technical excellence.
  • Leverage AI coding agents to accelerate development, maintain engineering standards, and scale your impact across the codebase.

Skills that will help you thrive in this role:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant focus on backend development.
  • Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) and experience building production-grade, scalable services with it.
  • Experience with both microservice and monolithic architectures, APIs (gRPC, REST), and distributed systems.
  • Proven hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes in production environments, with practical implementation of CI/CD and GitOps pipelines (e.g., Helm, ArgoCD)..
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform across multi-cloud environments.
  • A demonstrated ability to independently own complex technical projects from design to deployment.

Nice to have:

  • Deep experience in cryptography, including knowledge of cryptographic primitives, protocols, and secure key management.
  • Deep understanding of identity federation principles beyond just protocol usage (OIDC, SAML), including experience designing or contributing to federated trust systems.
  • Experience architecting for and deploying into complex customer environments, including on-premise, air-gapped, sovereign clouds, or bare-metal deployments.
  • Experience with modern API protocols like ConnectRPC.
  • Familiarity with container standards and runtimes like the Open Container Initiative (OCI).
  • Experience building and maintaining multi-language SDKs.
  • Contributions to open-source projects, especially in the security or data space.
  • Experience with other programming languages like Java, JavaScript, Python, or Rust.
  • Demonstrable experience as an active contributor or maintainer of an established open-source project.
  • Comfort working with AI coding agents as part of your development workflow.

Virtruvian qualities that will set you up for success:

Thinking outside of the box to respectfully challenge your teammates and managers in the pursuit of excellence

Strong sense of urgency with an action-oriented mindset

Able to collaborate and adapt to shifting priorities as business needs evolve

Comfortable with asynchronous communication including slack, email, zoom, etc.

Perks & Benefits:

At Virtru, we believe people do their best work when their wellbeing is put first. This is why we make your wellbeing our priority with a thoughtful and holistic program that encompasses Occupational, Mental, Social, Physical, and Environmental Wellness by offering benefits such as…

  • A Flexible PTO policy — we strongly encourage you to take time off (in addition to 14 holidays) to ensure that you are getting the proper time needed to unplug and recharge.
  • A $1,500 annual Learning & Development Stipend focused on providing you the resources to continually learn and professionally grow.
  • Frequent company-sponsored team celebrations that provide ample opportunities to connect with teammates and be social!
  • Access to an Employee Assistance Program
  • Access to Headspace, a mental health app tailored to your specific needs.
  • A flat 3% contribution to your retirement account
  • A high degree of flexibility — Have an appointment, errand, or family emergency to take care of? Hop to it! We give you the time and space to take care of you and your own first.

In addition to wellbeing, Virtru places a strong emphasis on diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. Our DB&I Council is dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace and making the psychological safety of each and every one of our teammates a top priority.

Additional perks include:

Competitive compensation

  • Generous parental, medical, and bereavement policies
  • Uncapped commissions for Sales roles
  • 401K contribution and stock options
  • Full medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • New Hire Swag and IT Welcome boxes
  • Structured semi-annual 360° performance reviews

Virtru is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. Virtru is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law.

raw.title: Staff IT Engineer
raw.excerpt: About AbridgeAbridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare.
raw.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

As a Staff IT Engineer, you will be a technical leader responsible for driving efficiency and scale across the entire corporate IT infrastructure and enterprise ecosystem. You will design, build, and maintain mission-critical automation solutions that eliminate manual processes, enhance security posture, and improve the employee experience globally. This role requires deep engineering expertise, an IT product mindset for automation, and the ability to mentor junior team members while tackling the organization's most complex integration and scaling challenges. You will work directly with IT leadership, Security leadership, and department heads across the company.

Operating at the intersection of healthcare AI and enterprise IT, you will be expected to architect and enforce automation standards that meet the rigorous demands of a HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2-audited environment.

What You'll Do

  • Workflow Automation: Develop scalable, resilient workflow automation solutions to streamline critical business processes, including onboarding/offboarding, access requests, compliance enforcement, and self-service IT support.

  • API and Integration Development: Serve as the subject matter expert for integrating disparate systems by building robust, fault-tolerant connections using APIs and event-driven architectures.

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM): Drive automation within the IAM infrastructure, focusing on automated role assignment, least-privilege policy enforcement, and audit-friendly logging of authentication and authorization events.

  • Enterprise Data Engineering: Architect and engineer robust data platforms for IT, ensuring efficient collection, normalization, and secure storage of high-volume enterprise data for reporting, audit, and advanced analytics.

  • Technical Leadership: Act as a force multiplier for the team — establishing engineering best practices, leading code reviews, documenting architectures, and mentoring engineers in automation principles.

  • Business Systems & Custom Application Deployment: Own the end-to-end deployment and lifecycle management of business-critical systems and custom-built applications, from architecture and vendor evaluation through implementation, integration, and ongoing support — ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise IT standards.

What You'll Need

  • Experience: 10+ years in IT Engineering, IT Apps Development, or DevOps, with at least 5 years dedicated to large-scale enterprise automation.

  • Cloud & Platform Expertise: Deep hands-on experience automating complex operations and governance across GCP, AWS, and/or Azure. You will bring an ability to build and modularize infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (i.e. Terraform).

  • Programming Proficiency: Highly proficient in at least one modern programming language; strong preference for Python.

  • Systems Integration: Proven experience with REST/GraphQL APIs and querying and managing relational databases (SQL strongly preferred).

  • Automation Platforms: Extensive experience designing and managing centralized automation platforms (e.g., n8n, SOAR, Ansible, Workato, or custom frameworks).

  • Compliance Context: Experience operating in regulated industries (healthcare, finance, or similar) with exposure to SOC 2, HIPAA, or equivalent compliance frameworks.

  • Communication: Able to communicate effectively across a wide range of audiences — from engineers to GTM stakeholders, from individual contributors to executives.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with agentic AI or ML models applied to IT automation (proactive issue detection, intelligent routing, NLP).

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Compensation Range: $200K - $240K

raw.excerpt: Work ArrangementRemote position with periodic travel to AEVEX facilities (Tampa, FL; Solana Beach, CA; other locations) as needed for implementation workshops, go-lives, and team events.
raw.description:
Work Arrangement

Remote position with periodic travel to AEVEX facilities (Tampa, FL; Solana Beach, CA; other locations) as needed for implementation workshops, go-lives, and team events. Estimated travel: 10–20%. May require occasional work outside standard business hours for deployments, upgrades, or critical incident resolution.

Job Overview

This is a platform ownership role focused on the continued development, maturity, and expansion of ServiceNow across the organization. The successful candidate should think beyond individual tickets and enhancements and focus on process efficiency, automation, data integrity, user adoption, scalability, and long-term platform value.

The ServiceNow Architect will own assigned solutions and modules end-to-end, from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, deployment, documentation, and continuous improvement in production.

The role will initially support ServiceNow development and platform initiatives based on defined projects, enhancements, and organizational priorities, with the opportunity to assume greater platform ownership as ServiceNow capabilities and adoption continue to expand.

Essential Functions

Platform Development & Ownership

  • Serve as a primary technical resource for the ServiceNow platform across the enterprise environment.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and continuously improve ServiceNow solutions based on business and IT requirements.
  • Develop and maintain Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, Scheduled Jobs, and other platform components using JavaScript and Glide APIs.
  • Build and manage Flow Designer flows, subflows, actions, approvals, notifications, and other automation.
  • Manage Update Sets and controlled promotion of changes across Development, Test, and Production environments.
  • Support platform upgrades, testing, release management, and ongoing platform health.
  • Evaluate existing configurations and recommend opportunities to simplify, standardize, or improve solutions.

ITSM & Service Experience

  • Develop and mature ITSM capabilities including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Catalog.
  • Configure and improve Change Management capabilities including change models, approvals, CAB workflows, risk assessment, and supporting automation.
  • Design and maintain Service Catalog items, Record Producers, approval workflows, SLAs, and self-service capabilities.
  • Improve agent workspaces, assignment processes, queues, forms, and other experiences that increase technician efficiency.
  • Continuously improve the end-user experience through portal improvements, self-service, automation, and feedback-driven iteration.
  • Identify unnecessary manual processes and develop practical solutions that improve service delivery.

HAM / SAM & Asset Lifecycle

  • Develop and mature Hardware Asset Management (HAM) and Software Asset Management (SAM) capabilities within ServiceNow.
  • Configure and improve hardware asset lifecycle processes including receiving, assignment, inventory, refresh, return, retirement, and disposal.
  • Improve asset ownership, inventory visibility, normalization, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Develop software asset and license management capabilities including software inventory, entitlement and license visibility, utilization, and lifecycle management.
  • Develop automation between asset management, request fulfillment, procurement, onboarding/offboarding, and other applicable processes.
  • Maintain appropriate relationships between assets and Configuration Items within the CMDB.

ITOM, Discovery & CMDB

  • Mature and maintain the CMDB with an emphasis on accuracy, completeness, ownership, relationships, and data integrity.
  • Configure and optimize Discovery schedules, MID Servers, Service Mapping, reconciliation rules, normalization, and CI relationships.
  • Support ITOM capabilities that improve infrastructure and service visibility.
  • Develop processes and automation to identify and remediate stale, duplicate, incomplete, or inaccurate CMDB data.
  • Partner with infrastructure and application teams to establish appropriate CI ownership and data governance.

Integration & Automation

  • Design, develop, and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, and other supported integration methods.
  • Design and deploy IntegrationHub spokes, spoke actions, and reusable automation components.
  • Integrate ServiceNow with enterprise identity, endpoint management, monitoring, security, business, and other platforms as requirements evolve.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IT and business processes and reduce manual intervention.
  • Design integrations with scalability, maintainability, security, and appropriate error handling in mind.

Reporting, Analytics & Platform Visibility

  • Develop dashboards and operational reporting that provide meaningful visibility into service performance.
  • Provide reporting around workload, ticket aging, SLA performance, trends, ownership, asset inventory, CMDB health, and other operational metrics.
  • Work with IT leadership and process owners to identify meaningful KPIs and translate them into actionable ServiceNow reporting.
  • Improve data quality where necessary to ensure ServiceNow reporting can be relied upon for operational and management decisions.

Acquisition & Business Process Integration

  • Support the onboarding of newly acquired organizations, teams, users, assets, and business processes into the ServiceNow environment.
  • Assess existing processes and workflows—including SharePoint-based or other legacy workflows—and determine appropriate ServiceNow solutions.
  • Translate business processes into scalable ServiceNow workflows, catalog items, approvals, integrations, and automation.
  • Work with stakeholders to gather requirements, validate designs, conduct testing, and coordinate production implementation.
  • Look for opportunities to standardize acquired processes while avoiding unnecessary customization.

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Maintain ServiceNow roles, ACLs, RBAC, and other security configurations to appropriately protect platform data.
  • Follow established development, testing, documentation, peer review, change management, and production deployment processes.
  • Support SOX, SOC, CMMC, NIST 800-171, and other applicable compliance requirements where ServiceNow workflows, access controls, reporting, or audit evidence are involved.
  • Develop and maintain workflows supporting access requests, approvals, access reviews, change management, and other controlled processes as required.
  • Ensure platform solutions are designed with auditability and appropriate separation of duties in mind.

Continuous Improvement & Platform Adoption

  • Maintain a platform ownership mindset, proactively identifying opportunities to improve ServiceNow rather than relying solely on submitted enhancement requests.
  • Recommend capabilities that maximize the value of existing ServiceNow licensing and identify when additional modules or capabilities may provide measurable value.
  • Partner with IT leadership, technical teams, process owners, and business stakeholders to establish priorities and deliver scalable solutions.
  • Promote adoption through intuitive workflows, self-service capabilities, documentation, and user feedback.
  • Maintain technical documentation, integration architecture, configuration documentation, and operational runbooks.
  • Provide knowledge transfer for significant configurations and enhancements.
  • Serve as an escalation resource for complex ServiceNow platform issues when required.

Standard Essential Functions

  • Regular and reliable attendance on a full time basis [or in accordance with posted schedule].
  • Responsible for exhibiting professional behavior with both internal and external business associates that reflects positively on the company and is consistent with the company's policies and practices.
  • Embodies AEVEX’s cultural values and aligns daily actions with department goals and company culture.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development and administration experience.
  • Strong proficiency with JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Flow Designer.
  • Demonstrated experience with ServiceNow ITSM including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Catalog.
  • Experience with HAM, SAM, or broader IT Asset Management capabilities.
  • Experience with CMDB, Discovery, MID Server, Service Mapping, reconciliation, and CI relationships.
  • Practical experience developing automation using Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, or comparable ServiceNow capabilities.
  • Experience developing REST/SOAP integrations and understanding ServiceNow integration patterns.
  • Experience developing operational dashboards and reporting within ServiceNow.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL practices and their application within ServiceNow.
  • Ability to translate technical and business requirements into practical, scalable platform solutions.

We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.

Senior Director, Emerging Science & Pipeline Strategy Marketing Community Lead

As the Senior Director, Emerging Science & Pipeline Strategy Marketing Community Lead, you are accountable for shaping the future HCP commercial portfolio through early commercialization strategy, customer ecosystem development, launch readiness, and transition planning across emerging assets and strategic opportunities.

Reporting to the VP, HCP Experience, you will partner closely with Therapeutic Community Leads, Indication Strategy Leads, Customer Engagement & Experience, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Business Development, Insights, and other enterprise partners to bring commercial and customer perspective into emerging opportunities, inform asset and development decisions, and prepare assets to transition successfully into therapeutic communities.

Roles & Responsibilities

Emerging Science & Pipeline Strategy

  • Lead HCP commercial strategy across pipeline assets, future indications, exploratory opportunities, partnerships / licensing opportunities, and other strategic opportunities.

  • Translate enterprise HCP Experience priorities into early commercialization strategies that support launch readiness, customer ecosystem development, portfolio growth, and informed investment decisions.

  • Maintain the community-level view of emerging customer needs, therapeutic landscapes, KOL networks, academic centers, referral dynamics, and other stakeholders shaping future market development.

  • Assess emerging opportunities and provide commercial perspective on relative priority, customer opportunity, readiness, resource needs, and strategic optionality.

  • Partner with asset, development, Medical Affairs, Business Development, and commercial teams to ensure customer and ecosystem insights inform asset strategy, evidence planning, launch planning, and market development.

  • Elevate emerging customer, scientific, market, and pipeline insights to senior leaders to inform prioritization and investment decisions.

Customer Ecosystem, Launch Readiness & Transition

  • Develop an integrated Emerging Science & Pipeline Strategy plan connecting customer insights, KOL strategy, launch readiness, pipeline opportunities, and cross-functional priorities.

  • Lead early customer planning, including ecosystem mapping, emerging KOL identification, academic center prioritization, and customer journey implications.

  • Shape early HCP education and engagement approaches in partnership with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Customer Engagement & Experience, Insights, and TLL leadership.

  • Establish launch and transition readiness criteria for movement of assets into Neurology, Rheumatology, or future therapeutic communities.

  • Lead transition planning to ensure customer ecosystem continuity, clear handoffs, resource readiness, and accountability as assets move into scaled execution.

  • Monitor scientific, market, customer, and competitive dynamics and adjust priorities and transition plans as the pipeline evolves.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Capability Building

  • Serve as a senior HCP marketing and commercialization leader across emerging science, pipeline strategy, and early commercialization.

  • Build strong partnerships across Therapeutic Communities, Portfolio Marketing, Customer Engagement & Experience, Field, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Business Development, Market Access, Patient Experience, Digital, Insights, and other enterprise functions.

  • Align priorities, resolve emerging asset and launch-readiness trade-offs, and ensure progress against Emerging Science & Pipeline Strategy priorities.

  • Champion data-enabled and AI-supported approaches that improve early commercialization and pipeline decision-making.

  • Lead, coach, and develop direct reports and your network of empowered teams, building capability in customer insight, pipeline prioritization, ecosystem shaping, early commercialization, and launch readiness.

  • Foster a culture of customer-centricity, accountability, collaboration, innovation, strong compliance, and sound judgment.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of HCP marketing, early commercialization, pipeline strategy, customer engagement, launch readiness, and lifecycle management in complex healthcare markets.

  • Strong ability to understand and shape emerging scientific ecosystems, KOL networks, academic centers, referral dynamics, and future customer communities.

  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate competing pipeline opportunities, assess commercial readiness, and make clear recommendations across emerging assets.

  • Experience translating emerging science, customer insight, and market dynamics into commercialization implications and actions.

  • Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to synthesize scientific, customer, market, and cross-functional input into clear direction.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, resolve trade-offs, and lead effectively in a complex network of empowered teams.

  • Strong leadership presence and ability to coach, develop, and inspire teams through ambiguity and change.

Education, Experience & Qualifications

  • BA/BS required; advanced degree preferred.

  • Approximately 15+ years of relevant biotech or pharmaceutical commercial experience, including significant leadership in early commercialization, pipeline strategy, HCP marketing, launch planning, therapeutic area strategy, or portfolio strategy.

  • Demonstrated leadership across pipeline strategy, early commercialization, launch readiness, and therapeutic area strategy across multiple assets, indications, or lifecycle stages.

  • Experience prioritizing emerging opportunities and leading complex, matrixed work across multiple assets, functions, and competing priorities.

  • Strong understanding of HCP customer journeys, KOL engagement, disease-state education, customer ecosystem development, and launch readiness in specialty, rare disease, biologics, or similarly complex markets.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, develop talent, and manage complex commercialization initiatives through growth, ambiguity, and change.

Growth & Acquisition Marketing Manager

The Global Talent Co. · Remote · Full-time

About the Opportunity

The Global Talent Co. is recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing DTC wellness brand whose mission is simple: help people live healthier. They're scaling their customer acquisition engine and looking to connect it more tightly to the full customer journey.

About the Role

We're looking for a Growth & Acquisition Marketing Manager to own our client's customer acquisition strategy across paid media and emerging growth channels. You'll manage their paid media agency, set acquisition strategy, guide creative testing, oversee media investment, and make sure every paid dollar is directly tied to DTC growth goals.

This role sits at the center of the digital growth engine — working closely with the Lifecycle & Retention Manager, e-commerce team, creative partners, and agency teams to keep the customer journey connected from first impression to purchase and beyond. You'll own strategy, performance accountability, budget planning, reporting, and the business decisions behind paid acquisition.

The ideal candidate is a strategic operator who understands performance marketing and paid platforms inside and out — analytical, commercially minded, creative, and comfortable pushing back on agency recommendations to make sure media investment is working as hard as possible.

What You'll Do

Acquisition Strategy Own acquisition strategy across paid media and emerging growth channels — Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, affiliate, influencer, retail media, and beyond. Build plans that support product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and always-on growth, balancing efficiency, growth, and long-term customer value.

Agency Leadership & Performance Accountability Own the day-to-day relationship with the paid media agency. Hold them accountable to performance targets, reporting quality, and testing velocity. Review plans, challenge assumptions, and translate agency output into clear decisions for the internal team.

Budget Management & Forecasting Own paid media budget planning, pacing, and investment recommendations. Build monthly and quarterly plans tied to DTC revenue goals, and monitor CAC, MER, ROAS, and new customer acquisition to keep investment sharp.

Creative Testing & Growth Insights Build a creative testing roadmap with the agency and creative team. Brief creative needs from customer insights and performance data, and share what's working across email, SMS, website, social, and brand marketing.

Reporting & Analytics Own weekly and monthly reporting on paid acquisition — new customers, revenue, CAC, MER, ROAS, conversion rate, AOV, payback, and channel performance — and turn the data into business recommendations, not just campaign updates.

Cross-Channel Collaboration Partner with Lifecycle & Retention, e-commerce, Creative, Brand, Innovation, CX, and Sales to keep acquisition strategy connected to the rest of the business.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in growth, acquisition, performance, or digital marketing

  • Proven experience managing paid media programs, in-house or through an agency

  • Experience managing agency relationships and holding partners accountable

  • Strong grasp of customer acquisition, media investment, and channel strategy

  • DTC, Shopify, CPG, wellness, beauty, food, or beverage experience strongly preferred

  • Comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • Strong communicator — can present performance insights and recommendations clearly

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience

Technical Skills

  • Strong command of Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, affiliate, paid social, and paid search

  • Fluent in acquisition metrics: CAC, MER, ROAS, new customer revenue, conversion rate, AOV, LTV, payback

  • Experience with GA4, Shopify analytics, ad platform reporting, dashboards, UTMs, pixels, and conversion tracking

  • Solid budget management and forecasting skills

  • Experience building testing frameworks across creative, audience, landing page, and channel mix

Who You Are

Passionate about health and wellness. Driven by growth but disciplined about efficiency and profitability. Commercially minded, analytical, and creative — someone who connects marketing activity to revenue outcomes and isn't afraid to challenge an agency's recommendation. A self-starter who moves quickly and takes ownership in a high-growth environment.

raw.description:
About A1

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

Role

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role. Work directly with engineers on system design, evaluation, and trade-offs-defining requirements, but shaping how the system works for global users. You work at the intersection of user needs, model capability, and system constraints, and are responsible for turning AI potential into real, reliable behavior in a real-world application.

What You'll be Doing

  • Research and define end-to-end AI system requirements from capability to behavior to user impact

  • Translate model capabilities, data constraints, and evaluation results into clear product and system decisions

  • Make hard trade-offs across quality, latency, cost, reliability, and UX

  • Work closely with ML, backend, and mobile engineers on system design, evaluation, and iteration

  • Define and evolve evaluation frameworks across offline metrics, online experiments, and human feedback

  • Drive execution with clear specs, strong judgment, and disciplined prioritization

  • Ensure systems ship quickly, safely, and reliably, with strong feedback loops

  • Own product quality end-to-end - correctness, predictability, and user trust

What You Will Need

Technical foundation

  • Strong grounding in computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and system design.

  • Solid understanding of ML fundamentals and how modern AI systems behave in production.

  • Comfort reading, reviewing, and discussing technical design documents.

AI & ML experience

  • Hands-on exposure to AI-powered products, including LLM-based systems.

  • Experience working with model evaluation, prompt or pipeline iteration, and feedback loops.

  • Strong intuition for model limitations, hallucinations, bias, and drift.

Product leadership

  • Significant experience owning complex, technical products end-to-end.

  • Proven ability to work closely with senior engineers and ML teams.

  • Strong judgment and decision-making ability in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • Ability to balance ambition with technical and operational reality.

Nice to have

  • Experience shipping AI-heavy consumer products.

  • Background as an engineer or highly technical product manager.

  • Experience defining evaluation metrics for ML systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and failure handling.

  • Prior experience in zero-to-one product environments.

Outcomes

  • Product strategy clearly aligns AI capabilities with user needs and company priorities.

  • AI features deliver real value, are understandable, predictable, and trusted by users.

  • Decisions balance quality, speed, cost, and reliability effectively under uncertainty.

  • Roadmaps and priorities are clear, with fast iteration based on real user feedback.

  • Teams are aligned, focused, and able to execute on AI product goals with minimal friction.

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

Dane Street is seeking experienced Board-Certified Orthopedic Spine Surgeons licensed in Tennessee to join our growing panel of independent physician reviewers. In this role, you will apply your clinical expertise to conduct comprehensive medical record reviews and provide objective, evidence-based opinions on cases involving spinal conditions, injuries, treatments, and surgical interventions.

This fully remote opportunity offers flexible scheduling and the ability to customize your workload while working as a 1099 independent contractor.

Position Description

As a Physician Reviewer, you will evaluate medical records, prepare concise clinical summaries, and provide independent medical opinions in response to specific questions posed by our clients. Reviews may include assessments of medical necessity, appropriateness of care, causation, impairment, treatment recommendations, and other issues related to orthopedic spine care.

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Reviewing medical records and supporting documentation
  • Conducting evidence-based clinical assessments
  • Preparing clear, comprehensive written reports
  • Participating in peer-to-peer discussions when necessary
  • Answering client-specific questions regarding orthopedic spine diagnoses, treatment plans, and surgical interventions

  • Orthopedic Spine Surgery
  • Degenerative Spine Conditions
  • Cervical, Thoracic, and Lumbar Disorders
  • Spinal Trauma and Injury
  • Minimally Invasive Spine Procedures
  • Spinal Fusion and Reconstructive Surgery

Requirements

  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO)
  • Board Certification in Orthopedic Surgery
  • Fellowship training and significant experience in Spine Surgery preferred
  • Current, unrestricted Tennessee medical license
  • Active clinical practice or recent experience in orthopedic spine surgery
  • Minimum of 5 years of post-residency clinical experience
  • Ability to attend required orientation and training sessions

Benefits

raw.description:
About Virtru:

While the rest of the security industry obsesses over locking data down to prevent it from being lost or stolen, we're doing something fundamentally different at Virtru. We're setting data free so that you can intentionally share it with others, but without sacrificing security, privacy, or control.

We've created both a suite of powerful data protection applications and an open platform that's sparking an ecosystem of innovation. Through the Trusted Data Format (TDF) open standard, we're not just protecting data; we're creating a new paradigm where security enables sharing rather than preventing it.

Think of us as the Android of data protection: a robust platform with an open core that developers and partners can build upon, coupled with our own best-in-class applications that showcase what's possible when you reimagine security from the ground up.

Backed by Iconiq Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, Foundry Capital, and Tiger Global, we're helping Fortune 500 companies and government agencies discover that true data security means having the freedom to share, collaborate, and innovate — without compromise.

Compensation: $155,000-200,000/year

Team & Position Details:

As a Senior Backend Software Engineer, you will be a core contributor to our Go-based backend and the open-source OpenTDF project, building the foundational services that power our entire data security platform. This is a hands-on role where you will tackle complex engineering challenges, architecting and implementing solutions that serve a diverse range of enterprise and federal customers. You will join a small, focused team with opportunities to collaborate with teams across Virtru's broader engineering organization.

You will thrive in this role if you are a resilient problem-solver who is comfortable navigating the unique challenges of on-premise, air-gapped, and cloud-native environments. If you are passionate about building robust, secure, and scalable systems and want to make a significant impact on a growing platform, we encourage you to apply.

As a Senior Backend Software Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, build, and maintain our core backend platform and services using Go.
  • Contribute directly to the open-source OpenTDF project, shaping its future and ensuring its success.
  • Tackle complex engineering challenges related to data security, scalability, and distributed systems in a multi-language environment.
  • Engineer and deploy solutions for complex enterprise and federal customer environments, including on-premise, air-gapped, and cloud-native deployments, using Terraform and GitOps tooling.
  • Collaborate on the architecture and implementation of our multi-language SDKs (Go, Java, JavaScript) to ensure they integrate seamlessly with the backend.
  • Mentor fellow engineers through constructive code reviews, pair programming, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.
  • Develop well-defined written design documents and contribute to a culture of technical excellence.
  • Leverage AI coding agents to accelerate development, maintain engineering standards, and scale your impact across the codebase.

Skills that will help you thrive in this role:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant focus on backend development.
  • Strong proficiency in Go (Golang) and experience building production-grade, scalable services with it.
  • Experience with both microservice and monolithic architectures, APIs (gRPC, REST), and distributed systems.

raw.excerpt: About AbridgeAbridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare.
raw.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

As a Staff IT Engineer, you will be a technical leader responsible for driving efficiency and scale across the entire corporate IT infrastructure and enterprise ecosystem. You will design, build, and maintain mission-critical automation solutions that eliminate manual processes, enhance security posture, and improve the employee experience globally. This role requires deep engineering expertise, an IT product mindset for automation, and the ability to mentor junior team members while tackling the organization's most complex integration and scaling challenges. You will work directly with IT leadership, Security leadership, and department heads across the company.

Operating at the intersection of healthcare AI and enterprise IT, you will be expected to architect and enforce automation standards that meet the rigorous demands of a HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2-audited environment.

What You'll Do

  • Workflow Automation: Develop scalable, resilient workflow automation solutions to streamline critical business processes, including onboarding/offboarding, access requests, compliance enforcement, and self-service IT support.

  • API and Integration Development: Serve as the subject matter expert for integrating disparate systems by building robust, fault-tolerant connections using APIs and event-driven architectures.

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM): Drive automation within the IAM infrastructure, focusing on automated role assignment, least-privilege policy enforcement, and audit-friendly logging of authentication and authorization events.

  • Enterprise Data Engineering: Architect and engineer robust data platforms for IT, ensuring efficient collection, normalization, and secure storage of high-volume enterprise data for reporting, audit, and advanced analytics.

  • Technical Leadership: Act as a force multiplier for the team — establishing engineering best practices, leading code reviews, documenting architectures, and mentoring engineers in automation principles.

  • Business Systems & Custom Application Deployment: Own the end-to-end deployment and lifecycle management of business-critical systems and custom-built applications, from architecture and vendor evaluation through implementation, integration, and ongoing support — ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise IT standards.

What You'll Need

  • Experience: 10+ years in IT Engineering, IT Apps Development, or DevOps, with at least 5 years dedicated to large-scale enterprise automation.

  • Cloud & Platform Expertise: Deep hands-on experience automating complex operations and governance across GCP, AWS, and/or Azure. You will bring an ability to build and modularize infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code (i.e. Terraform).

  • Programming Proficiency: Highly proficient in at least one modern programming language; strong preference for Python.

  • Systems Integration: Proven experience with REST/GraphQL APIs and querying and managing relational databases (SQL strongly preferred).

  • Automation Platforms: Extensive experience designing and managing centralized automation platforms (e.g., n8n, SOAR, Ansible, Workato, or custom frameworks).

  • Compliance Context: Experience operating in regulated industries (healthcare, finance, or similar) with exposure to SOC 2, HIPAA, or equivalent compliance frameworks.

  • Communication: Able to communicate effectively across a wide range of audiences — from engineers to GTM stakeholders, from individual contributors to executives.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with agentic AI or ML models applied to IT automation (proactive issue detection, intelligent routing, NLP).

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Compensation Range: $200K - $240K
